verses.en: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
verses.fr: Voici les paroles que Moïse adressa à tout Israël, de l''autre côté du Jourdain, dans le désert, dans la plaine, vis-à-vis de Suph, entre Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hatséroth et Di-Zahab.
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በምድረ በዳ፥ በዓረባ ውስጥ በኤርትራ ባሕር ፊት ለፊት፥ በፋራን በጦፌልም በላባንም በሐጼሮትም በዲዛሃብም መካከል ሳሉ፥ ሙሴ ለእስራኤል ሁሉ የነገራቸው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: (There are eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadeshbarnea.)
verses.fr: Il y a onze journées depuis Horeb, par le chemin de la montagne de Séir, jusqu''à Kadès-Barnéa.
verses.am: በሴይር ተራራ መንገድ ከኮሬብ እስከ ቃዴስ በርኔ ድረስ የአሥራ አንድ ቀን መንገድ ነው።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the Lord had given him in commandment unto them;
verses.fr: Dans la quarantième année, au onzième mois, le premier du mois, Moïse parla aux enfants d''Israël selon tout ce que l''Eternel lui avait ordonné de leur dire.
verses.am: በአርባኛው ዓመት በአሥራ አንደኛው ወር ከወሩም በመጀመሪያው ቀን፥ ሙሴ፥ በሐሴቦን ተቀምጦ የነበረውን የአሞራውያንን ንጉሥ ሴዎንን፥ በአስታሮትና በኤድራይ ተቀምጦ የነበረውን የባሳንን ንጉሥ ዐግን ከመታ በኋላ፥ እግዚአብሔር ስለ እነርሱ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ነገራቸው።

verses.en: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:
verses.fr: C''était après qu''il eut battu Sihon, roi des Amoréens, qui habitait à Hesbon, et Og, roi de Basan, qui habitait à Aschtaroth et à Edréi.
verses.am: በአርባኛው ዓመት በአሥራ አንደኛው ወር ከወሩም በመጀመሪያው ቀን፥ ሙሴ፥ በሐሴቦን ተቀምጦ የነበረውን የአሞራውያንን ንጉሥ ሴዎንን፥ በአስታሮትና በኤድራይ ተቀምጦ የነበረውን የባሳንን ንጉሥ ዐግን ከመታ በኋላ፥ እግዚአብሔር ስለ እነርሱ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ነገራቸው።

verses.en: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,
verses.fr: De l''autre côté du Jourdain, dans le pays de Moab, Moïse commença à expliquer cette loi, et dit:
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በሞዓብ ምድር ሙሴ እንዲህ ብሎ ይህችን ሕግ ይገልጥ ጀመር።

verses.en: The Lord our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:
verses.fr: L''Eternel, notre Dieu, nous a parlé à Horeb, en disant: Vous avez assez demeuré dans cette montagne.
verses.am: አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር በኮሬብ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረን። በዚህ ተራራ የተቀመጣችሁት በቃ፤

verses.en: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.
verses.fr: Tournez-vous, et partez; allez à la montagne des Amoréens et dans tout le voisinage, dans la plaine, sur la montagne, dans la vallée, dans le midi, sur la côte de la mer, au pays des Cananéens et au Liban, jusqu''au grand fleuve, au fleuve d''Euphrate.
verses.am: ተመልሳችሁ ተጓዙ፤ ወደ ተራራማው ወደ አሞራውያን አገር ወደ ድንበሮቹም ሁሉ፥ በዓረባም በደጋውም በቈላውም በደቡብም በባሕርም ዳር ወዳሉ ወደ ከነዓናውያን ምድር፥ ወደ ሊባኖስም እስከ ታላቁ ወንዝም እስከ ኤፍራጥስ ድረስ ሂዱ።

verses.en: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the Lord sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.
verses.fr: Voyez, j''ai mis le pays devant vous; allez, et prenez possession du pays que l''Eternel a juré à vos pères, Abraham, Isaac et Jacob, de donner à eux et à leur postérité après eux.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ምድሪቱን በፊታችሁ አድርጌአለሁ፤ ግቡ፥ እግዚአብሔር ለእነርሱ ከእነርሱም በኋላ ለዘራቸው ይሰጣት ዘንድ ለአባቶቻችሁ ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም የማለላቸውንም ምድር ውረሱ።

verses.en: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:
verses.fr: Dans ce temps-là, je vous dis: Je ne puis pas, à moi seul, vous porter.
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን እንዲህ ብዬ ተናገርኋችሁ። እኔ ብቻዬን ልሸከማችሁ አልችልም፤

verses.en: The Lord your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
verses.fr: L''Eternel, votre Dieu, vous a multipliés, et vous êtes aujourd''hui aussi nombreux que les étoiles du ciel.
verses.am: አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር አብዝቶአችኋል፥ እነሆም፥ እናንተ ዛሬ እንደ ሰማይ ከዋክብት ብዛት ናችሁ።

verses.en: (The Lord God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)
verses.fr: Que l''Eternel, le Dieu de vos pères, vous augmente mille fois autant, et qu''il vous bénisse comme il vous l''a promis!
verses.am: የአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር በዚህ ቁጥር ላይ እልፍ አእላፋት ይጨምር፥ እንደ ተናገራችሁም ይባርካችሁ።

verses.en: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
verses.fr: Comment porterais-je, à moi seul, votre charge, votre fardeau et vos contestations?
verses.am: እኔ ብቻዬን ድካምችሁን ሸክማችሁንም ክርክራችሁንም እሸከም ዘንድ እንዴት እችላለሁ?

verses.en: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.
verses.fr: Prenez dans vos tribus des hommes sages, intelligents et connus, et je les mettrai à votre tête.
verses.am: ከእናንተ ከየነገዳችሁ ጥበበኞች አስተዋዮዎችም አዋቂዎችም የሆኑትን ሰዎች ምረጡ፥ እኔም በላያችሁ አለቆች አደርጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.
verses.fr: Vous me répondîtes, en disant: Ce que tu proposes de faire est une bonne chose.
verses.am: እናንተም። እናደርገው ዘንድ የተናገርኸው ይህ ነገር መልካም ነው ብላችሁ መለሳችሁልኝ።

verses.en: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.
verses.fr: Je pris alors les chefs de vos tribus, des hommes sages et connus, et je les mis à votre tête comme chefs de mille, chefs de cent, chefs de cinquante, et chefs de dix, et comme ayant autorité dans vos tribus.
verses.am: ጥበበኞችና አዋቂዎች የሆኑትን የነገዶቻችሁን አለቆች መረጥሁ፥ በእናንተም ላይ አለቆች የሻለቆችም የመቶ አለቆችም የአምሳ አለቆችም የአሥር አለቆችም ገዦችም በየነገዶቻቸው አደረግኋቸው።

verses.en: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.
verses.fr: Je donnai, dans le même temps, cet ordre à vos juges: Ecoutez vos frères, et jugez selon la justice les différends de chacun avec son frère ou avec l''étranger.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም። የወንድሞቻችሁን ነገር ስሙ፤ በሰውና በወንድሙ ከእርሱም ጋር ባለው መጻተኛ መካከል በጽድቅ ፍረዱ።

verses.en: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.
verses.fr: Vous n''aurez point égard à l''apparence des personnes dans vos jugements; vous écouterez le petit comme le grand; vous ne craindrez aucun homme, car c''est Dieu qui rend la justice. Et lorsque vous trouverez une cause trop difficile, vous la porterez devant moi, pour que je l''entende.
verses.am: በፍርድም አድልዎ አታድርጉ፤ ታላቁን እንደምትሰሙ፥ ታናሹንም እንዲሁ ስሙ፤ ፍርድ ለእግዚአብሔር ነውና ከሰው ፊት አትፍሩ፤ ከነገርም አንድ ነገር ቢከብዳችሁ እርሱን ወደ እኔ አምጡት፥ እኔም እሰማዋለሁ ብዬ ፈራጆቻችሁን አዘዝኋቸው።

verses.en: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que je vous prescrivis, dans ce temps-là, tout ce que vous aviez à faire.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ልታደርጉት የሚገባችሁን ነገር ሁሉ አዘዝኋችሁ።

verses.en: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the Lord our God commanded us; and we came to Kadeshbarnea.
verses.fr: Nous partîmes d''Horeb, et nous parcourûmes en entier ce grand et affreux désert que vous avez vu; nous prîmes le chemin de la montagne des Amoréens, comme l''Eternel, notre Dieu, nous l''avait ordonné, et nous arrivâmes à Kadès-Barnéa.
verses.am: ከኮሬብም ተጓዝን፥ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘን በታላቁ እጅግም በሚያስፈራ በዚያ ባያችሁት ምድረ በዳ ሁሉ በኩል በተራራማው በአሞራውያን መንገድ ሄድን፤ ወደ ቃዴስ በርኔም መጣን።

verses.en: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the Lord our God doth give unto us.
verses.fr: Je vous dis: Vous êtes arrivés à la montagne des Amoréens, que l''Eternel, notre Dieu, nous donne.
verses.am: እኔም። አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ወደሚሰጠን ወደ ተራራማው ወደ አሞራውያን አገር መጣችሁ፤

verses.en: Behold, the Lord thy God hath set the land before thee: go up and possess it, as the Lord God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.
verses.fr: Vois, l''Eternel, ton Dieu, met le pays devant toi; monte, prends-en possession, comme te l''a dit l''Eternel, le Dieu de tes pères; ne crains point, et ne t''effraie point.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ምድሪቱን በፊትህ አድርጎአል፤ የአባቶችህ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዳለህ፥ ውጣ፥ ውረሳት፤ አትፍራ፥ አትደንግጥም አልኋችሁ።

verses.en: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.
verses.fr: Vous vous approchâtes tous de moi, et vous dîtes: Envoyons des hommes devant nous, pour explorer le pays, et pour nous faire un rapport sur le chemin par lequel nous y monterons et sur les villes où nous arriverons.
verses.am: እናንተም ሁላችሁ ወደ እኔ ቀርባችሁ። ምድሪቱን እንዲጎበኙልንና እንወጣበት ዘንድ የሚገባንን የመንገዱንና የምንገባባቸውን የእነዚያን ከተሞች ወሬ ተመልሰው እንዲነግሩን በፊታችን ሰዎች እንስደድ አላችሁኝ።

verses.en: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:
verses.fr: Cet avis me parut bon; et je pris douze hommes parmi vous, un homme par tribu.
verses.am: ያም ነገር ደስ አሰኘኝ፤ ከእናንተም አሥራ ሁለት ሰው መረጥሁ፤ ከየነገዱ ሁሉ አንድ አንድ ሰው ነበረ።

verses.en: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.
verses.fr: Ils partirent, traversèrent la montagne, et arrivèrent jusqu''à la vallée d''Eschcol, qu''ils explorèrent.
verses.am: ሄዱም፥ ወደ ተራራማውም ወጡ፥ ወደ ኤሽኮልም ሸለቆ መጥተው ጎበኙአት።

verses.en: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which the Lord our God doth give us.
verses.fr: Ils prirent dans leurs mains des fruits du pays, et nous les présentèrent; ils nous firent un rapport, et dirent: C''est un bon pays, que l''Eternel, notre Dieu, nous donne.
verses.am: ከምድሪቱም ፍሬ በእጃቸው ወሰዱ፥ ወደ እኛም ይዘውት መጡ። አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር የሚሰጠን ምድር መልካም ናት ብለውም አወሩልን።

verses.en: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the Lord your God:
verses.fr: Mais vous ne voulûtes point y monter, et vous fûtes rebelles à l''ordre de l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: በአምላካችሁ በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ላይ ዓመፃችሁ እንጂ ወደ እርስዋ መውጣትን እንቢ አላችሁ፤

verses.en: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the Lord hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
verses.fr: Vous murmurâtes dans vos tentes, et vous dîtes: C''est parce que l''Eternel nous hait, qu''il nous a fait sortir du pays d''Egypte, afin de nous livrer entre les mains des Amoréens et de nous détruire.
verses.am: በድንኳናችሁም ውስጥ እንዲህ እያላችሁ አጕረመረማችሁ። እግዚአብሔር ስለ ጠላን እንዲያጠፋን በአሞራውያን አጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጠን ዘንድ ከግብፅ ምድር አወጣን።

verses.en: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.
verses.fr: Où monterions-nous? Nos frères nous ont fait perdre courage, en disant: C''est un peuple plus grand et de plus haute taille que nous; ce sont des villes grandes et fortifiées jusqu''au ciel; nous y avons même vu des enfants d''Anak.
verses.am: ወዴት እንወጣለን? ሕዝቡ ብዙ ነው፥ ቁመቱም ከእኛ ይረዝማል፥ ከተሞቹም ታላላቆች የተመሸጉም እስከ ሰማይም የደረሱ ናቸው፥ የዔናቅንም ልጆች ደግሞ በዚያ አየናቸው ብለው ወንድሞቻችን ልባችንን አስፈሩት።

verses.en: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
verses.fr: Je vous dis: Ne vous épouvantez pas, et n''ayez pas peur d''eux.
verses.am: እኔም አልኋችሁ። አትደንግጡ፥ ከእነርሱም አትፍሩ፤

verses.en: The Lord your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
verses.fr: L''Eternel, votre Dieu, qui marche devant vous, combattra lui-même pour vous, selon tout ce qu''il a fait pour vous sous vos yeux en Egypte,
verses.am: በፊታችሁ የሚሄደው አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር፥ እናንተ ስታዩ በግብፅና በምድረ በዳ እንዳደረገላችሁ ሁሉ፥ ስለ እናንተ ይዋጋል፤

verses.en: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the Lord thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.
verses.fr: puis au désert, où tu as vu que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''a porté comme un homme porte son fils, pendant toute la route que vous avez faite jusqu''à votre arrivée en ce lieu.
verses.am: ወደዚህም ስፋራ እስክትመጡ ድረስ በሄዳችሁበት መንገድ ሁሉ፥ ሰው ልጁን እንዲሸከም አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር እንደተሸከመህ አንተ አይተሃል።

verses.en: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the Lord your God,
verses.fr: Malgré cela, vous n''eûtes point confiance en l''Eternel, votre Dieu,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የቃላችሁን ድምፅ ሰምቶ ተቆጣ።

verses.en: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.
verses.fr: qui allait devant vous sur la route pour vous chercher un lieu de campement, la nuit dans un feu afin de vous montrer le chemin où vous deviez marcher, et le jour dans une nuée.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የቃላችሁን ድምፅ ሰምቶ ተቆጣ።

verses.en: And the Lord heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel entendit le bruit de vos paroles. Il s''irrita, et jura, en disant:
verses.am: ለአባቶቻችሁ እሰጣት ዘንድ የማልሁላቸውን መልካሚቱን ምድር ከእነዚህ ሰዎች ከዚህ ክፉ ትውልድ ማንም አያይም፥

verses.en: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers.
verses.fr: Aucun des hommes de cette génération méchante ne verra le bon pays que j''ai juré de donner à vos pères,
verses.am: ከዮፎኒ ልጅ ከካሌብ በቀር እርሱ ግን ያያታል፤ እግዚአብሔርን ፈጽሞ ተከትሎአልና የረገጣትን ምድር ለእርሱ ለልጆቹም እሰጣለሁ ብሎ ማለ።

verses.en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the Lord.
verses.fr: excepté Caleb, fils de Jephunné; il le verra, lui, et je donnerai à lui et à ses enfants le pays sur lequel il a marché, parce qu''il a pleinement suivi la voie de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ በእናንተ ምክንያት በእኔ ተቆጣ እንዲህም አለ። አንተ ደግሞ ወደዚያ አትገባም፤

verses.en: Also the Lord was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.
verses.fr: L''Eternel s''irrita aussi contre moi, à cause de vous, et il dit: Toi non plus, tu n''y entreras point.
verses.am: በፊትህ የሚቆም የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ እርሱ ወደዚያ ይገባል፤ እርሱ ለእስራኤል ምድሪቱን ያወርሳልና አደፋፍረው።

verses.en: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
verses.fr: Josué, fils de Nun, ton serviteur, y entrera; fortifie-le, car c''est lui qui mettra Israël en possession de ce pays.
verses.am: ደግሞ። ለምርኮ ይሆናሉ ያላችኋቸው ሕፃናቶቻችሁ፥ ዛሬም መልካሙን ከክፉ መለየት የማይችሉ ልጆቻችሁ፥ እነርሱ ወደዚያ ይገባሉ፥ ምድሪቱንም ለእነርሱ እስጣለሁ ይወርሱአታልም።

verses.en: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
verses.fr: Et vos petits enfants, dont vous avez dit: Ils deviendront une proie! et vos fils, qui ne connaissent aujourd''hui ni le bien ni le mal, ce sont eux qui y entreront, c''est à eux que je le donnerai, et ce sont eux qui le posséderont.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን ተመልሳችሁ በኤርትራ ባሕር መንገድ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ሂዱ።

verses.en: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.fr: Mais vous, tournez-vous, et partez pour le désert, dans la direction de la mer Rouge.
verses.am: እናንተም። እግዚአብሔርን በድለናል፤ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘን ሁሉ እንወጣለን፥ እንዋጋማለን ብላችሁ መለሳችሁልኝ። ከእናንተም ሰው ሁሉ የጦር መሣሪያውን ያዘ፥ ወደ ተራራማውም አገር መውጣትን አቀለላችሁት።

verses.en: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the Lord, we will go up and fight, according to all that the Lord our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.
verses.fr: Vous répondîtes, en me disant: Nous avons péché contre l''Eternel; nous monterons et nous combattrons, comme l''Eternel, notre Dieu, nous l''a ordonné. Et vous ceignîtes chacun vos armes, et vous fîtes le projet téméraire de monter à la montagne.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። እኔ በእናንተ መካከል አይደለሁምና በጠላቶቻችሁ ፊት እንዳትወድቁ አትውጡ፥ አትዋጉም በላቸው አለኝ። እኔም ተናገርኋችሁ፤

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me, Say unto them. Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: Dis-leur: Ne montez pas et ne combattez pas, car je ne suis pas au milieu de vous; ne vous faites pas battre par vos ennemis.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ላይ ዓመፃችሁ እንጂ አልሰማችሁም፤ በትዕቢታችሁም ወደ ተራራማው አገር ወጣችሁ።

verses.en: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the Lord, and went presumptuously up into the hill.
verses.fr: Je vous parlai, mais vous n''écoutâtes point; vous fûtes rebelles à l''ordre de l''Eternel, et vous montâtes audacieusement à la montagne.
verses.am: በዚያም በተራራማው አገር ይኖሩ የነበር አሞራውያን ወጥተው ተጋጠሙአችሁ፥ ንብ እንደምታሳድድም አሳደዱአችሁ፥ እስከ ሔርማም ድረስ በሴይር መቱአችሁ።

verses.en: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.
verses.fr: Alors les Amoréens, qui habitent cette montagne, sortirent à votre rencontre, et vous poursuivirent comme font les abeilles; ils vous battirent en Séir, jusqu''à Horma.
verses.am: ተመልሳችሁም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አለቀሳችሁ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ድምፃችሁን አልሰማም፥ ወደ እናንተም አላዳመጠም።

verses.en: And ye returned and wept before the Lord; but the Lord would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.
verses.fr: A votre retour, vous pleurâtes devant l''Eternel; mais l''Eternel n''écouta point votre voix, et ne vous prêta point l''oreille.
verses.am: እንደ ተቀመጣችሁበትም ዘመን መጠን በቃዴስ ብዙ ቀን ተቀመጣችሁ።

verses.en: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there.
verses.fr: Vous restâtes à Kadès, où le temps que vous y avez passé fut de longue durée.
verses.am: ፤ እንደ ተቀመጣችሁበትም ዘመን መጠን በቃዴስ ብዙ ቀን ተቀመጣችሁ።

verses.en: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the Lord spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.
verses.fr: Nous nous tournâmes, et nous partîmes pour le désert, par le chemin de la mer Rouge, comme l''Eternel me l''avait ordonné; nous suivîmes longtemps les contours de la montagne de Séir.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዳለኝ ተመልሰን በኤርትራ ባሕር መንገድ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ሄድን፤ የሴይርንም ተራራ ብዙ ቀን ዞርን።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto me, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረኝ።

verses.en: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.
verses.fr: Vous avez assez suivi les contours de cette montagne. Tournez-vous vers le nord.
verses.am: ይህን ተራራ መዞር ይበቃችኋል፤ ተመልሳችሁ ወደ ሰሜን ሂዱ።

verses.en: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:
verses.fr: Donne cet ordre au peuple: Vous allez passer à la frontière de vos frères, les enfants d''Esaü, qui habitent en Séir. Ils vous craindront; mais soyez bien sur vos gardes.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም እንዲህ ብለህ እዘዛቸው። በሴይር ላይ በተቀመጡት በወንድሞቻችሁ በዔሳው ልጆች አገር ታልፋላችሁ፥ እነርሱም ይፈሩአችኋል፤ እንግዲህ እጅግ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.en: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.
verses.fr: Ne les attaquez pas; car je ne vous donnerai dans leur pays pas même de quoi poser la plante du pied: j''ai donné la montagne de Séir en propriété à Esaü.
verses.am: የሴይርን ተራራ ለዔሳው ርስት አድርጌ ስለ ሰጠሁ እኔ ከምድራቸው የጫማ መርገጫ ታህል እንኳ አልሰጣችሁምና አትጣሉአቸው።

verses.en: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.
verses.fr: Vous achèterez d''eux à prix d''argent la nourriture que vous mangerez, et vous achèterez d''eux à prix d''argent même l''eau que vous boirez.
verses.am: ከእነርሱ በገንዘብ ምግብ ገዝታችሁ ትበላላችሁ፤ ውኃም ደግሞ በገንዘብ ገዝታችሁ ትጠጣላችሁ።

verses.en: For the Lord thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the Lord thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''a béni dans tout le travail de tes mains, il a connu ta marche dans ce grand désert. Voilà quarante années que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, est avec toi: tu n''as manqué de rien.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር የእጅህን ሥራ ሁሉ ባርኮልሃልና፤ በዚህ በታላቅ ምድረ በዳ መሄድህን አውቆአል፤ በዚህ አርባ ዓመት ውስጥ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ነበረ፥ አንዳችም አላጣህም።

verses.en: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Eziongaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
verses.fr: Nous passâmes à distance de nos frères, les enfants d''Esaü, qui habitent en Séir, et à distance du chemin de la plaine, d''Elath et d''Etsjon-Guéber, puis nous nous tournâmes, et nous prîmes la direction du désert de Moab.
verses.am: በሴይርም ከተቀመጡት ከወንድሞቻችን ከዔሳው ልጆች በዓረባ መንገድ ከኤላትና ከዔጽዮንጋብር አለፍን። ተመልሰንም በሞዓብ ምድረ በዳ መንገድ አለፍን።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: N''attaque pas Moab, et ne t''engage pas dans un combat avec lui; car je ne te donnerai rien à posséder dans son pays: c''est aux enfants de Lot que j''ai donné Ar en propriété.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለኝ። እኔ ዔርን ለሎጥ ልጆች ርስት አድርጌ ስለ ሰጠሁ ከምድሩ ርስት አልሰጣችሁምና ሞዓብን አትጣላ በሰልፍም አትውጋቸው።

verses.en: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;
verses.fr: Les Emim y habitaient auparavant; c''était un peuple grand, nombreux et de haute taille, comme les Anakim.
verses.am: አስቀድሞ ታላቅና ብዙ ሕዝብ እንደ ዔናቅም ልጆች በቁመት የረዘሙ ኤሚማውያን በዚያ ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites called them Emims.
verses.fr: Ils passaient aussi pour être des Rephaïm, de même que les Anakim; mais les Moabites les appelaient Emim.
verses.am: እነርሱም ደግሞ እንደ ዔናቅ ልጆች ራፋይም ይባሉ ነበር፤ ሞዓባውያን ግን ኤሚም ይሉአቸዋል።

verses.en: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the Lord gave unto them.
verses.fr: Séir était habité autrefois par les Horiens; les enfants d''Esaü les chassèrent, les détruisirent devant eux, et s''établirent à leur place, comme l''a fait Israël dans le pays qu''il possède et que l''Eternel lui a donné.
verses.am: ሖራውያንም ደግሞ አስቀድሞ በሴይር ላይ ተቀምጠው ነበር፥ የዔሳው ልጆች ግን አሳደዱአቸው፤ እግዚአብሔርም በሰጠው በርስቱ ምድር እስራኤል እንዳደረገ፥ ከፊታቸው አጠፉአቸው፥ በስፍራቸውም ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.
verses.fr: Maintenant levez-vous, et passez le torrent de Zéred. Nous passâmes le torrent de Zéred.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ተነሡ የዘሬድንም ፈፋ ተሻገሩ አለ።

verses.en: And the space in which we came from Kadeshbarnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the Lord sware unto them.
verses.fr: Le temps que durèrent nos marches de Kadès-Barnéa au passage du torrent de Zéred fut de trente-huit ans, jusqu''à ce que toute la génération des hommes de guerre eût disparu du milieu du camp, comme l''Eternel le leur avait juré.
verses.am: የዘሬድንም ፈፋ ተሻገርን። የዘሬድንም ፈፋ እስከ ተሻገርንበት ድረስ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ማለባቸው የሰልፈኞች ትውልድ ሁሉ ከሰፈሩ መካከል እስከ ጠፉ ድረስ፥ ከቃዴስ በርኔ የተጓዝንበት ዘመን ሠላሳ ስምንት ዓመት ሆነ።

verses.en: For indeed the hand of the Lord was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.
verses.fr: La main de l''Eternel fut aussi sur eux pour les détruire du milieu du camp, jusqu''à ce qu''ils eussent disparu.
verses.am: ከሰፈርም መካከል ተቈርጠው እስኪጠፉ ድረስ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ በላያቸው ነበረ።

verses.en: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
verses.fr: Lorsque tous les hommes de guerre eurent disparu par la mort du milieu du peuple,
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሰልፈኞቹ ከጠፉ ከሕዝቡም መካከል ከሞቱ በኋላ፥

verses.en: That the Lord spake unto me, saying,
verses.fr: l''Eternel me parla, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረኝ።

verses.en: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:
verses.fr: Tu passeras aujourd''hui la frontière de Moab, à Ar,
verses.am: አንተ ዛሬ የሞዓብን ዳርቻ ዔርን ታልፋለህ፤

verses.en: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.
verses.fr: et tu approcheras des enfants d''Ammon. Ne les attaque pas, et ne t''engage pas dans un combat avec eux; car je ne te donnerai rien à posséder dans le pays des enfants d''Ammon: c''est aux enfants de Lot que je l''ai donné en propriété.
verses.am: ለሎጥም ልጆች ርስት አድርጌ ስለ ሰጠሁ ከአሞን ልጆች ምድር ርስት አልሰጥህምና በአሞን ልጆች አቅራቢያ ስትደርስ አትጣላቸው አትውጋቸውም።

verses.en: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;
verses.fr: Ce pays passait aussi pour un pays de Rephaïm; des Rephaïm y habitaient auparavant, et les Ammonites les appelaient Zamzummim:
verses.am: ያም ደግሞ የራፋይም ምድር ተብሎ ተቆጠረ፤ ራፋይምም አስቀድሞ በዚያ ተቀምጠው ነበር፤ አሞናውያን ግን ዘምዙማውያን ብለው ይጠሩአቸዋል።

verses.en: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the Lord destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:
verses.fr: c''était un peuple grand, nombreux et de haute taille, comme les Anakim. L''Eternel les détruisit devant les Ammonites, qui les chassèrent et s''établirent à leur place.
verses.am: ታላቅና ብዙም ሕዝብ እንደ ዔናቅም ልጆች ቁመታቸው የረዘመ ነበሩ፤ እግዚአብሔር ከፊታቸው አጠፋቸው፤ እነርሱንም አሳድደው በስፍራቸው ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que fit l''Eternel pour les enfants d''Esaü qui habitent en Séir, quand il détruisit les Horiens devant eux; ils les chassèrent et s''établirent à leur place, jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: ሖራውያንን ከፊታቸው አጥፍቶ በሴይር ለተቀመጡት ለዔሳው ልጆች እንዳደረገ እንዲሁ ለእነርሱ አደረገ፤ እነርሱንም አሳድደው በስፍራቸው እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)
verses.fr: Les Avviens, qui habitaient dans des villages jusqu''à Gaza, furent détruits par les Caphtorim, sortis de Caphtor, qui s''établirent à leur place.
verses.am: እስከ ጋዛም ድረስ በመንደሮች ተቀምጠው የነበሩትን ኤዋውያንን ከከፍቶር የወጡ ከፍቶራውያን አጠፉአቸው፥ በስፍራቸውም ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
verses.fr: Levez-vous, partez, et passez le torrent de l''Arnon. Vois, je livre entre tes mains Sihon, roi de Hesbon, l''Amoréen et son pays. Commence la conquête, fais-lui la guerre!
verses.am: ደግሞም አለ። ተነሥታችሁ ሂዱ፥ የአርኖንንም ሸለቆ ተሻገሩ፤ እነሆ፥ አሞራዊውን የሐሴቦንን ንጉሥ ሴዎንን ምድሩንም በእጅህ አሳልፌ ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ እርስዋን በመውረስ ጀምር፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ተዋጋ።

verses.en: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.
verses.fr: Je vais répandre dès aujourd''hui la frayeur et la crainte de toi sur tous les peuples qui sont sous le ciel; et, au bruit de ta renommée, ils trembleront et seront saisis d''angoisse à cause de toi.
verses.am: ከሰማይ በታች ባሉ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ ማስደንገጥህንና ማስፈራትህን እሰድድ ዘንድ ዛሬ እጀምራለሁ፤ ወሬህን በሰሙ ጊዜ በፊትህ ይንቀጠቀጣሉ፥ ድንጋጤም ይይዛቸዋል።

verses.en: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
verses.fr: J''envoyai, du désert de Kedémoth, des messagers à Sihon, roi de Hesbon, avec des paroles de paix. Je lui fis dire:
verses.am: ከቅዴሞትም ምድረ በዳ የሰላምን ቃል ይነግሩት ዘንድ ወደ ሐሴቦን ንጉሥ ወደ ሴዎን እንዲህ ብዬ መልእክተኞችን ላክሁ። በአገርህ ላይ ልለፍ፤

verses.en: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.
verses.fr: Laisse-moi passer par ton pays; je suivrai la grande route, sans m''écarter ni à droite ni à gauche.
verses.am: በአውራ ጎዳና እሄዳለሁ፥ ወደ ቀኝም ወደ ግራም አልተላለፍም።

verses.en: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;
verses.fr: Tu me vendras à prix d''argent la nourriture que je mangerai, et tu me donneras à prix d''argent l''eau que je boirai; je ne ferai que passer avec mes pieds.
verses.am: የሐሴቦን ንጉሥ ሴዎን ግን ያሳልፈን ዘንድ አልፈቀደም፤ እንደ ዛሬው ሁሉ በእጅህ አሳልፎ ይሰጠው ዘንድ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር መንፈሱን አደንድኖታልና፥ ልቡንም አጽንቶታልና።

verses.en: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the Lord our God giveth us.
verses.fr: C''est ce que m''ont accordé les enfants d''Esaü qui habitent en Séir, et les Moabites qui demeurent à Ar. Accorde-le aussi, jusqu''à ce que je passe le Jourdain pour entrer au pays que l''Eternel, notre Dieu, nous donne.
verses.am: የሐሴቦን ንጉሥ ሴዎን ግን ያሳልፈን ዘንድ አልፈቀደም፤ እንደ ዛሬው ሁሉ በእጅህ አሳልፎ ይሰጠው ዘንድ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር መንፈሱን አደንድኖታልና፥ ልቡንም አጽንቶታልና።

verses.en: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the Lord thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.
verses.fr: Mais Sihon, roi de Hesbon, ne voulut point nous laisser passer chez lui; car l''Eternel, ton Dieu, rendit son esprit inflexible et endurcit son coeur, afin de le livrer entre tes mains, comme tu le vois aujourd''hui.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ሴዎንንና ምድሩን በእጅህ አሳልፌ መስጠት፥ እነሆ፥ ጀመርሁ፤ ምድሩን ትገዛት ዘንድ መውረስ ጀምር አለኝ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: Vois, je te livre dès maintenant Sihon et son pays.
verses.am: ሴዎንም ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ሊጋጠሙን ወደ ያሀጽ ወጡ።

verses.en: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.
verses.fr: Sihon sortit à notre rencontre, avec tout son peuple, pour nous combattre à Jahats.
verses.am: አምላካችንም እግዚአብሔር እርሱን አሳልፎ ሰጠን፤ እርሱንም ልጆቹንም ሕዝቡንም ሁሉ መታን።

verses.en: And the Lord our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.
verses.fr: L''Eternel, notre Dieu, nous le livra, et nous le battîmes, lui et ses fils, et tout son peuple.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ከተሞቹን ሁሉ ወሰድን የተቀመጡባቸውንም ሰዎች ሁሉ ሴቶችንም ሕፃናቶችንም አጠፋን፤ አንዳችም አላስቀረንም፥

verses.en: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:
verses.fr: Nous prîmes alors toutes ses villes, et nous les dévouâmes par interdit, hommes, femmes et petits enfants, sans en laisser échapper un seul.
verses.am: ከብቶቻቸውንና ከከተሞቻቸው ያገኘነውን ብዝበዛ ለራሳችን ወሰድን እንጂ።

verses.en: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.
verses.fr: Seulement, nous pillâmes pour nous le bétail et le butin des villes que nous avions prises.
verses.am: በአርኖን ቈላ አጠገብ ካለችው ከአሮዔር ከሸለቆውም ውስጥ ካለችው ከተማ ጀምረን እስከ ገለዓድ ድረስ ማናቸይቱም ከተማ አልጠነከረችብንም፤ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን አሳልፎ ሰጠን።

verses.en: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the Lord our God delivered all unto us:
verses.fr: Depuis Aroër sur les bords du torrent de l''Arnon, et la ville qui est dans la vallée, jusqu''à Galaad, il n''y eut pas de ville trop forte pour nous: l''Eternel, notre Dieu, nous livra tout.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ወደ ከለከለን ሁሉ፥ ወደ አሞን ልጆች ምድር በያቦቅም ወንዝ አጠገብ ወዳለው ስፍራ ሁሉ በተራራማውም አገር ወዳሉት ከተሞች አልደረስንም።

verses.en: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the Lord our God forbad us.
verses.fr: Mais tu n''approchas point du pays des enfants d''Ammon, de tous les bords du torrent de Jabbok, des villes de la montagne, de tous les lieux que l''Eternel, notre Dieu, t''avait défendu d''attaquer.
verses.am: ፤ ዳሩ ግን አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ወደ ከለከለን ሁሉ፥ ወደ አሞን ልጆች ምድር በያቦቅም ወንዝ አጠገብ ወዳለው ስፍራ ሁሉ በተራራማውም አገር ወዳሉት ከተሞች አልደረስንም።

verses.en: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.fr: Nous nous tournâmes, et nous montâmes par le chemin de Basan. Og, roi de Basan, sortit à notre rencontre, avec tout son peuple, pour nous combattre à Edréi.
verses.am: ተመልሰን በባሳን መንገድ ወጣን፥ የባሳን ንጉሥ ዐግም ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በኤድራይ ሊዋጉን ወጡ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: Ne le crains point; car je le livre entre tes mains, lui et tout son peuple, et son pays; tu le traiteras comme tu as traité Sihon, roi des Amoréens, qui habitait à Hesbon.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። እርሱንና ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ምድሩንም በእጅህ አሳልፌ ሰጥቼአለሁና አትፍራው፤ በሐሴቦን ይኖር በነበረው በአሞራውያን ንጉሥ በሴዎን ላይ እንዳደረግህ በእርሱም ታደርግበታለህ አለኝ።

verses.en: So the Lord our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel, notre Dieu, livra encore entre nos mains Og, roi de Basan, avec tout son peuple; nous le battîmes, sans laisser échapper aucun de ses gens.
verses.am: አምላካችን እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ የባሳንን ንጉሥ ዐግን ሕዝቡንም ሁሉ በእጃችን አሳልፎ ሰጠን፤ እኛም መታነው፤ አንድ ሰው እንኳ አምልጦ አልቀረለትም።

verses.en: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.fr: Nous prîmes alors toutes ses villes, et il n''y en eut pas une qui ne tombât en notre pouvoir: soixante villes, toute la contrée d''Argob, le royaume d''Og en Basan.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ከተሞቹን ሁሉ ወሰድን፤ አንድም ያልወሰድነው የለም፤ በባሳን ያለውን የዐግን መንግሥት፥ የአርጎብን አገር ሁሉ፥ ስድሳ ከተሞችን ወሰድን።

verses.en: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.
verses.fr: Toutes ces villes étaient fortifiées, avec de hautes murailles, des portes et des barres; il y avait aussi des villes sans murailles en très grand nombre.
verses.am: በቅጥር ካልተመሸጉት ከእጅግ ብዙ ከተሞች ሌላ፥ እነዚህ ከተሞች ሁሉ ቁመቱ ረጅም በሆነ ቅጥር በመዝጊያና በመወርወሪያም የተመሸጉ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.
verses.fr: Nous les dévouâmes par interdit, comme nous l''avions fait à Sihon, roi de Hesbon; nous dévouâmes toutes les villes par interdit, hommes, femmes et petits enfants.
verses.am: በሐሴቦንም ንጉሥ በሴዎን እንዳደረግን ፈጽሞ አጠፋናቸው፤ ከተሞቹን ሁሉ ከወንዶችና ከሴቶች ከሕፃናቶችም ጋር አጠፋናቸው።

verses.en: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.
verses.fr: Mais nous pillâmes pour nous tout le bétail et le butin des villes.
verses.am: ከብቶቹን ሁሉ የከተሞቹንም ምርኮ ለእኛ በዘበዝን።

verses.en: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que, dans ce temps-là, nous conquîmes sur les deux rois des Amoréens le pays de l''autre côté du Jourdain, depuis le torrent de l''Arnon jusqu''à la montagne de l''Hermon
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን ከአርኖን ሸለቆ ጀምሮ እስከ አርሞንዔም ተራራ ድረስ ምድሪቱን በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ከነበሩ ከሁለቱ ከአሞራውያን ነገሥታት እጅ ወሰድን፤

verses.en: (Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)
verses.fr: les Sidoniens donnent à l''Hermon le nom de Sirion, et les Amoréens celui de Senir,
verses.am: ሲዶናውያን አርሞንዔምን ሢርዮን ብለው ይጠሩታል፥ አሞራውያንም ሳኔር ብለው ይጠሩታል።

verses.en: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.fr: toutes les villes de la plaine, tout Galaad et tout Basan jusqu''à Salca et Edréi, villes du royaume d''Og en Basan.
verses.am: በሜዳውም ያሉትን ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ ገለዓድንም ሁሉ፥ በባሳንም ያሉትን የዐግን መንግሥት ከተሞች እስከ ሰልካና እስከ ኤድራይ ድረስ ባሳንን ሁሉ ወሰድን።

verses.en: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.
verses.fr: Og, roi de Basan, était resté seul de la race des Rephaïm. Voici, son lit, un lit de fer, n''est-il pas à Rabbath, ville des enfants d''Ammon? Sa longueur est de neuf coudées, et sa largeur de quatre coudées, en coudées d''homme.
verses.am: ከራፋይም ወገን የባሳን ንጉሥ ዐግ ብቻውን ቀርቶ ነበር፤ እነሆ፥ አልጋው የብረት አልጋ ነበረ፤ እርሱ በአሞን ልጆች አገር በነበረባት አለ፤ ርዝመቱ ዘጠኝ ክንድ ወርዱም አራት ክንድ በሰው ክንድ ልክ ነበረ።

verses.en: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.
verses.fr: Nous prîmes alors possession de ce pays. Je donnai aux Rubénites et aux Gadites le territoire à partir d''Aroër sur le torrent de l''Arnon et la moitié de la montagne de Galaad avec ses villes.
verses.am: ይህችንም ምድር በዚያን ዘመን ወረስን፤ በአርኖንም ሸለቆ አጠገብ ካለችው ከአሮዔር ጀምሮ የገለዓድን ተራራማ አገር እኩሌታ ከተሞቹንም ለሮቤልና ለጋድ ነገድ ሰጠኋቸው።

verses.en: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.
verses.fr: Je donnai à la moitié de la tribu de Manassé le reste de Galaad et tout le royaume d''Og en Basan: toute la contrée d''Argob, avec tout Basan, c''est ce qu''on appelait le pays des Rephaïm.
verses.am: ከገለዓድም የቀረውን የዐግንም መንግሥት ባሳንን ሁሉ፥ የአርጎብንም ምድር ሁሉ ለምናሴ ነገድ እኩሌታ ሰጠሁ፤ ያችም ባሳን ሁሉ የራፋይም አገር ተብላ ተቈጠረች።

verses.en: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashanhavothjair, unto this day.
verses.fr: Jaïr, fils de Manassé, prit toute la contrée d''Argob jusqu''à la frontière des Gueschuriens et des Maacathiens, et il donna son nom aux bourgs de Basan, appelés encore aujourd''hui bourgs de Jaïr.
verses.am: የምናሴ ልጅ ኢያዕር እስከ ጌሹራውያንና እስከ ማዕካታውያን ዳርቻ ድረስ የአርጎብን ምድር ሁሉ ወሰደ፤ ይህችንም የባሳንን ምድር እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በስሙ የኢያዕር መንደሮች ብሎ ጠራ።

verses.en: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.
verses.fr: Je donnai Galaad à Makir.
verses.am: ለማኪርም ገልዓድን ሰጠሁት።

verses.en: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.fr: Aux Rubénites et aux Gadites je donnai une partie de Galaad jusqu''au torrent de l''Arnon, dont le milieu sert de limite, et jusqu''au torrent de Jabbok, frontière des enfants d''Ammon;
verses.am: ለሮቤል ነገድና ለጋድም ነገድ ከገለዓድ ጀምሮ እስከ አርኖን ሸለቆ ድረስ የሸለቆውን እኩሌታ ዳርቻውንም፥ እስከ አሞን ልጆች ዳርቻ እስከ ያቦቅ ወንዝ ድረስ፥

verses.en: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdothpisgah eastward.
verses.fr: je leur donnai encore la plaine, limitée par le Jourdain, depuis Kinnéreth jusqu''à la mer de la plaine, la mer Salée, au pied du Pisga vers l''orient.
verses.am: ከኪኔሬት እስከ ዓረባ ባሕር እርሱም የጨው ባሕር ድረስ ከፈስጋ ተራራ በታች ወደ ምሥራቅ ያለውን ዓረባ ዮርዳኖስንም ዳሩንም ሰጠኋቸው።

verses.en: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The Lord your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all that are meet for the war.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, je vous donnai cet ordre. L''Eternel, votre Dieu, vous livre ce pays, pour que vous le possédiez. Vous tous, soldats, vous marcherez en armes devant les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን እንዲህ ብዬ አዘዝኋችሁ። አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ይህችን ምድር ርስት አድርጎ ሰጥቶአችኋል፤ መሣሪያችሁን ይዛችሁ እናንተ አርበኞች ሁሉ በወንድሞቻችሁ በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ትሻገራላችሁ።

verses.en: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;
verses.fr: Vos femmes seulement, vos petits enfants et vos troupeaux-je sais que vous avez de nombreux troupeaux-resteront dans les villes que je vous ai données,
verses.am: ነገር ግን እጅግ ከብቶች እንዳሉአችሁ አውቃለሁና ሴቶቻችሁና ልጆቻችሁ ከብቶቻችሁም በሰጠኋችሁ ከተሞች ይቀመጣሉ፤

verses.en: Until the Lord have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which the Lord your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.
verses.fr: jusqu''à ce que l''Eternel ait accordé du repos à vos frères comme à vous, et qu''ils possèdent, eux aussi, le pays que l''Eternel, votre Dieu, leur donne de l''autre côté du Jourdain. Et vous retournerez chacun dans l''héritage que je vous ai donné.
verses.am: ይኸውም እግዚአብሔር እናንተን እንዳሳረፈ፥ ወንድሞቻችሁን እስኪያሳርፍ ድረስ እነርሱም ደግሞ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር የሚሰጣቸውን ምድር እስኪወርሱ ድረስ ነው፤ ከዚያም በኋላ እናንተ ሁሉ ወደ ሰጠኋችሁ ርስት ትመለሳላችሁ።

verses.en: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the Lord your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the Lord do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, je donnai des ordres à Josué, et je dis: Tes yeux ont vu tout ce que l''Eternel, votre Dieu, a fait à ces deux rois: ainsi fera l''Eternel à tous les royaumes contre lesquels tu vas marcher.
verses.am: በዚያም ጊዜ ኢያሱን። አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር በእነዚህ በሁለቱ ነገሥት ያደረገውን ሁሉ ዓይኖችህ አይተዋል፤ እንዲሁ በምታልፍባቸው መንግሥታት ሁሉ ላይ እግዚአብሔር ያደርጋል።

verses.en: Ye shall not fear them: for the Lord your God he shall fight for you.
verses.fr: Ne les craignez point; car l''Eternel, votre Dieu, combattra lui-même pour vous.
verses.am: አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር እርሱ ስለ እናንተ ይዋጋልና አትፍራቸውም ብዬ አዘዝሁት።

verses.en: And I besought the Lord at that time, saying,
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, j''implorai la miséricorde de l''Eternel, en disant:
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን እኔ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብዬ ለመንሁ።

verses.en: O Lord God, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?
verses.fr: Seigneur Eternel, tu as commencé à montrer à ton serviteur ta grandeur et ta main puissante; car quel dieu y a-t-il, au ciel et sur la terre, qui puisse imiter tes oeuvres et tes hauts faits?
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ታላቅነትህን የጸናችውንም እጅህን ለእኔ ለባሪያህ ማሳየት ጀምረሃል፤ በሰማይና በምድርም እንደ ሥራህ እንደ ኃይልህም ይሠራ ዘንድ የሚችል አምላክ ማን ነው?

verses.en: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.
verses.fr: Laisse-moi passer, je te prie, laisse-moi voir ce bon pays de l''autre côté du Jourdain, ces belles montagnes et le Liban.
verses.am: እኔ ልሻገር በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ ያለችውን መልካሚቱን ምድር ያንም መልካሙን ተራራማውን አገር ሊባኖስንም ልይ።

verses.en: But the Lord was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the Lord said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.
verses.fr: Mais l''Eternel s''irrita contre moi, à cause de vous, et il ne m''écouta point. L''Eternel me dit: C''est assez, ne me parle plus de cette affaire.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን በእናንተ ምክንያት ተቈጣኝ አልሰማኝምም፤ እግዚአብሔርም አለኝ። ይበቃሃል፤ በዚህ ነገር ደግመህ አትናገረኝ።

verses.en: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
verses.fr: Monte au sommet du Pisga, porte tes regards à l''occident, au nord, au midi et à l''orient, et contemple de tes yeux; car tu ne passeras pas ce Jourdain.
verses.am: ይህን ዮርዳኖስን አትሻገርምና ወደ ፈስጋ ራስ ውጣ፤ ዓይንህንም ወደ ምዕራብ ወደ ሰሜንም ወደ ደቡብም ወደ ምሥራቅም አንሥተህ በዓይንህ ተመልከት።

verses.en: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.
verses.fr: Donne des ordres à Josué, fortifie-le et affermis-le; car c''est lui qui marchera devant ce peuple et qui le mettra en possession du pays que tu verras.
verses.am: ኢያሱ በዚህ ሕዝብ ፊት ይሻገራልና፥ አንተም የምታያትን ምድር እርሱ ያወርሳቸዋልና ኢያሱን እዘዘው፥ አደፋፍረውም፥ አጽናውም።

verses.en: So we abode in the valley over against Bethpeor.
verses.fr: Nous demeurâmes dans la vallée, vis-à-vis de Beth-Peor.
verses.am: በቤተፌጎርም ፊት ለፊት በሸለቆው ውስጥ ተቀመጥን።

verses.en: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the Lord God of your fathers giveth you.
verses.fr: Maintenant, Israël, écoute les lois et les ordonnances que je vous enseigne. Mettez-les en pratique, afin que vous viviez, et que vous entriez en possession du pays que vous donne l''Eternel, le Dieu de vos pères.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እስራኤል ሆይ፥ እንድታደርጉአቸው በሕይወትም እንድትኖሩ፥ የአባቶቻችሁም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ወደሚሰጣችሁ ምድር ገብታችሁ እንድትወርሱ፥ የማስተምራችሁን ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ስሙ።

verses.en: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the Lord your God which I command you.
verses.fr: Vous n''ajouterez rien à ce que je vous prescris, et vous n''en retrancherez rien; mais vous observerez les commandements de l''Eternel, votre Dieu, tels que je vous les prescris.
verses.am: እኔ ያዘዝኋችሁን የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ትጠብቃላችሁ እንጂ ባዘዝኋችሁ ቃል ላይ አትጨምሩም፥ ከእርሱም አታጎድሉም።

verses.en: Your eyes have seen what the Lord did because of Baalpeor: for all the men that followed Baalpeor, the Lord thy God hath destroyed them from among you.
verses.fr: Vos yeux ont vu ce que l''Eternel a fait à l''occasion de Baal-Peor: l''Eternel, ton Dieu, a détruit du milieu de toi tous ceux qui étaient allés après Baal-Peor.
verses.am: ብዔልፌጎርን የተከተሉትን ሰዎች ሁሉ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከመካከላችሁ እንዳጠፋ፥ እግዚአብሔር በብዔልፌጎር ያደረገውን ዓይኖቻችሁ አይተዋል።

verses.en: But ye that did cleave unto the Lord your God are alive every one of you this day.
verses.fr: Et vous, qui vous êtes attachés à l''Eternel, votre Dieu, vous êtes aujourd''hui tous vivants.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን የተከተላችሁ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ሁላችሁ በሕይወት ትኖራላችሁ።

verses.en: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the Lord my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.
verses.fr: Voici, je vous ai enseigné des lois et des ordonnances, comme l''Eternel, mon Dieu, me l''a commandé, afin que vous les mettiez en pratique dans le pays dont vous allez prendre possession.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እናንተ ገብታችሁ በምትወርሱአት ምድር ውስጥ እንዲህ ታደርጉ ዘንድ አምላኬ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘኝ ሥርዓትንና ፍርድን አስተማርኋችሁ።

verses.en: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.
verses.fr: Vous les observerez et vous les mettrez en pratique; car ce sera là votre sagesse et votre intelligence aux yeux des peuples, qui entendront parler de toutes ces lois et qui diront: Cette grande nation est un peuple absolument sage et intelligent!
verses.am: ጠብቁአት አድርጉአትም፤ ይህችን ሥርዓት ሁሉ ሰምተው። በእውነት ይህ ታላቅ ሕዝብ ጠቢብና አስተዋይ ሕዝብ ነው በሚሉ በአሕዛብ ፊት ጥበባችሁና ማስተዋላችሁ ይህ ነውና፤

verses.en: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the Lord our God is in all things that we call upon him for?
verses.fr: Quelle est, en effet, la grande nation qui ait des dieux aussi proches que l''Eternel, notre Dieu, l''est de nous toutes les fois que nous l''invoquons?
verses.am: አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር በምንጠራው ጊዜ ሁሉ እንደሚቀርበን፥ አምላኩ ወደ እርሱ የቀረበው ታላቅ ሕዝብ ማን ነው?

verses.en: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
verses.fr: Et quelle est la grande nation qui ait des lois et des ordonnances justes, comme toute cette loi que je vous présente aujourd''hui?
verses.am: በዓይናችሁ ፊት ዛሬ እንደማኖራት እንደዚህች ሕግ ሁሉ ጽድቅ የሆነች ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ያለው ታላቅ ሕዝብ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons' sons;
verses.fr: Seulement, prends garde à toi et veille attentivement sur ton âme, tous les jours de ta vie, de peur que tu n''oublies les choses que tes yeux ont vues, et qu''elles ne sortent de ton coeur; enseigne-les à tes enfants et aux enfants de tes enfants.
verses.am: እናንተም ቀርባችሁ ከተራራው በታች ቆማችሁ ነበር፤ እስከ ሰማይም መካከል ድረስ አሳት በተራራው ላይ ይነድድ ነበር፤ ጨለማና ደመና ድቅድቅ ጨለማም ነበረ።

verses.en: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the Lord thy God in Horeb, when the Lord said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.
verses.fr: Souviens-toi du jour où tu te présentas devant l''Eternel, ton Dieu, à Horeb, lorsque l''Eternel me dit: Assemble auprès de moi le peuple! Je veux leur faire entendre mes paroles, afin qu''ils apprennent à me craindre tout le temps qu''ils vivront sur la terre; et afin qu''ils les enseignent à leurs enfants.
verses.am: እናንተም ቀርባችሁ ከተራራው በታች ቆማችሁ ነበር፤ እስከ ሰማይም መካከል ድረስ አሳት በተራራው ላይ ይነድድ ነበር፤ ጨለማና ደመና ድቅድቅ ጨለማም ነበረ።

verses.en: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.
verses.fr: Vous vous approchâtes et vous vous tîntes au pied de la montagne. La montagne était embrasée, et les flammes s''élevaient jusqu''au milieu du ciel. Il y avait des ténèbres, des nuées, de l''obscurité.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በእሳት ውስጥ ሆኖ ተናገራችሁ፤ የቃልን ድምፅ ሰማችሁ፥ መልክ ግን አላያችሁም፤ ድምፅን ብቻ ሰማችሁ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel vous parla du milieu du feu; vous entendîtes le son des paroles, mais vous ne vîtes point de figure, vous n''entendîtes qu''une voix.
verses.am: ታደርጉትም ዘንድ ያዘዛችሁን ቃል ኪዳን አሥሩን ቃላት ነገራችሁ፤ በሁለቱም በድንጋይ ጽላቶች ላይ ጻፋቸው።

verses.en: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.
verses.fr: Il publia son alliance, qu''il vous ordonna d''observer, les dix commandements; et il les écrivit sur deux tables de pierre.
verses.am: ትወርሱአት ዘንድ ተሻግራችሁ በምትገቡባት ምድር የምታደርጉአትን ሥርዓትና ፍርድ አስተምራችሁ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር በዚያን ጊዜ አዘዘኝ።

verses.en: And the Lord commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, l''Eternel me commanda de vous enseigner des lois et des ordonnances, afin que vous les mettiez en pratique dans le pays dont vous allez prendre possession.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በኮሬብ በእሳት ውስጥ ሆኖ በተናገራችሁ ጊዜ መልክ ከቶ አላያችሁምና እጅግ ተጠንቀቁ፤

verses.en: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the Lord spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:
verses.fr: Puisque vous n''avez vu aucune figure le jour où l''Eternel vous parla du milieu du feu, à Horeb, veillez attentivement sur vos âmes,
verses.am: እንዳትረክሱ፥ የተቀረጸውን ምስል የማናቸውንም ነገር ምሳሌ፥ በወንድ ወይም በሴት መልክ የተሠራውን፥

verses.en: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
verses.fr: de peur que vous ne vous corrompiez et que vous ne vous fassiez une image taillée, une représentation de quelque idole, la figure d''un homme ou d''une femme,
verses.am: በምድር ላይ ያለውን የእንስሳን ሁሉ ምሳሌ፥ በሰማይም በታች የሚበርረውን የወፍን ሁሉ ምሳሌ፥

verses.en: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,
verses.fr: la figure d''un animal qui soit sur la terre, la figure d''un oiseau qui vole dans les cieux,
verses.am: በምድርም ላይ የሚሽከረከረውን ሁሉ ምሳሌ፥ ከምድርም በታች በውኃ ውስጥ የሚኖረውን የዓሣን ሁሉ ምሳሌ እንዳታደርጉ፥

verses.en: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.fr: la figure d''une bête qui rampe sur le sol, la figure d''un poisson qui vive dans les eaux au-dessous de la terre.
verses.am: ዓይኖችህን ወደ ሰማይ አንሥተህ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከሰማይ ሁሉ በታች ላሉት አሕዛብ ሁሉ የሰጣቸውን ፀሐይንና ጨረቃን ከዋክብትንና የሰማይን ሠራዊት ሁሉ ባየህ ጊዜ፥ ሰግደህላቸው አምልከሃቸውም እንዳትስት ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.en: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the Lord thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.
verses.fr: Veille sur ton âme, de peur que, levant tes yeux vers le ciel, et voyant le soleil, la lune et les étoiles, toute l''armée des cieux, tu ne sois entraîné à te prosterner en leur présence et à leur rendre un culte: ce sont des choses que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, a données en partage à tous les peuples, sous le ciel tout entier.
verses.am: እናንተን ግን እንደ ዛሬው ሁሉ የርስቱ ሕዝብ ትሆኑለት ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ወስዶ ከብረት እቶን ከግብፅ አወጣችሁ።

verses.en: But the Lord hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.
verses.fr: Mais vous, l''Eternel vous a pris, et vous a fait sortir de la fournaise de fer de l''Egypte, afin que vous fussiez un peuple qui lui appartînt en propre, comme vous l''êtes aujourd''hui.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በእናንተ ምክንያት ተቈጣኝ፥ ዮርዳኖስንም እንዳልሻገር፥ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር ርስት አድርጎ ወደሚሰጥህ ወደ መልካሚቱ ምድር እንዳልገባ ማለ።

verses.en: Furthermore the Lord was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the Lord thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel s''irrita contre moi, à cause de vous; et il jura que je ne passerais point le Jourdain, et que je n''entrerais point dans le bon pays que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne en héritage.
verses.am: እኔ ግን በዚህች ምድር እሞታለሁ፥ ዮርዳኖስንም አልሻገርም፤ እናንተ ግን ትሻገራላችሁ፥ ያችንም መልካሚቱን ምድር ትወርሳላችሁ።

verses.en: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.
verses.fr: Je mourrai donc en ce pays-ci, je ne passerai point le Jourdain; mais vous le passerez, et vous posséderez ce bon pays.
verses.am: አምላካችሁም እግዚአብሔር ከእናንተ ጋር የተማማለውን ቃል ኪዳን እንዳትረሱ፥ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር የከለከለውን በማናቸውም ቅርጽ የተቀረጸውን ምስል እንዳታደርጉ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.en: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the Lord your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the Lord thy God hath forbidden thee.
verses.fr: Veillez sur vous, afin de ne point mettre en oubli l''alliance que l''Eternel, votre Dieu, a traitée avec vous, et de ne point vous faire d''image taillée, de représentation quelconque, que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''ait défendue.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር የሚበላ እሳት ቀናተኛም አምላክ ነውና።

verses.en: For the Lord thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel, ton Dieu, est un feu dévorant, un Dieu jaloux.
verses.am: ልጆችን የልጅ ልጆችንም፥ በወለዳችሁ ጊዜ በምድሪቱም ብዙ ዘመን በተቀመጣችሁ ጊዜ፥ በረከሳችሁም ጊዜ፥ በማናቸውም ቅርጽ የተቀረጸውን ምስል ባደረጋችሁ ጊዜ፥ ታስቈጡትም ዘንድ በአምላካችሁ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ የሆነውን ነገር በሠራችሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: When thou shalt beget children, and children's children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the Lord thy God, to provoke him to anger:
verses.fr: Lorsque tu auras des enfants, et des enfants de tes enfants, et que vous serez depuis longtemps dans le pays, si vous vous corrompez, si vous faites des images taillées, des représentations de quoi que ce soit, si vous faites ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel, votre Dieu, pour l''irriter, -
verses.am: ትወርሱአት ዘንድ ዮርዳኖስን ተሻግራችሁ ከምትገቡባት ምድር ፈጥናችሁ እንድትጠፉ እኔ ዛሬ ሰማይንና ምድርን በእናንተ አስመሰክራለሁ፤ ፈጽሞም ትጠፋላችሁ እንጂ ረጅም ዘመን አትቀመጡባትም።

verses.en: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
verses.fr: j''en prends aujourd''hui à témoin contre vous le ciel et la terre, -vous disparaîtrez par une mort rapide du pays dont vous allez prendre possession au delà du Jourdain, vous n''y prolongerez pas vos jours, car vous serez entièrement détruits.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በአሕዛብ መካከል ይበትናችኋል፥ እግዚአብሔር በውስጣቸው በሚያኖራችሁ በአሕዛብ መካከልም ጥቂቶች ሆናችሁ ትቀራላችሁ።

verses.en: And the Lord shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the Lord shall lead you.
verses.fr: L''Eternel vous dispersera parmi les peuples, et vous ne resterez qu''un petit nombre au milieu des nations où l''Eternel vous emmènera.
verses.am: በዚያም የማያዩትን የማይሰሙትንም የማይበሉትንም የማያሸቱትንም፥ በሰው እጅ ከእንጨትና ከድንጋይ የተሠሩትን አማልክት ታመልካላችሁ።

verses.en: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.fr: Et là, vous servirez des dieux, ouvrage de mains d''homme, du bois et de la pierre, qui ne peuvent ni voir, ni entendre, ni manger, ni sentir.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከዚያ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ትሻላችሁ፤ በልብህም ሁሉ በነፍስህም ሁሉ የፈለግኸው እንደ ሆነ ታገኘዋለህ።

verses.en: But if from thence thou shalt seek the Lord thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
verses.fr: C''est de là aussi que tu chercheras l''Eternel, ton Dieu, et que tu le trouveras, si tu le cherches de tout ton coeur et de toute ton âme.
verses.am: ይህም ሁሉ በደረሰብህ ጊዜ፥ ስትጨንቅ፥ በዘመኑ ፍጻሜ ወደ አምላክህ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ትመለሳለህ፥ ቃሉንም ትሰማለህ።

verses.en: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the Lord thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;
verses.fr: Au sein de ta détresse, toutes ces choses t''arriveront. Alors, dans la suite des temps, tu retourneras à l''Eternel, ton Dieu, et tu écouteras sa voix;
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር መሐሪ አምላክ ነውና አይተውህም፥ አያጠፋህምም፥ ለአባቶችህም የማለላቸውን ቃል ኪዳኑን አይረሳም።

verses.en: (For the Lord thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
verses.fr: car l''Eternel, ton Dieu, est un Dieu de miséricorde, qui ne t''abandonnera point et ne te détruira point: il n''oubliera pas l''alliance de tes pères, qu''il leur a jurée.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሰውን በምድር ላይ ከፈጠረው ጀምሮ፥ ከሰማይ ዳር እስከ ዳርቻዋ ድረስ ከቶ እንዲህ ያለ ታላቅ ነገር ወይም እንደ እርሱ ያለ ተሰምቶ እንደሆነ ከአንተ በፊት የነበረውን የቀደመውን ዘመን ጠይቅ።

verses.en: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?
verses.fr: Interroge les temps anciens qui t''ont précédé, depuis le jour où Dieu créa l''homme sur la terre, et d''une extrémité du ciel à l''autre: y eut-il jamais si grand événement, et a-t-on jamais ouï chose semblable?
verses.am: አንተ ከእሳት ውስጥ ሆኖ ሲናገር የእግዚአብሔርን ድምፅ እንደ ሰማህ፥ ሌላ ሕዝብ ሰምቶ በሕይወት ይኖራልን?

verses.en: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
verses.fr: Fut-il jamais un peuple qui entendît la voix de Dieu parlant du milieu du feu, comme tu l''as entendue, et qui soit demeuré vivant?
verses.am: አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር በዓይናችሁ ፊት በግብፅ ለእናንተ እንደ ሠራው ሁሉ፥ በፈተናና በተአምራት፥ በድንቅና በሰልፍ፥ በጸናች እጅና በተዘረጋ ክንድ በታላቅም ማስፈራት እግዚአብሔር ከሌላ ሕዝብ መካከል ገብቶ ለእርሱ ሕዝብን ይወስድ ዘንድ ሞክሮ ነበርን?

verses.en: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the Lord your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.fr: Fut-il jamais un dieu qui essayât de venir prendre à lui une nation du milieu d''une nation, par des épreuves, des signes, des miracles et des combats, à main forte et à bras étendu, et avec des prodiges de terreur, comme l''a fait pour vous l''Eternel, votre Dieu, en Egypte et sous vos yeux?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አምላክ እንደ ሆነ ታውቅ ዘንድ ይህ ለአንተ ተገለጠ፤ ከእርሱም ሌላ አምላክ የለም።

verses.en: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the Lord he is God; there is none else beside him.
verses.fr: Tu as été rendu témoin de ces choses, afin que tu reconnusses que l''Eternel est Dieu, qu''il n''y en a point d''autre.
verses.am: ያስተምርህ ዘንድ ከሰማይ ድምፁን አሰማህ፤ በምድርም ላይ ታላቁን እሳት አሳየህ፤ ከእሳትም ውስጥ ቃሉን ሰማህ።

verses.en: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.
verses.fr: Du ciel, il t''a fait entendre sa voix pour t''instruire; et, sur la terre, il t''a fait voir son grand feu, et tu as entendu ses paroles du milieu du feu.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እግዚአብሔር በላይ በሰማይ በታችም በምድር አምላክ እንደ ሆነ፥ ሌላም እንደሌለ ዛሬ እወቅ፥ በልብህም ያዝ።

verses.en: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;
verses.fr: Il a aimé tes pères, et il a choisi leur postérité après eux; il t''a fait lui-même sortir d''Egypte par sa grande puissance;
verses.am: እንግዲህ እግዚአብሔር በላይ በሰማይ በታችም በምድር አምላክ እንደ ሆነ፥ ሌላም እንደሌለ ዛሬ እወቅ፥ በልብህም ያዝ።

verses.en: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.
verses.fr: il a chassé devant toi des nations supérieures en nombre et en force, pour te faire entrer dans leur pays, pour t''en donner la possession, comme tu le vois aujourd''hui.
verses.am: ለአንተ ከአንተም በኋላ ለልጆችህ መልካም ይሆን ዘንድ፥ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም በሚሰጥህ ምድር ዕድሜህ ይረዝም ዘንድ፥ እኔ ዛሬ የማዝዝህን ሥርዓቱንና ትእዛዙን ጠብቅ።

verses.en: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the Lord he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.
verses.fr: Sache donc en ce jour, et retiens dans ton coeur que l''Eternel est Dieu, en haut dans le ciel et en bas sur la terre, et qu''il n''y en a point d''autre.
verses.am: ከተሞቹም ለሮቤል ነገድ በምድረ በዳ በደልዳላ ስፍራ ያለ ቦሶር፥ ለጋድም ነገድ በገለዓድ ያለ ራሞት፥ ለምናሴም ነገድ በባሳን ያለ ጎላን ነበሩ።

verses.en: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth, which the Lord thy God giveth thee, for ever.
verses.fr: Et observe ses lois et ses commandements que je te prescris aujourd''hui, afin que tu sois heureux, toi et tes enfants après toi, et que tu prolonges désormais tes jours dans le pays que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne.
verses.am: ከተሞቹም ለሮቤል ነገድ በምድረ በዳ በደልዳላ ስፍራ ያለ ቦሶር፥ ለጋድም ነገድ በገለዓድ ያለ ራሞት፥ ለምናሴም ነገድ በባሳን ያለ ጎላን ነበሩ።

verses.en: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.fr: Alors Moïse choisit trois villes de l''autre côté du Jourdain, à l''orient,
verses.am: ሙሴም በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ያኖራት ሕግ ይህች ናት፤

verses.en: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:
verses.fr: afin qu''elles servissent de refuge au meurtrier qui aurait involontairement tué son prochain, sans avoir été auparavant son ennemi, et afin qu''il pût sauver sa vie en s''enfuyant dans l''une de ces villes.
verses.am: የእርሱንና የባሳንን ንጉሥ የዐግን ምድር፥ በምሥራቅ በኩል በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ የነበሩትን የሁለቱን የአሞራውያንን ነገሥታት ምድር፥

verses.en: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.
verses.fr: C''étaient: Betser, dans le désert, dans la plaine, chez les Rubénites; Ramoth, en Galaad, chez les Gadites, et Golan, en Basan, chez les Manassites.
verses.am: የእርሱንና የባሳንን ንጉሥ የዐግን ምድር፥ በምሥራቅ በኩል በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ የነበሩትን የሁለቱን የአሞራውያንን ነገሥታት ምድር፥

verses.en: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:
verses.fr: C''est ici la loi que présenta Moïse aux enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: በአርኖን ወንዝ ዳር ካለችው ከአሮዔር ጀምሮ እስከ ሲዎን ተራራ እስከ አርሞንዔም ድረስ፥

verses.en: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt.
verses.fr: Voici les préceptes, les lois et les ordonnances que Moïse prescrivit aux enfants d''Israël, après leur sortie d''Egypte.
verses.am: በምሥራቅ በኩል በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ከፈስጋ ተራራ በታች ያለውን ዓረባ ሁሉ እስከ ዓረባ ባሕር ድረስ ወሰዱ።

verses.en: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Bethpeor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:
verses.fr: C''était de l''autre côté du Jourdain, dans la vallée, vis-à-vis de Beth-Peor, au pays de Sihon, roi des Amoréens, qui habitait à Hesbon, et qui fut battu par Moïse et les enfants d''Israël, après leur sortie d''Egypte.
verses.am: ፤ ሙሴና የእስራኤል ልጆች ከግብፅ ከወጡ በኋላ በመቱት፥ በሐሴቦን ተቀምጦ በነበረው በአሞራውያን ንጉሥ በሴዎን ምድር፥ በቤተ ፌጎር አንጻር ባለው ሸለቆ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ፥ ከግብፅ በወጡ ጊዜ ሙሴ ለእስራኤል ልጆች የተናገረው ምስክርና ሥርዓት ፍርድም ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.fr: Ils s''emparèrent de son pays et de celui d''Og, roi de Basan. Ces deux rois des Amoréens étaient de l''autre côté du Jourdain, à l''orient.
verses.am: ፤ የእርሱንና የባሳንን ንጉሥ የዐግን ምድር፥ በምሥራቅ በኩል በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ የነበሩትን የሁለቱን የአሞራውያንን ነገሥታት ምድር፥

verses.en: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,
verses.fr: Leur territoire s''étendait depuis Aroër sur les bords du torrent de l''Arnon jusqu''à la montagne de Sion qui est l''Hermon,
verses.am: ፤ በአርኖን ወንዝ ዳር ካለችው ከአሮዔር ጀምሮ እስከ ሲዎን ተራራ እስከ አርሞንዔም ድረስ፥

verses.en: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.
verses.fr: et il embrassait toute la plaine de l''autre côté du Jourdain, à l''orient, jusqu''à la mer de la plaine, au pied du Pisga.
verses.am: ፤ በምሥራቅ በኩል በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ከፈስጋ ተራራ በታች ያለውን ዓረባ ሁሉ እስከ ዓረባ ባሕር ድረስ ወሰዱ።

verses.en: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.
verses.fr: Moïse convoqua tout Israël, et leur dit: Ecoute, Israël, les lois et les ordonnances que je vous fais entendre aujourd''hui. Apprenez-les, et mettez-les soigneusement en pratique.
verses.am: ሙሴም እስራኤልን ሁሉ ጠርቶ አላቸው። እስራኤል ሆይ፥ እንድትማሩአት በማድረግም እንድትጠብቁአት ዛሬ በጆሮአችሁ የምናገራትን ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ስሙ።

verses.en: The Lord our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
verses.fr: L''Eternel, notre Dieu, a traité avec nous une alliance à Horeb.
verses.am: አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር በኮሬብ ከእኛ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ።

verses.en: The Lord made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.
verses.fr: Ce n''est point avec nos pères que l''Eternel a traité cette alliance; c''est avec nous, qui sommes ici aujourd''hui, tous vivants.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ዛሬ በዚህ በሕይወት ካለነው ከእኛ ከሁላችን ጋር እንጂ ከአባቶቻችን ጋር ይህችን ቃል ኪዳን አላደረገም።

verses.en: The Lord talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,
verses.fr: L''Eternel vous parla face à face sur la montagne, du milieu du feu.
verses.am: በተራራው ላይ በእሳት ውስጥ ሆኖ እግዚአብሔር ፊት ለፊት ተናገራችሁ።

verses.en: (I stood between the Lord and you at that time, to shew you the word of the Lord: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,
verses.fr: Je me tins alors entre l''Eternel et vous, pour vous annoncer la parole de l''Eternel; car vous aviez peur du feu, et vous ne montâtes point sur la montagne. Il dit:
verses.am: እኔ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እነግራችሁ ዘንድ በዚያን ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔርና በእናንተ መካከል ቆሜ ነበር፤ እናንተ በእሳቱ ምክንያት ፈርታችኋልና፥ ወደ ተራራውም አልወጣችሁምና። እርሱም አለ።

verses.en: I am the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.fr: Je suis l''Eternel, ton Dieu, qui t''ai fait sortir du pays d''Egypte, de la maison de servitude.
verses.am: ከግብፅ ምድር ከባርነት ቤት ያወጣሁህ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.en: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.
verses.fr: Tu n''auras point d''autres dieux devant ma face.
verses.am: ከእኔ በቀር ሌሎች አማልክት አይሁኑልህ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.fr: Tu ne te feras point d''image taillée, de représentation quelconque des choses qui sont en haut dans les cieux, qui sont en bas sur la terre, et qui sont dans les eaux plus bas que la terre.
verses.am: በላይ በሰማይ ካለው፥ በታችም በምድር ካለው፥ ከምድርም በታች በውኃ ካለው ነገር የማናቸውንም ምሳሌ የተቀረጸውንም ምስል ለአንተ አታድርግ፤

verses.en: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,
verses.fr: Tu ne te prosterneras point devant elles, et tu ne les serviras point; car moi, l''Eternel, ton Dieu, je suis un Dieu jaloux, qui punis l''iniquité des pères sur les enfants jusqu''à la troisième et à la quatrième génération de ceux qui me haïssent,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን የአምላክህን ስም በከንቱ አትጥራ፤ እግዚአብሔር ስሙን በከንቱ የሚጠራውን ከበደል አያነጻውምና።

verses.en: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.
verses.fr: et qui fais miséricorde jusqu''en mille générations à ceux qui m''aiment et qui gardent mes commandements.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን የአምላክህን ስም በከንቱ አትጥራ፤ እግዚአብሔር ስሙን በከንቱ የሚጠራውን ከበደል አያነጻውምና።

verses.en: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain: for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
verses.fr: Tu ne prendras point le nom de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, en vain; car l''Eternel ne laissera point impuni celui qui prendra son nom en vain.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ እንዳዘዘህ የሰንበትን ቀን ትቀድሰው ዘንድ ጠብቅ።

verses.en: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee.
verses.fr: Observe le jour du repos, pour le sanctifier, comme l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te l''a ordonné.
verses.am: ስድስት ቀን ሥራ ተግባርህንም ሁሉ አድርግ፥

verses.en: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:
verses.fr: Tu travailleras six jours, et tu feras tout ton ouvrage.
verses.am: ሰባተኛው ቀን ግን ለእግዚአብሔር አምላክህ ሰንበት ነው፤ አንተ እንደምታርፍ ሎሌህና ገረድህ ያርፉ ዘንድ፥ አንተ ወንድ ልጅህም ሴት ልጅህም ሎሌህም ገረድህም በሬህም አህያህም ከብትህም ሁሉ በደጆችህም ውስጥ ያለ እንግዳ በእርሱ ምንም ሥራ አትሥሩ።

verses.en: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.
verses.fr: Mais le septième jour est le jour du repos de l''Eternel, ton Dieu: tu ne feras aucun ouvrage, ni toi, ni ton fils, ni ta fille, ni ton serviteur, ni ta servante, ni ton boeuf, ni ton âne, ni aucune de tes bêtes, ni l''étranger qui est dans tes portes, afin que ton serviteur et ta servante se reposent comme toi.
verses.am: አንተም በግብፅ ባሪያ እንደ ነበርህ አስብ፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ በጸናች እጅና በተዘረጋ ክንድ ከዚያ አወጣህ፤ ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ የሰንበትን ቀን ትጠብቅ ዘንድ አዘዘህ።

verses.en: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the Lord thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the Lord thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.
verses.fr: Tu te souviendras que tu as été esclave au pays d''Egypte, et que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''en a fait sortir à main forte et à bras étendu: c''est pourquoi l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''a ordonné d''observer le jour du repos.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ እንዳዘዘህ አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ በሚሰጥህ ምድር ላይ ዕድሜህ እንዲረዝም፥ መልካምም እንዲሆንልህ።

verses.en: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.
verses.fr: Honore ton père et ta mère, comme l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te l''a ordonné, afin que tes jours se prolongent et que tu sois heureux dans le pays que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne.
verses.am: አትግደል።

verses.en: Thou shalt not kill.
verses.fr: Tu ne tueras point.
verses.am: አታመንዝር።

verses.en: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.
verses.fr: Tu ne commettras point d''adultère.
verses.am: አትስረቅ።

verses.en: Neither shalt thou steal.
verses.fr: Tu ne déroberas point.
verses.am: በባልንጀራህ ላይ በሐሰት አትመስክር።

verses.en: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.
verses.fr: Tu ne porteras point de faux témoignage contre ton prochain.
verses.am: የባልጀራህን ሚስት አትመኝ፤ የባልንጀራህንም ቤት እርሻውንም ሎሌውንም ገረዱንም በሬውንም አህያውንም፥ ከባልንጀራህ ገንዘብ ሁሉ ማናቸውንም አትመኝ።

verses.en: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour's wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour's house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour's.
verses.fr: Tu ne convoiteras point la femme de ton prochain; tu ne désireras point la maison de ton prochain, ni son champ, ni son serviteur, ni sa servante, ni son boeuf, ni son âne, ni aucune chose qui appartienne à ton prochain.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በተራራው ላይ በእሳትና በደመናው በጨለማውም ውስጥ ሆኖ በታላቅ ድምፅ እነዚህን ቃሎች ለጉባኤአችሁ ሁሉ ተናገረ፤ ምንም ምን አልጨመረም። በሁለቱም የድንጋይ ጽላቶች ላይ ጻፋቸው፥ ለእኔም ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: These words the Lord spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.
verses.fr: Telles sont les paroles que prononça l''Eternel à haute voix sur la montagne, du milieu du feu, des nuées et de l''obscurité, et qu''il adressa à toute votre assemblée, sans rien ajouter. Il les écrivit sur deux tables de pierre, qu''il me donna.
verses.am: ተራራው በእሳት ሲነድድ ከጨለማው ውስጥ ድምፁን በሰማችሁ ጊዜ፥ እናንተ፥ የነገዶቻችሁ አለቆች ሽማግሌዎቻችሁም፥ ወደ እኔ ቀረባችሁ፤

verses.en: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
verses.fr: Lorsque vous eûtes entendu la voix du milieu des ténèbres, et tandis que la montagne était toute en feu, vos chefs de tribus et vos anciens s''approchèrent tous de moi,
verses.am: አላችሁም። እነሆ፥ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ክብሩንና ታላቅነቱን አሳይቶናል፥ ከእሳቱም ውስጥ ድምፁን ሰምተናል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከሰው ጋር ሲነጋገር ሰውዮውም በሕይወት ሲኖር ዛሬ አይተናል።

verses.en: And ye said, Behold, the Lord our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.
verses.fr: et vous dîtes: Voici, l''Eternel, notre Dieu, nous a montré sa gloire et sa grandeur, et nous avons entendu sa voix du milieu du feu; aujourd''hui, nous avons vu que Dieu a parlé à des hommes, et qu''ils sont demeurés vivants.
verses.am: አሁን እንግዲህ ይህች ታላቂቱ እሳት ታቃጥለናለችና ለምን እንሞታለን? እኛ የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን ድምፅ ደግሞ ብንሰማ እንሞታለን።

verses.en: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the Lord our God any more, then we shall die.
verses.fr: Et maintenant pourquoi mourrions-nous? car ce grand feu nous dévorera; si nous continuons à entendre la voix de l''Eternel, notre Dieu, nous mourrons.
verses.am: ከሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ እኛ እንደ ሰማን በእሳት ውስጥ ሆኖ ሲናገር የሕያው አምላክን ድምፅ ሰምቶ በሕይወቱ የኖረ ማን ነው?

verses.en: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
verses.fr: Quel est l''homme, en effet, qui ait jamais entendu, comme nous, la voix du Dieu vivant parlant du milieu du feu, et qui soit demeuré vivant?
verses.am: አንተ ቅረብ፥ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር የሚለውን ሁሉ ስማ፤ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔርም ለአንተ የሚናገረውን ሁሉ ለእኛ ንገረን፤ እኛም ሰምተን እናደርገዋለን።

verses.en: Go thou near, and hear all that the Lord our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the Lord our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.
verses.fr: Approche, toi, et écoute tout ce que dira l''Eternel, notre Dieu; tu nous rapporteras toi-même tout ce que te dira l''Eternel, notre Dieu; nous l''écouterons, et nous le ferons.
verses.am: በተናገራችሁኝም ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር የእናንተን ቃል ጽምፅ ሰማ፤ እግዚአብሔርም አለኝ። ይህ ሕዝብ የተናገሩህን ቃል ድምፅ ሰምቼአለሁ፤ የተናገሩህ ሁሉ መልካም ነገር ነው።

verses.en: And the Lord heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the Lord said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.
verses.fr: L''Eternel entendit les paroles que vous m''adressâtes. Et l''Eternel me dit: J''ai entendu les paroles que ce peuple t''a adressées: tout ce qu''ils ont dit est bien.
verses.am: ለእነርሱም ለዘላለምም ለልጆቻቸው መልካም ይሆንላቸው ዘንድ፥ እንዲፈሩኝ ሁልጊዜም ትእዛዜን ሁሉ እንዲጠብቁ እንዲህ ያለ ልብ ምነው በሆነላቸው!

verses.en: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!
verses.fr: Oh! s''ils avaient toujours ce même coeur pour me craindre et pour observer tous mes commandements, afin qu''ils fussent heureux à jamais, eux et leurs enfants!
verses.am: ሄደህ። ወደ ድንኳናችሁ ተመለሱ በላቸው።

verses.en: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.
verses.fr: Va, dis-leur: Retournez dans vos tentes.
verses.am: አንተ ግን በዚህ በእኔ ዘንድ ቁም፥ ርስት አድርጌ በምሰጣቸውም ምድር ላይ ያደርጉአት ዘንድ የምታስተምራቸውን ትእዛዜንና ሥርዓቴን ፍርዴንም ሁሉ እነግርሃለሁ።

verses.en: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.
verses.fr: Mais toi, reste ici avec moi, et je te dirai tous les commandements, les lois et les ordonnances, que tu leur enseigneras, afin qu''ils les mettent en pratique dans le pays dont je leur donne la possession.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ እንዳዘዛችሁ ታደርጉ ዘንድ ጠብቁ፤ ከእርሱም ወደ ቀኝም ወደ ግራም ፈቀቅ አትበሉ።

verses.en: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the Lord your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.fr: Vous ferez avec soin ce que l''Eternel, votre Dieu, vous a ordonné; vous ne vous en détournerez ni à droite, ni à gauche.
verses.am: በሕይወት እንድትኖሩ፥ መልካምም እንዲሆንላችሁ፥ በምትወርሱአትም ምድር ዕድሜአችሁ እንዲረዝም፥ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ባዘዛችሁ መንገድ ሁሉ ሂዱ።

verses.en: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the Lord your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.
verses.fr: Vous suivrez entièrement la voie que l''Eternel, votre Dieu, vous a prescrite, afin que vous viviez et que vous soyez heureux, afin que vous prolongiez vos jours dans le pays dont vous aurez la possession.
verses.am: ፤ በሕይወት እንድትኖሩ፥ መልካምም እንዲሆንላችሁ፥ በምትወርሱአትም ምድር ዕድሜአችሁ እንዲረዝም፥ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ባዘዛችሁ መንገድ ሁሉ ሂዱ።
