verses.en: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the Lord your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:
verses.fr: Voici les commandements, les lois et les ordonnances que l''Eternel, votre Dieu, a commandé de vous enseigner, afin que vous les mettiez en pratique dans le pays dont vous allez prendre possession;
verses.am: አንተ ልጅህም የልጅ ልጅህም በዕድሜአችሁ

verses.en: That thou mightest fear the Lord thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son's son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.
verses.fr: afin que tu craignes l''Eternel, ton Dieu, en observant, tous les jours de ta vie, toi, ton fils, et le fils de ton fils, toutes ses lois et tous ses commandements que je te prescris, et afin que tes jours soient prolongés.
verses.am: ሁሉ ልትወርሱአት በምትገቡባት ምድር ታደርጉአት ዘንድ፥ አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን ፈርተህ እኔ ለአንተ ያዘዝሁትን ሥርዓቱንና ትእዛዙን ሁሉ ትጠብቅ ዘንድ፥ ዕድሜህም ይረዝም ዘንድ፥ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር እንዳስተምራችሁ ያዘዛት ትእዛዝና ሥርዓት ፍርድም ይህች ናት።

verses.en: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the Lord God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.
verses.fr: Tu les écouteras donc, Israël, et tu auras soin de les mettre en pratique, afin que tu sois heureux et que vous multipliiez beaucoup, comme te l''a dit l''Eternel, le Dieu de tes pères, en te promettant un pays où coulent le lait et le miel.
verses.am: እንግዲህ፥ እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ስማ፤ መልካምም እንዲሆንልህ፥ የአባቶችህም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረ ወተትና ማር በምታፈስሰው ምድር እጅግ እንድትበዛ፥ ታደርጋት ዘንድ ጠብቅ።

verses.en: Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God is one Lord:
verses.fr: Ecoute, Israël! l''Eternel, notre Dieu, est le seul Eternel.
verses.am: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ስማ፤ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር አንድ እግዚአብሔር ነው፤

verses.en: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
verses.fr: Tu aimeras l''Eternel, ton Dieu, de tout ton coeur, de toute ton âme et de toute ta force.
verses.am: አንተም አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን በፍጹም ልብህ በፍጹምም ነፍስህ በፍጹምም ኃይልህ ውደድ።

verses.en: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:
verses.fr: Et ces commandements, que je te donne aujourd''hui, seront dans ton coeur.
verses.am: እኔም ዛሬ አንተን የማዝዘውን ይህን ቃል በልብህ ያዝ።

verses.en: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verses.fr: Tu les inculqueras à tes enfants, et tu en parleras quand tu seras dans ta maison, quand tu iras en voyage, quand tu te coucheras et quand tu te lèveras.
verses.am: ለልጆችህም አስተምረው፥ በቤትህም ስትቀመጥ፥ በመንገድም ስትሄድ፥ ስትተኛም፥ ስትነሣም ተጫወተው።

verses.en: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.
verses.fr: Tu les lieras comme un signe sur tes mains, et ils seront comme des fronteaux entre tes yeux.
verses.am: በእጅህም ምልክት አድርገህ እሰረው፤ በዓይኖችህም መካከል እንደክታብ ይሁንልህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.
verses.fr: Tu les écriras sur les poteaux de ta maison et sur tes portes.
verses.am: በቤትህም መቃኖች በደጃፍህም በሮች ላይ ጻፈው።

verses.en: And it shall be, when the Lord thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,
verses.fr: L''Eternel, ton Dieu, te fera entrer dans le pays qu''il a juré à tes pères, à Abraham, à Isaac et à Jacob, de te donner. Tu posséderas de grandes et bonnes villes que tu n''as point bâties,
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ለአንተ ሊሰጣት ለአባቶችህ ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም ወደ ማለላቸው ምድር ባገባህ ጊዜ፤ ያልሠራሃቸውንም ታላቅና መልካም ከተሞች፥

verses.en: And houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;
verses.fr: des maisons qui sont pleines de toutes sortes de biens et que tu n''as point remplies, des citernes creusées que tu n''as point creusées, des vignes et des oliviers que tu n''as point plantés. Lorsque tu mangeras et te rassasieras,
verses.am: ያልሞላሃቸውንም ሀብትን የሞሉ ቤቶች፥ ያልማስሃቸውንም የተማሱ ጕድጓዶች፥ ያልተከልሃቸውንም ወይንና ወይራ በሰጠህ ጊዜ፥ በበላህና በጠገብህም ጊዜ፤

verses.en: Then beware lest thou forget the Lord, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.fr: garde-toi d''oublier l''Eternel, qui t''a fait sortir du pays d''Egypte, de la maison de servitude.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ከግብፅ ምድር ከባርነት ቤት ያወጣህን እግዚአብሔርን እንዳትረሳ ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.en: Thou shalt fear the Lord thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.
verses.fr: Tu craindras l''Eternel, ton Dieu, tu le serviras, et tu jureras par son nom.
verses.am: አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን ፍራ፤ እርሱንም አምልክ፤ በስሙም ማል።

verses.en: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;
verses.fr: Vous n''irez point après d''autres dieux, d''entre les dieux des peuples qui sont autour de vous;
verses.am: በማሳህ እንደ ፈተናችሁት አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን አትፈታተኑት።

verses.en: (For the Lord thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the Lord thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.
verses.fr: car l''Eternel, ton Dieu, est un Dieu jaloux au milieu de toi. La colère de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, s''enflammerait contre toi, et il t''exterminerait de dessus la terre.
verses.am: በማሳህ እንደ ፈተናችሁት አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን አትፈታተኑት።

verses.en: Ye shall not tempt the Lord your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.
verses.fr: Vous ne tenterez point l''Eternel, votre Dieu, comme vous l''avez tenté à Massa.
verses.am: ለእናንተ ያዘዘውን የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ምስክሩንም ሥርዓቱንም አጥብቃችሁ ጠብቁ።

verses.en: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the Lord your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.
verses.fr: Mais vous observerez les commandements de l''Eternel, votre Dieu, ses ordonnances et ses lois qu''il vous a prescrites.
verses.am: በኋለኛው ዘመንም ልጅህ። አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ያዘዛችሁ ምስክርና ሥርዓት ፍርድስ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ በጠየቀህ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the Lord: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the Lord sware unto thy fathers.
verses.fr: Tu feras ce qui est droit et ce qui est bien aux yeux de l''Eternel, afin que tu sois heureux, et que tu entres en possession du bon pays que l''Eternel a juré à tes pères de te donner,
verses.am: በኋለኛው ዘመንም ልጅህ። አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ያዘዛችሁ ምስክርና ሥርዓት ፍርድስ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ በጠየቀህ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the Lord hath spoken.
verses.fr: après qu''il aura chassé tous tes ennemis devant toi, comme l''Eternel l''a dit.
verses.am: አንተ ልጅህን በለው። በግብፅ የፈርዖን ባሪያዎች ነበርን፤ እግዚአብሔርም በጽኑ እጅ ከግብፅ አወጣን፤

verses.en: And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the Lord our God hath commanded you?
verses.fr: Lorsque ton fils te demandera un jour: Que signifient ces préceptes, ces lois et ces ordonnances, que l''Eternel, notre Dieu, vous a prescrits?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከግብፅና በፈርዖን በቤቱም ሁሉ ላይ እኛ እያየን ታላቅና ክፉ ምልክት ተአምራትም አደረገ።

verses.en: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh's bondmen in Egypt; and the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:
verses.fr: tu diras à ton fils: Nous étions esclaves de Pharaon en Egypte, et l''Eternel nous a fait sortir de l''Egypte par sa main puissante.
verses.am: ለአባቶቻችን ወደ ማለላቸው ምድር አግብቶ እርስዋን ይሰጠን ዘንድ ከዚያ አወጣን።

verses.en: And the Lord shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:
verses.fr: L''Eternel a opéré, sous nos yeux, des miracles et des prodiges, grands et désastreux, contre l''Egypte, contre Pharaon et contre toute sa maison;
verses.am: እንደ ዛሬም በሕይወት እንዲያኖረን፥ ሁልጊዜም መልካም እንዲሆንልን፥ አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን እንፈራ ዘንድ፥ ይህችንም ሥርዓት ሁሉ እናደርግ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር አዘዘን።

verses.en: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.
verses.fr: et il nous a fait sortir de là, pour nous amener dans le pays qu''il avait juré à nos pères de nous donner.
verses.am: እርሱም እንዳዘዘን በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እናደርጋት ዘንድ ይህችን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ብንጠብቅ ለእኛ ጽድቅ ይሆንልናል።

verses.en: And the Lord commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the Lord our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.
verses.fr: L''Eternel nous a commandé de mettre en pratique toutes ces lois, et de craindre l''Eternel, notre Dieu, afin que nous fussions toujours heureux, et qu''il nous conservât la vie, comme il le fait aujourd''hui.
verses.am: ፤ እንደ ዛሬም በሕይወት እንዲያኖረን፥ ሁልጊዜም መልካም እንዲሆንልን፥ አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን እንፈራ ዘንድ፥ ይህችንም ሥርዓት ሁሉ እናደርግ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር አዘዘን።

verses.en: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the Lord our God, as he hath commanded us.
verses.fr: Nous aurons la justice en partage, si nous mettons soigneusement en pratique tous ces commandements devant l''Eternel, notre Dieu, comme il nous l''a ordonné.
verses.am: ፤ እርሱም እንዳዘዘን በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እናደርጋት ዘንድ ይህችን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ብንጠብቅ ለእኛ ጽድቅ ይሆንልናል።

verses.en: When the Lord thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;
verses.fr: Lorsque l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''aura fait entrer dans le pays dont tu vas prendre possession, et qu''il chassera devant toi beaucoup de nations, les Héthiens, les Guirgasiens, les Amoréens, les Cananéens, les Phéréziens, les Héviens et les Jébusiens, sept nations plus nombreuses et plus puissantes que toi;
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ልትወርሳት ወደምትገባባት ምድር ባመጣህ ጊዜ፥ ከፊትህም ብዙ አሕዛብን፥ ከአንተ የበለጡትን የበረቱትንም ሰባቱን አሕዛብ፥ ኬጢያዊውን ጌርጌሳዊውንም አሞራዊውንም ከነዓናዊውንም ፌርዛዊውንም ኤዊያዊውንም ኢያቡሳዊውንም ባወጣ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: And when the Lord thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:
verses.fr: lorsque l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te les aura livrées et que tu les auras battues, tu les dévoueras par interdit, tu ne traiteras point d''alliance avec elles, et tu ne leur feras point grâce.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔርም በእጅህ አሳልፎ በሰጣቸው በመታሃቸውም ጊዜ፥ ፈጽመህ አጥፋቸው፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አታድርግ፥ አትማራቸውም፤

verses.en: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.
verses.fr: Tu ne contracteras point de mariage avec ces peuples, tu ne donneras point tes filles à leurs fils, et tu ne prendras point leurs filles pour tes fils;
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ጋር አትጋባ፤ ሴት ልጅህን ለወንድ ልጁ አትስጥ፥ ሴት ልጁንም ለወንድ ልጅህ አትውሰድ።

verses.en: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the Lord be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.
verses.fr: car ils détourneraient de moi tes fils, qui serviraient d''autres dieux, et la colère de l''Eternel s''enflammerait contre vous: il te détruirait promptement.
verses.am: እንዳይከተለኝ ሌሎችንም አማልክት እንዲያመልክ ልጅህን ያስታልና፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ ይነድድባችኋል፥ ፈጥኖም ያጠፋችኋል።

verses.en: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.
verses.fr: Voici, au contraire, comment vous agirez à leur égard: vous renverserez leurs autels, vous briserez leurs statues, vous abattrez leurs idoles, et vous brûlerez au feu leurs images taillées.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እንዲህ አድርጉባቸው፤ መሠዊያቸውን አፍርሱ፥ ሐውልቶቻቸውንም ሰባብሩ፥ የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶቻቸውንም ቍረጡ፥ የተቀረጸውን ምስላቸውንም በእሳት አቃጥሉ።

verses.en: For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God: the Lord thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.fr: Car tu es un peuple saint pour l''Eternel, ton Dieu; l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''a choisi, pour que tu fusses un peuple qui lui appartînt entre tous les peuples qui sont sur la face de la terre.
verses.am: ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር አንተ ቅዱስ ሕዝብ ነህና፤ በምድር ፊት ከሚኖሩ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ይልቅ ለእርሱ ለራሱ ሕዝብ ትሆንለት ዘንድ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር መረጠህ።

verses.en: The Lord did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:
verses.fr: Ce n''est point parce que vous surpassez en nombre tous les peuples, que l''Eternel s''est attaché à vous et qu''il vous a choisis, car vous êtes le moindre de tous les peuples.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የወደዳችሁና የመረጣችሁ ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ በቍጥር ስለ በዛችሁ አይደለም፤ እናንተ ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ በቍጥር ጥቂቶች ነበራችሁና፤

verses.en: But because the Lord loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the Lord brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.fr: Mais, parce que l''Eternel vous aime, parce qu''il a voulu tenir le serment qu''il avait fait à vos pères, l''Eternel vous a fait sortir par sa main puissante, vous a délivrés de la maison de servitude, de la main de Pharaon, roi d''Egypte.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ስለ ወደዳችሁ ለአባቶቻችሁም የማለላቸውን መሐላ ስለ ጠበቀ፥ ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር በጽኑ እጅ አወጣችሁ፥ ከባርነትም ቤት ከግብፅ ንጉሥ ከፈርዖን እጅ አዳናችሁ።

verses.en: Know therefore that the Lord thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
verses.fr: Sache donc que c''est l''Eternel, ton Dieu, qui est Dieu. Ce Dieu fidèle garde son alliance et sa miséricorde jusqu''à la millième génération envers ceux qui l''aiment et qui observent ses commandements.
verses.am: አንተም አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር እርሱ አምላክ እንደ ሆነ፥ ለሚወድዱትም ትእዛዙንም ለሚጠብቁ ቃል ኪዳኑንና ምሕረቱን እስከ ሺህ ትውልድ ድረስ የሚጠብቅ የታመነ አምላክ እንደ ሆነ እወቅ፤

verses.en: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.
verses.fr: Mais il use directement de représailles envers ceux qui le haïssent, et il les fait périr; il ne diffère point envers celui qui le hait, il use directement de représailles.
verses.am: የሚጠሉትን ለማጥፋት በፊታቸው ብድራት ይመልስባቸዋል፤ ለሚጠላው አይዘገይም፥ ነገር ግን በፊቱ ብድራት ይመልስበታል።

verses.en: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.
verses.fr: Ainsi, observe les commandements, les lois et les ordonnances que je te prescris aujourd''hui, et mets-les en pratique.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ታደርጋት ዘንድ እኔ ዛሬ ለአንተ የማዝዛትን ትእዛዝና ሥርዓት ፍርድንም ጠብቅ።

verses.en: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the Lord thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:
verses.fr: Si vous écoutez ces ordonnances, si vous les observez et les mettez en pratique, l''Eternel, ton Dieu, gardera envers toi l''alliance et la miséricorde qu''il a jurées à tes pères.
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ ይህችን ፍርድ ሰምተህ ብትጠብቃት ብታደርጋትም፥ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ለአባቶችህ የማለውን ቃል ኪዳንና ምሕረት ለአንተ ይጠብቅልሃል፤

verses.en: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
verses.fr: Il t''aimera, il te bénira et te multipliera; il bénira le fruit de tes entrailles et le fruit de ton sol, ton blé, ton moût et ton huile, les portées de ton gros et de ton menu bétail, dans le pays qu''il a juré à tes pères de te donner.
verses.am: ይወድድህማል፥ ይባርክህማል፥ ያበዛህማል፤ ይሰጥህም ዘንድ ለአባቶችህ በማለላቸው ምድር የሆድህን ፍሬ የመሬትህንም ፍሬ፥ እህልህን ወይንህንም ዘይትህንም፥ የከብትህንም ብዛት የበግህንም መንጋ ይባርክልሃል።

verses.en: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.
verses.fr: Tu seras béni plus que tous les peuples; il n''y aura chez toi ni homme ni femme stérile, ni bête stérile parmi tes troupeaux.
verses.am: ከአሕዛብም ሁሉ ይልቅ የተባረክህ ትሆናለህ፤ በሰውህና በከብትህም ዘንድ ወንድ ቢሆን ወይም ሴት ብትሆን መካን አይሆንብህም።

verses.en: And the Lord will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.
verses.fr: L''Eternel éloignera de toi toute maladie; il ne t''enverra aucune de ces mauvaises maladies d''Egypte qui te sont connues, mais il en frappera tous ceux qui te haïssent.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሕማምን ሁሉ ከአንተ ያርቃል፤ የምታውቀውንም ክፉውን የግብፅ በሽታ ሁሉ በአንተ ላይ አያደርስብህም፥ በጠላቶችህም ሁሉ ላይ ያመጣባቸዋል።

verses.en: And thou shalt consume all the people which the Lord thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.
verses.fr: Tu dévoreras tous les peuples que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, va te livrer, tu ne jetteras pas sur eux un regard de pitié, et tu ne serviras point leurs dieux, car ce serait un piège pour toi.
verses.am: አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር በእጅህ አሳልፎ የሚጥላቸውን አሕዛብን ሁሉ ታጠፋቸዋለህ፤ ዓይንህም አታዝንላቸውም፤ ያም ወጥመድ ይሆንብሃልና አማልክቶቻቸውን አታምልካቸው።

verses.en: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?
verses.fr: Peut-être diras-tu dans ton coeur: Ces nations sont plus nombreuses que moi; comment pourrai-je les chasser?
verses.am: በልብህም። እነዚህ አሕዛብ ከእኔ ይልቅ ይበዛሉና አወጣቸው ዘንድ እንዴት እችላለሁ? ብትል፥ አትፍራቸው፤

verses.en: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: but shalt well remember what the Lord thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;
verses.fr: Ne les crains point. Rappelle à ton souvenir ce que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, a fait à Pharaon et à toute l''Egypte,
verses.am: ነገር ግን አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በፈርዖንና በግብፅ ሁሉ ያደረገውን፥

verses.en: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the Lord thy God brought thee out: so shall the Lord thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.
verses.fr: les grandes épreuves que tes yeux ont vues, les miracles et les prodiges, la main forte et le bras étendu, quand l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''a fait sortir: ainsi fera l''Eternel, ton Dieu, à tous les peuples que tu redoutes.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር፥ ዓይንህ እያየች፥ ታላቅን መቅሠፍት ምልክትንም ተአምራትንም የጸናችውን እጅ የተዘረጋውንም ክንድ አድርጎ እንዳወጣህ፥ አስብ፤ እንዲሁ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር አንተ በምትፈራቸው በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ ያደርጋል።

verses.en: Moreover the Lord thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.
verses.fr: L''Eternel, ton Dieu, enverra même les frelons contre eux, jusqu''à la destruction de ceux qui échapperont et qui se cacheront devant toi.
verses.am: ደግሞም አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር የቀሩት ከፊትህም የተሸሸጉት እስኪጠፉ ድረስ ተርብ ይሰድድባቸዋል።

verses.en: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the Lord thy God is among you, a mighty God and terrible.
verses.fr: Ne sois point effrayé à cause d''eux; car l''Eternel, ton Dieu, est au milieu de toi, le Dieu grand et terrible.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር፥ ታላቅና የሚያስፈራ አምላክ፥ በመካከልህ ነውና ከእነርሱ የተነሣ አትደንግጥ።

verses.en: And the Lord thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.
verses.fr: L''Eternel, ton Dieu, chassera peu à peu ces nations loin de ta face; tu ne pourras pas les exterminer promptement, de peur que les bêtes des champs ne se multiplient contre toi.
verses.am: አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር እነዚህን አሕዛብ በጥቂት በጥቂቱ ከፊትህ ያወጣቸዋል፤ የምድረ በዳ አራዊት እንዳይበዙብህ አንድ ጊዜ ታጠፋቸው ዘንድ አይገባህም።

verses.en: But the Lord thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.
verses.fr: L''Eternel, ton Dieu, te les livrera; et il les mettra complètement en déroute, jusqu''à ce qu''elles soient détruites.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ግን እነርሱን በእጅህ አሳልፎ ይሰጣቸዋል፥ እስኪጠፉም ድረስ በታላቅ ድንጋጤ ያስደነግጣቸዋል።

verses.en: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.
verses.fr: Il livrera leurs rois entre tes mains, et tu feras disparaître leurs noms de dessous les cieux; aucun ne tiendra contre toi, jusqu''à ce que tu les aies détruits.
verses.am: ነገሥታቶቻቸውንም በእጅህ አሳልፎ ይሰጣቸዋል፥ ስማቸውንም ከሰማይ በታች ታጠፋለህ፤ እስክታጠፋቸው ድረስ ማንም በፊትህ ይቆም ዘንድ አይችልም።

verses.en: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therin: for it is an abomination to the Lord thy God.
verses.fr: Vous brûlerez au feu les images taillées de leurs dieux. Tu ne convoiteras point et tu ne prendras point pour toi l''argent et l''or qui sont sur elles, de peur que ces choses ne te deviennent un piège; car elles sont en abomination à l''Eternel, ton Dieu.
verses.am: የተቀረጸውንም የአምላኮቻቸውን ምስል በእሳት ታቃጥላለህ፤ የተሠራባቸውን ብርና ወርቅ አትመኝ፤ በአምላክህም በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ርኩስ ነውና እንዳትጠመድበት ከእርሱ ምንም አትውሰድ።

verses.en: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.
verses.fr: Tu n''introduiras point une chose abominable dans ta maison, afin que tu ne sois pas, comme cette chose, dévoué par interdit; tu l''auras en horreur, tu l''auras en abomination, car c''est une chose dévouée par interdit.
verses.am: እንደ እርሱም ርጉም እንዳትሆን ርኩስን ነገር ወደ ቤትህ አታግባ፤ ርጉም ነውና ተጸየፈው፥ ጥላውም።

verses.en: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the Lord sware unto your fathers.
verses.fr: Vous observerez et vous mettrez en pratique tous les commandements que je vous prescris aujourd''hui, afin que vous viviez, que vous multipliiez, et que vous entriez en possession du pays que l''Eternel a juré de donner à vos pères.
verses.am: በሕይወት እንድትኖሩ፥ እንድትበዙም፥ እግዚአብሔርም ለአባቶቻችሁ ወደ ማለላቸው ምድር ገብታችሁ እንድትወርሱአት፥ ዛሬ ለአንተ የማዝዘውን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ታደርጉ ዘንድ ጠብቁ።

verses.en: And thou shalt remember all the way which the Lord thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.
verses.fr: Souviens-toi de tout le chemin que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''a fait faire pendant ces quarante années dans le désert, afin de t''humilier et de t''éprouver, pour savoir quelles étaient les dispositions de ton coeur et si tu garderais ou non ses commandements.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ይፈትንህ ዘንድ፥ በልብህም ያለውን ትእዛዙን ትጠብቅ ወይም አትጠብቅ እንደሆነ ያውቅ ዘንድ፥ ሊያስጨንቅህ በእነዚህ በአርባ ዓመታት በምድረ በዳ የመራህን መንገድ ሁሉ አስብ።

verses.en: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the Lord doth man live.
verses.fr: Il t''a humilié, il t''a fait souffrir de la faim, et il t''a nourri de la manne, que tu ne connaissais pas et que n''avaient pas connue tes pères, afin de t''apprendre que l''homme ne vit pas de pain seulement, mais que l''homme vit de tout ce qui sort de la bouche de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሰውም ከእግዚአብሔር አፍ በሚወጣ ነገር ሁሉ በሕይወት እንዲኖር እንጂ ሰው በእንጀራ ብቻ በሕይወት እንዳይኖር ያስታውቅህ ዘንድ አስጨነቀህ፥ አስራበህም፥ አንተም ያላወቅኸውን አባቶችህም ያላወቁትን መና አበላህ።

verses.en: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.
verses.fr: Ton vêtement ne s''est point usé sur toi, et ton pied ne s''est point enflé, pendant ces quarante années.
verses.am: በእነዚህ አርባ ዓመታት የለበስኸው ልብስ አላረጀም፥ እግርህም አላበጠም።

verses.en: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the Lord thy God chasteneth thee.
verses.fr: Reconnais en ton coeur que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te châtie comme un homme châtie son enfant.
verses.am: ሰውም ልጁን እንደሚገሥፅ እንዲሁም አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር አንተን እንዲገሥጽ በልብህ አስተውል።

verses.en: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
verses.fr: Tu observeras les commandements de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, pour marcher dans ses voies et pour le craindre.
verses.am: በመንገዱም እንድትሄድ እርሱንም እንድትፈራ የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ጠብቅ።

verses.en: For the Lord thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel, ton Dieu, va te faire entrer dans un bon pays, pays de cours d''eaux, de sources et de lacs, qui jaillissent dans les vallées et dans les montagnes;
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ወደ መልካም ምድር፥ ከሸለቆና ከኮረብታ የሚመነጩ የውኃ ጅረቶችና ፈሳሾች ምንጮችም ወዳሉባት ምድር፥

verses.en: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;
verses.fr: pays de froment, d''orge, de vignes, de figuiers et de grenadiers; pays d''oliviers et de miel;
verses.am: ስንዴ ገብስም ወይንም በለስም ሮማንም ወይራም ማርም ወደ ሞሉባት ምድር፥

verses.en: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.
verses.fr: pays où tu mangeras du pain avec abondance, où tu ne manqueras de rien; pays dont les pierres sont du fer, et des montagnes duquel tu tailleras l''airain.
verses.am: ሳይጎድልህ እንጀራን ወደምትበላባት አንዳችም ወደማታጣባት ምድር፥ ድንጋይዋ ብረት ወደ ሆነ፥ ከተራራዋም መዳብ ወደሚማስባት ምድር ያገባሃል።

verses.en: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the Lord thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
verses.fr: Lorsque tu mangeras et te rassasieras, tu béniras l''Eternel, ton Dieu, pour le bon pays qu''il t''a donné.
verses.am: ትበላማለህ፥ ትጠግብማለህ፥ ስለሰጠህም ስለመልካሚቱ ምድር አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን ትባርካለህ።

verses.en: Beware that thou forget not the Lord thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:
verses.fr: Garde-toi d''oublier l''Eternel, ton Dieu, au point de ne pas observer ses commandements, ses ordonnances et ses lois, que je te prescris aujourd''hui.
verses.am: ዛሬ እኔ አንተን የማዝዘውን ትእዛዙንና ፍርዱን ሥርዓቱንም ባለመጠበቅ አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን እንዳትረሳ ተጠንቀቅ፤

verses.en: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;
verses.fr: Lorsque tu mangeras et te rassasieras, lorsque tu bâtiras et habiteras de belles maisons,
verses.am: ከበላህና ከጠገብህ በኋላ፥ መልካምም ቤት ሠርተህ ከተቀመጥህበት በኋላ፥

verses.en: And when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;
verses.fr: lorsque tu verras multiplier ton gros et ton menu bétail, s''augmenter ton argent et ton or, et s''accroître tout ce qui est à toi,
verses.am: የላምና የበግ መንጋ ከበዛልህ በኋላ፥ ብርህና ወርቅህም ያለህም ሁሉ ከበዛልህ በኋላ፥ ልብህ እንዳይጓደድ፤

verses.en: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the Lord thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;
verses.fr: prends garde que ton coeur ne s''enfle, et que tu n''oublies l''Eternel, ton Dieu, qui t''a fait sortir du pays d''Egypte, de la maison de servitude,
verses.am: ከግብፅም ምድር ከባርነት ቤት ያወጣህን፥

verses.en: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;
verses.fr: qui t''a fait marcher dans ce grand et affreux désert, où il y a des serpents brûlants et des scorpions, dans des lieux arides et sans eau, et qui a fait jaillir pour toi de l''eau du rocher le plus dur,
verses.am: እባብና ጊንጥ ጥማትም ባለባት፥ ውኃም በሌለባት፥ በታላቂቱና በምታስፈራው ምድረ በዳ የመራህን፥ ከጭንጫ ድንጋይም ውኃን ያወጣልህን፥

verses.en: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;
verses.fr: qui t''a fait manger dans le désert la manne inconnue à tes pères, afin de t''humilier et de t''éprouver, pour te faire ensuite du bien.
verses.am: በመጨረሻም ዘመን መልካም ያደርግልህ ዘንድ ሊፈትንህ ሊያዋርድህም አባቶችህ ያላወቁትን መና በምድረ በዳ ያበላህን አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን እንዳትረሳ፤

verses.en: And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.
verses.fr: Garde-toi de dire en ton coeur: Ma force et la puissance de ma main m''ont acquis ces richesses.
verses.am: በልብህም። ጉልበቴ የእጄም ብርታት ይህን ሀብት አመጣልኝ እንዳትል።

verses.en: But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.
verses.fr: Souviens-toi de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, car c''est lui qui te donnera de la force pour les acquérir, afin de confirmer, comme il le fait aujourd''hui, son alliance qu''il a jurée à tes pères.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ዛሬ እንደ ሆነ ለአባቶችህ የማለውን ቃል ኪዳን ያጸና ዘንድ፥ ሀብት ለማከማቸት እርሱ ጉልበት ሰጥቶሃልና አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን አስብ።

verses.en: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the Lord thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.
verses.fr: Si tu oublies l''Eternel, ton Dieu, et que tu ailles après d''autres dieux, si tu les sers et te prosternes devant eux, je vous déclare formellement aujourd''hui que vous périrez.
verses.am: አምላክህንም እግዚአብሔርን ብትረሳ፥ ሌሎችንም አማልክት ብትከተል ብታመልካቸውም ብትሰግድላቸውም፥ ፈጽሞ እንድትጠፉ እኔ ዛሬውኑ እመሰክርባችኋለሁ።

verses.en: As the nations which the Lord destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the Lord your God.
verses.fr: Vous périrez comme les nations que l''Eternel fait périr devant vous, parce que vous n''aurez point écouté la voix de l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስላልሰማችሁ እግዚአብሔር ከፊታችሁ እንደሚያጠፋቸው እንደ አሕዛብ እንዲሁ እናንተ ትጠፋላችሁ።

verses.en: Hear, O Israel: Thou art to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,
verses.fr: Ecoute, Israël! Tu vas aujourd''hui passer le Jourdain, pour te rendre maître de nations plus grandes et plus puissantes que toi, de villes grandes et fortifiées jusqu''au ciel,
verses.am: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ስማ፤ ከአንተ የበለጡትንና የበረቱትን አሕዛብ፥ እስከ ሰማይም ድረስ የተመሸጉትን ታላላቆች ከተሞች ለመውረስ ትገቡ ዘንድ ዛሬ ዮርዳኖስን ትሻገረዋለህ።

verses.en: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom thou knowest, and of whom thou hast heard say, Who can stand before the children of Anak!
verses.fr: d''un peuple grand et de haute taille, les enfants d''Anak, que tu connais, et dont tu as entendu dire: Qui pourra tenir contre les enfants d''Anak?
verses.am: አንተም የምታውቃቸው ስለ እነርሱም። በዔናቅ ልጆች ፊት መቆም ማን ይችላል? ሲባል የሰማኸው ታላቁና ረጅሙ ሕዝብ የዔናቅ ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.en: Understand therefore this day, that the Lord thy God is he which goeth over before thee; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before thy face: so shalt thou drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as the Lord hath said unto thee.
verses.fr: Sache aujourd''hui que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, marchera lui-même devant toi comme un feu dévorant, c''est lui qui les détruira, qui les humiliera devant toi; et tu les chasseras, tu les feras périr promptement, comme l''Eternel te l''a dit.
verses.am: አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር እንደሚበላ እሳት ሆኖ በፊትህ እንዲያልፍ ዛሬ እወቅ፤ እርሱ ያጠፋቸዋል፥ በፊትህም ያዋርዳቸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ነገረህ አንተ ታሳድዳቸዋለህ፥ ፈጥነህም ታጠፋቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Speak not thou in thine heart, after that the Lord thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness the Lord hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the Lord doth drive them out from before thee.
verses.fr: Lorsque l''Eternel, ton Dieu, les chassera devant toi, ne dis pas en ton coeur: C''est à cause de ma justice que l''Eternel me fait entrer en possession de ce pays. Car c''est à cause de la méchanceté de ces nations que l''Eternel les chasse devant toi.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከፊትህ ካወጣቸው በኋላ። ስለ ጽድቄ እወርሳት ዘንድ ወደዚች ምድር እግዚአብሔር አገባኝ ስትል በልብህ አትናገር፤ እነዚህን አሕዛብ ስለ ኃጢአታቸው እግዚአብሔር ከፊትህ ያወጣቸዋል።

verses.en: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations the Lord thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which the Lord sware unto thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.fr: Non, ce n''est point à cause de ta justice et de la droiture de ton coeur que tu entres en possession de leur pays; mais c''est à cause de la méchanceté de ces nations que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, les chasse devant toi, et c''est pour confirmer la parole que l''Eternel a jurée à tes pères, à Abraham, à Isaac et à Jacob.
verses.am: ምድራቸውን ትወርሳት ዘንድ የምትገባው ስለ ጽድቅህና ስለ ልብህ ቅንነት አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከፊትህ በሚያጠፋቸው በእነዚያ አሕዛብ ኃጢአት ምክንያትና ለአባቶችህ ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም የማለላቸውን ቃል ይፈጽም ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: Understand therefore, that the Lord thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou art a stiffnecked people.
verses.fr: Sache donc que ce n''est point à cause de ta justice que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne ce bon pays pour que tu le possèdes; car tu es un peuple au cou roide.
verses.am: እንግዲህ አንተ አንገተ ደንዳና ሕዝብ ነህና አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ይህችን መልካም ምድር ርስት አድርጎ የሰጠህ ስለ ጽድቅህ እንዳይደለ እወቅ።

verses.en: Remember, and forget not, how thou provokedst the Lord thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against the Lord.
verses.fr: Souviens-toi, n''oublie pas de quelle manière tu as excité la colère de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, dans le désert. Depuis le jour où tu es sorti du pays d''Egypte jusqu''à votre arrivée dans ce lieu, vous avez été rebelles contre l''Eternel.
verses.am: አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን በምድረ በዳ እንዳስቈጣኸው፤ ከግብፅ አገር ከወጣህበት ቀን ጀምሮ ወደዚህ ስፍራ እስከ መጣችሁ ድረስ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ እንዳመፃችሁ አስብ፥ አትርሳ።

verses.en: Also in Horeb ye provoked the Lord to wrath, so that the Lord was angry with you to have destroyed you.
verses.fr: A Horeb, vous excitâtes la colère de l''Eternel; et l''Eternel s''irrita contre vous, et eut la pensée de vous détruire.
verses.am: በኮሬብ ደግሞ እግዚአብሔርን አስቈጣችሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሊያጠፋችሁ ተቈጣባችሁ።

verses.en: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which the Lord made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:
verses.fr: Lorsque je fus monté sur la montagne, pour prendre les tables de pierre, les tables de l''alliance que l''Eternel a traitée avec vous, je demeurai sur la montagne quarante jours et quarante nuits, sans manger de pain et sans boire d''eau;
verses.am: የድንጋዩን ጽላቶች፥ እግዚአብሔር ከእናንተ ጋር የተማማለባቸውን የቃል ኪዳን ጽላቶች፥ እቀበል ዘንድ ወደ ተራራ በወጣሁ ጊዜ፥ በተራራው አርባ ቀንና አርባ ሌሊት ተቀምጬ ነበር፤ እንጀራ አልበላሁም፥ ውኃም አልጠጣሁም።

verses.en: And the Lord delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them was written according to all the words, which the Lord spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.
verses.fr: et l''Eternel me donna les deux tables de pierre écrites du doigt de Dieu, et contenant toutes les paroles que l''Eternel vous avait dites sur la montagne, du milieu du feu, le jour de l''assemblée.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በእግዚአብሔር ጣት የተጻፋትን ሁለት የድንጋይ ጽላቶች ሰጠኝ፤ ስብሰባ ተደርጎ በነበረበትም ቀን እግዚአብሔር በተራራው ላይ በእሳት ውስጥ ሆኖ የነገራችሁ ቃል ሁሉ ተጽፎባቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that the Lord gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.
verses.fr: Ce fut au bout des quarante jours et des quarante nuits que l''Eternel me donna les deux tables de pierre, les tables de l''alliance.
verses.am: ከአርባ ቀንና ከአርባ ሌሊትም በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ሁለቱን የድንጋይ ጽላቶች፥ የቃል ኪዳኑን ጽላቶች፥ ሰጠኝ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit alors: Lève-toi, descends en hâte d''ici; car ton peuple, que tu as fait sortir d''Egypte, s''est corrompu. Ils se sont promptement écartés de la voie que je leur avais prescrite; ils se sont fait une image de fonte.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ተነሥተህ ከዚህ ፈጥነህ ውረድ፤ ከግብፅ ያወጣሃቸው ሕዝብህ ረክሰዋል፤ ፈጥነው ካዘዝኋቸው መንገድ ፈቀቅ ብለዋል፥ ቀልጦ የተሠራ ምስልም ለራሳቸው አድርገዋል አለኝ።

verses.en: Furthermore the Lord spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: Je vois que ce peuple est un peuple au cou roide.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ይህ ሕዝብ አንገተ ደንዳና ሕዝብ እንደሆነ አይቼአለሁ፤

verses.en: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.
verses.fr: Laisse-moi les détruire et effacer leur nom de dessous les cieux; et je ferai de toi une nation plus puissante et plus nombreuse que ce peuple.
verses.am: አጠፋቸው ዘንድ፥ ስማቸውንም ከሰማይ በታች እደመስስ ዘንድ ተወኝ፤ አንተንም ከእነርሱ ለሚበረታና ለሚበዛ ሕዝብ አደርግሃለሁ ብሎ ተናገረኝ።

verses.en: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.
verses.fr: Je retournai et je descendis de la montagne toute en feu, les deux tables de l''alliance dans mes deux mains.
verses.am: እኔም ተመልሼ ከተራራው ወረድሁ፥ ተራራውም በእሳት ይነድድ ነበር፤ ሁለቱም የቃል ኪዳን ጽላቶች በሁለቱ እጆቼ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against the Lord your God, and had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the Lord had commanded you.
verses.fr: Je regardai, et voici, vous aviez péché contre l''Eternel, votre Dieu, vous vous étiez fait un veau de fonte, vous vous étiez promptement écartés de la voie que vous avait prescrite l''Eternel.
verses.am: ተመለከትሁም፤ እነሆ፥ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን በድላችሁ ነበር፥ ለእናንተም ቀልጦ የተሠራ የጥጃ ምስል ሠርታችሁ ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔር ካዘዛችሁ መንገድ ፈጥናችሁ ፈቀቅ ብላችሁ ነበር።

verses.en: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.
verses.fr: Je saisis les deux tables, je les jetai de mes mains, et je les brisai sous vos yeux.
verses.am: ሁለቱንም ጽላቶች ያዝሁ፥ ከሁለቱም እጆቼ ጣልኋቸው፥ እናንተም ስታዩ ሰበርኋቸው።

verses.en: And I fell down before the Lord, as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which ye sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger.
verses.fr: Je me prosternai devant l''Eternel, comme auparavant, quarante jours et quarante nuits, sans manger de pain et sans boire d''eau, à cause de tous les péchés que vous aviez commis en faisant ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel, pour l''irriter.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አሮንን ሊያጠፋው እጅግ ተቈጣው፤ ስለ አሮንም ደግሞ በዚያን ጊዜ ጸለይሁ።

verses.en: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the Lord was wroth against you to destroy you. But the Lord hearkened unto me at that time also.
verses.fr: Car j''étais effrayé à la vue de la colère et de la fureur dont l''Eternel était animé contre vous jusqu''à vouloir vous détruire. Mais l''Eternel m''exauça encore cette fois.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አሮንን ሊያጠፋው እጅግ ተቈጣው፤ ስለ አሮንም ደግሞ በዚያን ጊዜ ጸለይሁ።

verses.en: And the Lord was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.
verses.fr: L''Eternel était aussi très irrité contre Aaron, qu''il voulait faire périr, et pour qui j''intercédai encore dans ce temps-là.
verses.am: ያደረጋችሁትንም ኃጢአት ጥጃውን ወሰድሁ፥ በእሳትም አቃጠልሁት፥ አደቀቅሁትም፥ እንደ ትቢያም እስኪሆን ድረስ ፈጨሁት፤ ትቢያውንም ከተራራ በሚወርድ ወንዝ ጣልሁት።

verses.en: And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, and ground it very small, even until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.
verses.fr: Je pris le veau que vous aviez fait, ce produit de votre péché, je le brûlai au feu, je le broyai jusqu''à ce qu''il fût réduit en poudre, et je jetai cette poudre dans le torrent qui descend de la montagne.
verses.am: በተቤራም በማሳህም በምኞት መቃብርም እግዚአብሔርን አስቈጣችሁት።

verses.en: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibrothhattaavah, ye provoked the Lord to wrath.
verses.fr: A Tabeéra, à Massa, et à Kibroth-Hattaava, vous excitâtes la colère de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ውጡ የሰጠኋችሁንም ምድር ውረሱ ብሎ ከቃዴስ በርኔ በላካችሁ ጊዜ፥ በአምላካችሁ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ዐመፃችሁ፥ በእርሱም አላመናችሁም፥ ድምፁንም አልሰማችሁም።

verses.en: Likewise when the Lord sent you from Kadeshbarnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the Lord your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.
verses.fr: Et lorsque l''Eternel vous envoya à Kadès-Barnéa, en disant: Montez, et prenez possession du pays que je vous donne! vous fûtes rebelles à l''ordre de l''Eternel, votre Dieu, vous n''eûtes point foi en lui, et vous n''obéîtes point à sa voix.
verses.am: እናንተን ካወቅሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ በእግዚአብሔር ዓመፀኞች ነበራችሁ።

verses.en: Ye have been rebellious against the Lord from the day that I knew you.
verses.fr: Vous avez été rebelles contre l''Eternel depuis que je vous connais.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። አጠፋችኋለሁ ብሎ ስለ ተናገረ በወደቅሁበት ዘመን አርባ ቀንና አርባ ሌሊት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወደቅሁ።

verses.en: Thus I fell down before the Lord forty days and forty nights, as I fell down at the first; because the Lord had said he would destroy you.
verses.fr: Je me prosternai devant l''Eternel, je me prosternai quarante jours et quarante nuits, parce que l''Eternel avait dit qu''il voulait vous détruire.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት እንዲህ ብዬ ጸለይሁ። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ በታላቅነትህ የተቤዠኸውን፥ በጠነከረችውም እጅ ከግብፅ ያወጣኸውን ሕዝብህንና ርስትህን አታጥፋ።

verses.en: I prayed therefore unto the Lord, and said, O Lord God, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.fr: Je priai l''Eternel, et je dis: Seigneur Eternel, ne détruis pas ton peuple, ton héritage, que tu as racheté dans ta grandeur, que tu as fait sortir d''Egypte par ta main puissante.
verses.am: ባሪያዎችህን አብርሃምንና ይስሐቅን ያዕቆብንም አስብ፤ የዚህን ሕዝብ ደንዳንነት ክፋቱንም ኃጢአቱንም አትመልከት፤

verses.en: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:
verses.fr: Souviens-toi de tes serviteurs, Abraham, Isaac et Jacob. Ne regarde point à l''opiniâtreté de ce peuple, à sa méchanceté et à son péché,
verses.am: ከእርስዋ እኛን ያወጣህባት ምድር ሰዎች። እግዚአብሔር ተስፋ ወደ ሰጣቸው ምድር ያገባቸው ዘንድ አልቻለምና፥ ጠልቶአቸውማልና ስለዚህ በምድረ በዳ ሊገድላቸው አወጣቸው እንዳይሉ።

verses.en: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because the Lord was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.
verses.fr: de peur que le pays d''où tu nous as fait sortir ne dise: C''est parce que l''Eternel n''avait pas le pouvoir de les mener dans le pays qu''il leur avait promis, et c''est parce qu''il les haïssait, qu''il les a fait sortir pour les faire mourir dans le désert.
verses.am: እነርሱም በታላቅ ኃይልህ በተዘረጋውም ክንድህ ያወጣሃቸው ሕዝብህና ርስትህ ናቸው።

verses.en: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm.
verses.fr: Ils sont pourtant ton peuple et ton héritage, que tu as fait sortir d''Egypte par ta grande puissance et par ton bras étendu.
verses.am: ፤ እነርሱም በታላቅ ኃይልህ በተዘረጋውም ክንድህ ያወጣሃቸው ሕዝብህና ርስትህ ናቸው።

verses.en: At that time the Lord said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, l''Eternel me dit: Taille deux tables de pierre comme les premières, et monte vers moi sur la montagne; tu feras aussi une arche de bois.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር። እንደ ፊተኞች ያሉትን ሁለት የድንጋይ ጽላቶች ጠርበህ ወደ እኔ ወደ ተራራው ውጣ፥ ለአንተም የእንጨት ታቦት ሥራ፤

verses.en: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.
verses.fr: J''écrirai sur ces tables les paroles qui étaient sur les premières tables que tu as brisées, et tu les mettras dans l''arche.
verses.am: በሰበርሃቸውም በፊተኞቹ ጽላቶች የነበሩትን ቃሎች በእነዚህ ጽላቶች እጽፋለሁ፥ በታቦቱም ውስጥ ታደርጋቸዋለህ አለኝ።

verses.en: And I made an ark of shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in mine hand.
verses.fr: Je fis une arche de bois d''acacia, je taillai deux tables de pierre comme les premières, et je montai sur la montagne, les deux tables dans ma main.
verses.am: ከግራርም እንጨት ታቦትን ሠራሁ፥ እንደ ፊተኞችም ሁለት የድንጋይ ጽላቶች ጠረብሁ፤ ሁለቱንም ጽላቶች በእጄ ይዤ ወደ ተራራው ወጣሁ።

verses.en: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the Lord spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the Lord gave them unto me.
verses.fr: L''Eternel écrivit sur les tables ce qui avait été écrit sur les premières, les dix paroles qu''il vous avait dites sur la montagne, du milieu du feu, le jour de l''assemblée; et l''Eternel me les donna.
verses.am: ስብሰባ ተደርጎ በነበረበትም ቀን እግዚአብሔር በተራራው ላይ በእሳት ውስጥ ሆኖ የተናገራችሁን አሠርቱን ቃላት ቀድሞ ተጽፈው እንደ ነበረ በጽላቶቹ ላይ ጻፈ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እነርሱን ለእኔ ሰጠኝ።

verses.en: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the Lord commanded me.
verses.fr: Je retournai et je descendis de la montagne, je mis les tables dans l''arche que j''avais faite, et elles restèrent là, comme l''Eternel me l''avait ordonné.
verses.am: ተመልሼም ከተራራው ወረድሁ፥ ጽላቶችንም በሠራሁት ታቦት ውስጥ አደረግኋቸው፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንዳዘዘኝ በዚያ ኖሩ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest's office in his stead.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël partirent de Beéroth-Bené Jaakan pour Moséra. C''est là que mourut Aaron, et qu''il fut enterré; Eléazar, son fils, lui succéda dans le sacerdoce.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከብኤሮት ብኔያዕቃን ወደ ሞሴራ ተጓዙ፤ በዚያም አሮን ሞተ በዚያም ተቀበረ፤ በእርሱም ፋንታ ልጁ አልዓዛር ካህን ሆነ።

verses.en: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de là pour Gudgoda, et de Gudgoda pour Jothbatha, pays où il y a des cours d''eaux.
verses.am: ከዚያም ወደ ጉድጎዳ ተጓዙ፤ ከጉድጎዳም ወደ ውኃ ፈሳሾች ምድር ወደ ዮጥባታ ተጓዙ።

verses.en: At that time the Lord separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the Lord, to stand before the Lord to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, l''Eternel sépara la tribu de Lévi, et lui ordonna de porter l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel, de se tenir devant l''Eternel pour le servir, et de bénir le peuple en son nom: ce qu''elle a fait jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ይሸከም ዘንድ፥ እርሱንም ለማገልገል በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይቆም ዘንድ፥ በስሙም ይባርክ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ የሌዊን ነገድ ለየ።

verses.en: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the Lord is his inheritance, according as the Lord thy God promised him.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi Lévi n''a ni part ni héritage avec ses frères: l''Eternel est son héritage, comme l''Eternel, ton Dieu, le lui a dit.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ለሌዊ ከወንድሞቹ ጋር ክፍልና ርስት የለውም፤ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረው እግዚአብሔር ርስቱ ነው።

verses.en: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the Lord hearkened unto me at that time also, and the Lord would not destroy thee.
verses.fr: Je restai sur la montagne, comme précédemment, quarante jours et quarante nuits. L''Eternel m''exauça encore cette fois; l''Eternel ne voulut pas te détruire.
verses.am: እኔም እንደ ፊተኛው ጊዜ አርባ ቀንና አርባ ሌሊት በተራራው ላይ ተቀመጥሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በዚህ ጊዜ ደግሞ ሰማኝ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሊያጠፋህ አልወደደም።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me, Arise, take thy journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: Lève-toi, va, marche à la tête du peuple. Qu''ils aillent prendre possession du pays que j''ai juré à leurs pères de leur donner.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ተነሥተህ በሕዝቡ ፊት ተጓዝ፤ ለአባቶቻቸውም ልሰጣቸው ወደ ማልሁላቸው ምድር ይግቡ ይውረሱአትም አለኝ።

verses.en: And now, Israel, what doth the Lord thy God require of thee, but to fear the Lord thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the Lord thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,
verses.fr: Maintenant, Israël, que demande de toi l''Eternel, ton Dieu, si ce n''est que tu craignes l''Eternel, ton Dieu, afin de marcher dans toutes ses voies, d''aimer et de servir l''Eternel, ton Dieu, de tout ton coeur et de toute ton âme;
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ሰማይ ሰማየ ሰማያትም፥ ምድርም በእርስዋም ያለው ሁሉ የአምላክህ የእግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: To keep the commandments of the Lord, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?
verses.fr: si ce n''est que tu observes les commandements de l''Eternel et ses lois que je te prescris aujourd''hui, afin que tu sois heureux?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ሰማይ ሰማየ ሰማያትም፥ ምድርም በእርስዋም ያለው ሁሉ የአምላክህ የእግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the Lord's thy God, the earth also, with all that therein is.
verses.fr: Voici, à l''Eternel, ton Dieu, appartiennent les cieux et les cieux des cieux, la terre et tout ce qu''elle renferme.
verses.am: ብቻ እግዚአብሔር ስለ አባቶችህ ደስ ብሎታል፥ እነርሱንም ወድዶአል፤ ከእነርሱም በኋላ እናንተን ዘራቸውን እንደ ዛሬው ሁሉ ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል መረጠ።

verses.en: Only the Lord had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all people, as it is this day.
verses.fr: Et c''est à tes pères seulement que l''Eternel s''est attaché pour les aimer; et, après eux, c''est leur postérité, c''est vous qu''il a choisis d''entre tous les peuples, comme vous le voyez aujourd''hui.
verses.am: ለድሃ አደጉና ለመበለቲቱ ይፈርዳል፥ መብልና ልብስም ይሰጠው ዘንድ ስደተኛውን ይወድዳል።

verses.en: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.
verses.fr: Vous circoncirez donc votre coeur, et vous ne roidirez plus votre cou.
verses.am: ለድሃ አደጉና ለመበለቲቱ ይፈርዳል፥ መብልና ልብስም ይሰጠው ዘንድ ስደተኛውን ይወድዳል።

verses.en: For the Lord your God is God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel, votre Dieu, est le Dieu des dieux, le Seigneur des seigneurs, le Dieu grand, fort et terrible, qui ne fait point acception des personnes et qui ne reçoit point de présent,
verses.am: እናንተ በግብፅ አገር ስደተኞች ነበራችሁና ስለዚህ ስደተኛውን ውደዱ።

verses.en: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.
verses.fr: qui fait droit à l''orphelin et à la veuve, qui aime l''étranger et lui donne de la nourriture et des vêtements.
verses.am: አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን ፍራ፥ እርሱንም አምልክ፤ ከእርሱም ተጣበቅ፥ በስሙም ማል።

verses.en: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Vous aimerez l''étranger, car vous avez été étrangers dans le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ዓይኖችህ ያዩትን እነዚህን ታላላቆች የሚያስፈሩትንም ነገሮች ያደረገልህ እርሱ ክብርህ ነው፥ እርሱም አምላክህ ነው።

verses.en: Thou shalt fear the Lord thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.
verses.fr: Tu craindras l''Eternel, ton Dieu, tu le serviras, tu t''attacheras à lui, et tu jureras par son nom.
verses.am: አባቶችህ ሰባ ነፍስ ሆነው ወደ ግብፅ ወረዱ፤ አሁንም አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ብዛትህን እንደ ሰማይ ከዋክብት አደረገ።

verses.en: He is thy praise, and he is thy God, that hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thine eyes have seen.
verses.fr: Il est ta gloire, il est ton Dieu: c''est lui qui a fait au milieu de toi ces choses grandes et terribles que tes yeux ont vues.
verses.am: ፤ ዓይኖችህ ያዩትን እነዚህን ታላላቆች የሚያስፈሩትንም ነገሮች ያደረገልህ እርሱ ክብርህ ነው፥ እርሱም አምላክህ ነው።

verses.en: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the Lord thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.
verses.fr: Tes pères descendirent en Egypte au nombre de soixante-dix personnes; et maintenant l''Eternel, ton Dieu, a fait de toi une multitude pareille aux étoiles des cieux.
verses.am: ፤ አባቶችህ ሰባ ነፍስ ሆነው ወደ ግብፅ ወረዱ፤ አሁንም አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ብዛትህን እንደ ሰማይ ከዋክብት አደረገ።

verses.en: Therefore thou shalt love the Lord thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, alway.
verses.fr: Tu aimeras l''Eternel, ton Dieu, et tu observeras toujours ses préceptes, ses lois, ses ordonnances et ses commandements.
verses.am: እንግዲህ አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን ውደድ፥ ሕጉንም ሥርዓቱንም ፍርዱንም ትእዛዙንም ሁልጊዜ ጠብቅ።

verses.en: And know ye this day: for I speak not with your children which have not known, and which have not seen the chastisement of the Lord your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his stretched out arm,
verses.fr: Reconnaissez aujourd''hui-ce que n''ont pu connaître et voir vos enfants-les châtiments de l''Eternel, votre Dieu, sa grandeur, sa main forte et son bras étendu,
verses.am: የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ተግሣጽ፥ ታላቅነቱንም፥ የጸናችም እጁን፥ የተዘረጋውንም ክንዱን፥

verses.en: And his miracles, and his acts, which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and unto all his land;
verses.fr: ses signes et ses actes qu''il a accomplis au milieu de l''Egypte contre Pharaon, roi d''Egypte, et contre tout son pays.
verses.am: በግብፅም መካከል በንጉሡ በፈርዖንና በአገሩ ሁሉ ላይ ያደረጋትን ተአምራቱንና ሥራውን፥

verses.en: And what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and how the Lord hath destroyed them unto this day;
verses.fr: Reconnaissez ce qu''il a fait à l''armée d''Egypte, à ses chevaux et à ses chars, comment il a fait couler sur eux les eaux de la mer Rouge, lorsqu''ils vous poursuivaient, et les a détruits pour toujours;
verses.am: በተከተሉአችሁም ጊዜ በኤርትራ ባሕር ውኃ እንዳሰጠማቸው፥ እግዚአብሔርም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ እንዳጠፋቸው፥ በግብፅ ጭፍራ በፈረሶቻቸውም በሰረገሎቻቸውም ያደረገውን፥

verses.en: And what he did unto you in the wilderness, until ye came into this place;
verses.fr: ce qu''il vous a fait dans le désert, jusqu''à votre arrivée en ce lieu;
verses.am: ወደዚህ ስፍራ እስክትመጡ ድረስ በምድረ በዳ ያደረገላችሁን፥

verses.en: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance that was in their possession, in the midst of all Israel:
verses.fr: ce qu''il a fait à Dathan et à Abiram, fils d''Eliab, fils de Ruben, comment la terre ouvrit sa bouche et les engloutit, avec leurs maisons et leurs tentes et tout ce qui était à leur suite, au milieu de tout Israël.
verses.am: በእስራኤልም ሁሉ መካከል ምድር አፍዋን ከፍታ እነርሱንና ቤተሰቦቻቸውን ድንኳኖቻቸውንም ለእነርሱም የነበራቸውን ሁሉ በዋጠቻቸው በሮቤል ልጅ በኤልያብ ልጆች በዳታንና በአቤሮን ያደረገውን ላላወቁትና ላላዩት ልጆቻችሁ አልነግራቸውምና እናንተ ዛሬ እወቁ።

verses.en: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the Lord which he did.
verses.fr: Car vos yeux ont vu toutes les grandes choses que l''Eternel a faites.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ያደረጋትን ታላቂቱን ሥራ ሁሉ ዓይኖቻችሁ አይተዋል።

verses.en: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day, that ye may be strong, and go in and possess the land, whither ye go to possess it;
verses.fr: Ainsi, vous observerez tous les commandements que je vous prescris aujourd''hui, afin que vous ayez la force de vous emparer du pays où vous allez passer pour en prendre possession,
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንድትጠነክሩ፥ ትወርሱአትም ዘንድ ወደምትሻገሩባት ምድር እንድትገቡ እንድትወርሱአትም፥ እግዚአብሔርም ለእነርሱና ለዘራቸው ይሰጣት ዘንድ በማለላቸው ወተትና ማርም በምታፈስሰው ምድር ዕድሜአችሁ እንዲረዝም፥ ዛሬ ለእናንተ የማዝዘውን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ጠብቁ።

verses.en: And that ye may prolong your days in the land, which the Lord sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed, a land that floweth with milk and honey.
verses.fr: et afin que vous prolongiez vos jours dans le pays que l''Eternel a juré à vos pères de leur donner, à eux et à leur postérité, pays où coulent le lait et le miel.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንድትጠነክሩ፥ ትወርሱአትም ዘንድ ወደምትሻገሩባት ምድር እንድትገቡ እንድትወርሱአትም፥ እግዚአብሔርም ለእነርሱና ለዘራቸው ይሰጣት ዘንድ በማለላቸው ወተትና ማርም በምታፈስሰው ምድር ዕድሜአችሁ እንዲረዝም፥ ዛሬ ለእናንተ የማዝዘውን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ጠብቁ።

verses.en: For the land, whither thou goest in to possess it, is not as the land of Egypt, from whence ye came out, where thou sowedst thy seed, and wateredst it with thy foot, as a garden of herbs:
verses.fr: Car le pays dont tu vas entrer en possession, n''est pas comme le pays d''Egypte, d''où vous êtes sortis, où tu jetais dans les champs ta semence et les arrosais avec ton pied comme un jardin potager.
verses.am: ትወርሳት ዘንድ የምትገባባት ምድር፥ በአትክልት ስፍራ እንደሚዘሩ ዘርህን እንደዘራህባት፥ በእግርህም እንዳጠጣሃት፥ እንደ ወጣህባት እንደ ግብፅ ምድር አይደለችም።

verses.en: But the land, whither ye go to possess it, is a land of hills and valleys, and drinketh water of the rain of heaven:
verses.fr: Le pays que vous allez posséder est un pays de montagnes et de vallées, et qui boit les eaux de la pluie du ciel;
verses.am: ነገር ግን ትወርሱአት ዘንድ ተሻግራችሁ የምትገቡባት ምድር ኮረብታና ሸለቆ ያለባት አገር ናት፤ በሰማይ ዝናብ ውኃ ትረካለች።

verses.en: A land which the Lord thy God careth for: the eyes of the Lord thy God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.
verses.fr: c''est un pays dont l''Eternel, ton Dieu, prend soin, et sur lequel l''Eternel, ton Dieu, a continuellement les yeux, du commencement à la fin de l''année.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር የሚጐበኛት አገር ናት፤ ከዓመቱ መጀመሪያ እስከ ዓመቱ መጨረሻ ድረስ የአምላክህ የእግዚአብሔር ዓይን ሁልጊዜ በእርስዋ ላይ ነው።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love the Lord your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.fr: Si vous obéissez à mes commandements que je vous prescris aujourd''hui, si vous aimez l''Eternel, votre Dieu, et si vous le servez de tout votre coeur et de toute votre âme,
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እናንተ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ትወድዱ ዘንድ፥ በፍጹምም ልባችሁ በፍጹምም ነፍሳችሁ ታመልኩት ዘንድ ዛሬ ለእናንተ የማዝዘውን ትእዛዜን ፈጽማችሁ ብትሰሙ፥

verses.en: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.
verses.fr: je donnerai à votre pays la pluie en son temps, la pluie de la première et de l''arrière-saison, et tu recueilleras ton blé, ton moût et ton huile;
verses.am: እህልህን ወይንህንም ዘይትህንም ትሰበስብ ዘንድ በየጊዜው የበልጉን ዝናብና የክረምቱን ዝናብ ለምድራችሁ አወርዳለሁ።

verses.en: And I will send grass in thy fields for thy cattle, that thou mayest eat and be full.
verses.fr: je mettrai aussi dans tes champs de l''herbe pour ton bétail, et tu mangeras et te rassasieras.
verses.am: በሜዳ ለእንስሶችህ ሣርን እሰጣለሁ፥ ትበላማለህ፥ ትጠግብማለህ።

verses.en: Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;
verses.fr: Gardez-vous de laisser séduire votre coeur, de vous détourner, de servir d''autres dieux et de vous prosterner devant eux.
verses.am: ልባችሁ እንዳይስት፥ ፈቀቅ እንዳትሉ፥ ሌሎችንም አማልክት እንዳታመልኩ፥ እንዳትሰግዱላቸውም፥

verses.en: And then the Lord's wrath be kindled against you, and he shut up the heaven, that there be no rain, and that the land yield not her fruit; and lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the Lord giveth you.
verses.fr: La colère de l''Eternel s''enflammerait alors contre vous; il fermerait les cieux, et il n''y aurait point de pluie; la terre ne donnerait plus ses produits, et vous péririez promptement dans le bon pays que l''Eternel vous donne.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ እንዳይነድድባችሁ፥ ዝናብም እንዳይዘንብ ምድሪቱም ፍሬዋን እንዳትሰጥ ሰማይን እንዳይዘጋባችሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከሚሰጣችሁ ከመልካሚቱ ምድር ፈጥናችሁ እንዳትጠፉ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.en: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.
verses.fr: Mettez dans votre coeur et dans votre âme ces paroles que je vous dis. Vous les lierez comme un signe sur vos mains, et elles seront comme des fronteaux entre vos yeux.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እነዚህን ቃሎች በልባችሁና በነፍሳችሁ አኑሩ፤ እነርሱንም ለምልክት በእጃችሁ ላይ እሰሩአቸው፥ በዓይኖቻችሁም መካከል እንደክታብ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verses.fr: Vous les enseignerez à vos enfants, et vous leur en parlerez quand tu seras dans ta maison, quand tu iras en voyage, quand tu te coucheras et quand tu te lèveras.
verses.am: ልጆቻችሁንም አስተምሩአቸው፥ በቤትህም ስትቀመጥ፥ በመንገድም ስትሄድ፥ ስትተኛም ስትነሣም አጫውቱአቸው።

verses.en: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house, and upon thy gates:
verses.fr: Tu les écriras sur les poteaux de ta maison et sur tes portes.
verses.am: አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ትወድዱ ዘንድ፥ በመንገዱም ሁሉ ትሄዱ ዘንድ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ትጣበቁ ዘንድ፥ ዛሬ ለእናንተ የማዝዘውን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ብትጠብቁ ብታደርጉአትም፥

verses.en: That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the Lord sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.
verses.fr: Et alors vos jours et les jours de vos enfants, dans le pays que l''Eternel a juré à vos pères de leur donner, seront aussi nombreux que les jours des cieux le seront au-dessus de la terre.
verses.am: አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ትወድዱ ዘንድ፥ በመንገዱም ሁሉ ትሄዱ ዘንድ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ትጣበቁ ዘንድ፥ ዛሬ ለእናንተ የማዝዘውን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ብትጠብቁ ብታደርጉአትም፥

verses.en: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you, to do them, to love the Lord your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him;
verses.fr: Car si vous observez tous ces commandements que je vous prescris, et si vous les mettez en pratique pour aimer l''Eternel, votre Dieu, pour marcher dans toutes ses voies et pour vous attacher à lui,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እነዚህን አሕዛብ ሁሉ ከፊታችሁ ያወጣል፥ ከእናንተም የሚበልጡትን የሚበረቱትንም አሕዛብ ትወርሳላችሁ።

verses.en: Then will the Lord drive out all these nations from before you, and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.
verses.fr: l''Eternel chassera devant vous toutes ces nations, et vous vous rendrez maîtres de nations plus grandes et plus puissantes que vous.
verses.am: የእግራችሁ ጫማ የምትረግጣት ስፍራ ሁሉ ለእናንተ ትሆናለች፤ ከምድረ በዳም ከሊባኖስም ከታላቁም ከኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ባሕር ድረስ ዳርቻችሁ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be.
verses.fr: Tout lieu que foulera la plante de votre pied sera à vous: votre frontière s''étendra du désert au Liban, et du fleuve de l''Euphrate jusqu''à la mer occidentale.
verses.am: በእናንተም ፊት ማንም መቆም አይችልም፤ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር፥ እርሱ እንደ ተናገራችሁ፥ ማስፈራታችሁን ማስደንገጣችሁንም በምትረግጡአት ምድር ሁሉ ላይ ያኖራል።

verses.en: There shall no man be able to stand before you: for the Lord your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath said unto you.
verses.fr: Nul ne tiendra contre vous. L''Eternel, votre Dieu, répandra, comme il vous l''a dit, la frayeur et la crainte de toi sur tout le pays où vous marcherez.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እኔ ዛሬ በፊታችሁ በረከትንና መርገምን አኖራለሁ፤

verses.en: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse;
verses.fr: Vois, je mets aujourd''hui devant vous la bénédiction et la malédiction:
verses.am: በረከትም፥ እኔ ዛሬ ለእናንተ የማዝዘውን የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ብትሰሙ፤

verses.en: A blessing, if ye obey the commandments of the Lord your God, which I command you this day:
verses.fr: la bénédiction, si vous obéissez aux commandements de l''Eternel, votre Dieu, que je vous prescris en ce jour;
verses.am: መርገምም፥ የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ባትሰሙ፥ ዛሬም ካዘዝኋችሁ መንገድ ፈቀቅ ብትሉ፥ ሌሎችንም የማታውቋቸውን አማልክት ብትከተሉ ነው።

verses.en: And a curse, if ye will not obey the commandments of the Lord your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.
verses.fr: la malédiction, si vous n''obéissez pas aux commandements de l''Eternel, votre Dieu, et si vous vous détournez de la voie que je vous prescris en ce jour, pour aller après d''autres dieux que vous ne connaissez point.
verses.am: አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር ትወርሳት ዘንድ አንተን ወደምትሄድባት ምድር ባገባህ ጊዜ፥ በረከቱን በገሪዛን ተራራ መርገሙንም በጌባል ተራራ ታኖራለህ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when the Lord thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.
verses.fr: Et lorsque l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''aura fait entrer dans le pays dont tu vas prendre possession, tu prononceras la bénédiction sur la montagne de Garizim, et la malédiction sur la montagne d''Ebal.
verses.am: እነርሱም በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ፥ ከፀሐይ መግቢያ ካለችው መንገድ በኋላ፥ በዓረባ በተቀመጡት በከነዓናውያን ምድር፥ በጌልገላ ፊት ለፊት በሞሬ የአድባር ዛፍ አጠገብ ናቸው።

verses.en: Are they not on the other side Jordan, by the way where the sun goeth down, in the land of the Canaanites, which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh?
verses.fr: Ces montagnes ne sont-elles pas de l''autre côté du Jourdain, derrière le chemin de l''occident, au pays des Cananéens qui habitent dans la plaine vis-à-vis de Guilgal, près des chênes de Moré?
verses.am: አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር የሚሰጣችሁን ምድር ትወርሱ ዘንድ ዮርዳኖስን ትሻገራላችሁ፥ ትወርሱአታላችሁም፥ ትቀመጡባታላችሁም።

verses.en: For ye shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the Lord your God giveth you, and ye shall possess it, and dwell therein.
verses.fr: Car vous allez passer le Jourdain pour entrer en possession du pays que l''Eternel, votre Dieu, vous donne; vous le posséderez, et vous y habiterez.
verses.am: እኔም ዛሬ በፊታችሁ የማኖራትን ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ሁሉ ታደርጉ ዘንድ ጠብቁ።

verses.en: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you this day.
verses.fr: Vous observerez et vous mettrez en pratique toutes les lois et les ordonnances que je vous prescris aujourd''hui.
verses.am: ፤ እኔም ዛሬ በፊታችሁ የማኖራትን ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ሁሉ ታደርጉ ዘንድ ጠብቁ።

verses.en: These are the statutes and judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the Lord God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.
verses.fr: Voici les lois et les ordonnances que vous observerez et que vous mettrez en pratique, aussi longtemps que vous y vivrez, dans le pays dont l''Eternel, le Dieu de vos pères, vous donne la possession.
verses.am: በምድር ላይ በምትኖሩበት ዘመን ሁሉ የአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ለመውረስ በሰጣችሁ አገር፥ የምትጠብቁአትና የምታደርጉአት ሥርዓትና ፍርድ እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:
verses.fr: Vous détruirez tous les lieux où les nations que vous allez chasser servent leurs dieux, sur les hautes montagnes, sur les collines, et sous tout arbre vert.
verses.am: እናንተ የምትወርሱአቸው አሕዛብ አማልክቶቻቸውን ያመለኩባቸውን በረጅም ተራሮች በኮረብቶችም ላይ ከለምለምም ዛፍ በታች ያለውን ስፍራ ሁሉ ፈጽማችሁ አጥፉአቸው፤

verses.en: And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place.
verses.fr: Vous renverserez leurs autels, vous briserez leurs statues, vous brûlerez au feu leurs idoles, vous abattrez les images taillées de leurs dieux, et vous ferez disparaître leurs noms de ces lieux-là.
verses.am: መሠዊያቸውንም አፍርሱ፥ ሐውልቶቻቸውንም ሰባብሩ፥ የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶቻቸውንም በእሳት አቃጥሉ፥ የአማልክቶቻቸውንም የተቀረጹ ምስሎች አንከታክቱ፤ ከዚያም ስፍራ ስማቸውን አጥፉ።

verses.en: Ye shall not do so unto the Lord your God.
verses.fr: Vous n''agirez pas ainsi à l''égard de l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: ለአምላካችሁ ለእግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ያለ ሥራ አትሥሩ።

verses.en: But unto the place which the Lord your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there, even unto his habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come:
verses.fr: Mais vous le chercherez à sa demeure, et vous irez au lieu que l''Eternel, votre Dieu, choisira parmi toutes vos tribus pour y placer son nom.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ከነገዶቻችሁ ሁሉ ስሙን በዚያ ያኖር ዘንድ ወደዚያ ወደ መረጠው ስፍራ ትመጣላችሁ፥ ማደሪያውንም ትሻላችሁ።

verses.en: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:
verses.fr: C''est là que vous présenterez vos holocaustes, vos sacrifices, vos dîmes, vos prémices, vos offrandes en accomplissement d''un voeu, vos offrandes volontaires, et les premiers-nés de votre gros et de votre menu bétail.
verses.am: ወደዚያም የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕታችሁን፥ ሌላ መሥዋዕታችሁንም፥ አሥራታችሁንም፥ በእጃችሁም ያነሣችሁትን ቍርባን፥ ስእለታችሁንም፥ በፈቃዳችሁ የምታቀርቡትን፥ የላማችሁንና የበጋችሁንም በኵራት ውሰዱ።

verses.en: And there ye shall eat before the Lord your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto, ye and your households, wherein the Lord thy God hath blessed thee.
verses.fr: C''est là que vous mangerez devant l''Eternel, votre Dieu, et que, vous et vos familles, vous ferez servir à votre joie tous les biens par lesquels l''Eternel, votre Dieu, vous aura bénis.
verses.am: በዚያም በአምላካችሁ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ብሉ፥ እጃችሁንም በምትዘረጉበት፥ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በባረከህ ነገር ሁሉ፥ እናንተና ቤተሰባችሁ ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.en: Ye shall not do after all the things that we do here this day, every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes.
verses.fr: Vous n''agirez donc pas comme nous le faisons maintenant ici, où chacun fait ce qui lui semble bon,
verses.am: ሰው ሁሉ በፊቱ መልካም መስሎ የታየውን፥ እኛ በዚህ ዛሬ የምናደርገውን ሁሉ አታደርጉም፤

verses.en: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which the Lord your God giveth you.
verses.fr: parce que vous n''êtes point encore arrivés dans le lieu de repos et dans l''héritage que l''Eternel, votre Dieu, vous donne.
verses.am: አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ወደሚሰጣችሁ ዕረፍትና ርስት እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ አልገባችሁምና።

verses.en: But when ye go over Jordan, and dwell in the land which the Lord your God giveth you to inherit, and when he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about, so that ye dwell in safety;
verses.fr: Mais vous passerez le Jourdain, et vous habiterez dans le pays dont l''Eternel, votre Dieu, vous mettra en possession; il vous donnera du repos, après vous avoir délivrés de tous vos ennemis qui vous entourent, et vous vous établirez en sécurité.
verses.am: ዮርዳኖስን ግን በተሻገራችሁ ጊዜ፥ አምላካችሁም እግዚአብሔር በሚያወርሳችሁ ምድር በተቀመጣችሁ ጊዜ፥ ያለ ፍርሃትም እንድትኖሩ ከከበቡአችሁ ጠላቶች ሁሉ ዕረፍት በሰጣችሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Then there shall be a place which the Lord your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall ye bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the Lord:
verses.fr: Alors il y aura un lieu que l''Eternel, votre Dieu, choisira pour y faire résider son nom. C''est là que vous présenterez tout ce que je vous ordonne, vos holocaustes, vos sacrifices, vos dîmes, vos prémices, et les offrandes choisies que vous ferez à l''Eternel pour accomplir vos voeux.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ስሙ ይጠራበት ዘንድ ወደዚያ ወደ መረጠው ስፍራ፥ እኔ የማዝዛችሁን ሁሉ፥ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕታችሁን፥ ሌላ መሥዋዕታችሁንም፥ አሥራታችሁንም፥ በእጃችሁ ያነሣችሁትንም ቍርባን፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ተስላችሁ የመረጣችሁትን ስእለታችሁን ሁሉ ውሰዱ።

verses.en: And ye shall rejoice before the Lord your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite that is within your gates; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you.
verses.fr: C''est là que vous vous réjouirez devant l''Eternel, votre Dieu, vous, vos fils et vos filles, vos serviteurs et vos servantes, et le Lévite qui sera dans vos portes; car il n''a ni part ni héritage avec vous.
verses.am: እናንተም፥ ወንዶች ልጆቻችሁና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁም፥ ባሪያዎቻችሁም፥ ገረዶቻችሁም፥ ከእናንተ ጋር ክፍልና ርስት ስለሌለው በደጆቻችሁ ውስጥ የተቀመጠው ሌዋዊም በአምላካችሁ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.en: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest:
verses.fr: Garde-toi d''offrir tes holocaustes dans tous les lieux que tu verras;
verses.am: የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትህን በሚታይህ ስፍራ ሁሉ እንዳታቀርብ ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.en: But in the place which the Lord shall choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.
verses.fr: mais tu offriras tes holocaustes au lieu que l''Eternel choisira dans l''une de tes tribus, et c''est là que tu feras tout ce que je t''ordonne.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ከነገዶችህ ከአንዱ ዘንድ በመረጠው ስፍራ በዚያ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትህን አቅርብ፥ በዚያም የማዝዝህን ሁሉ አድርግ።

verses.en: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, according to the blessing of the Lord thy God which he hath given thee: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the roebuck, and as of the hart.
verses.fr: Néanmoins, quand tu en auras le désir, tu pourras tuer du bétail et manger de la viande dans toutes tes portes, selon les bénédictions que t''accordera l''Eternel, ton Dieu; celui qui sera impur et celui qui sera pur pourront en manger, comme on mange de la gazelle et du cerf.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሰጠህ በረከት፥ ሰውነትህ እንደ ፈቀደ፥ በደጆችህ ሁሉ ውስጥ አርደህ ብላ፤ ንጹሕ ሰው ንጹሕም ያልሆነ ሰው እንደ ሚዳቋና እንደ ዋላ ያለውን ይብላው።

verses.en: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water.
verses.fr: Seulement, vous ne mangerez pas le sang: tu le répandras sur la terre comme de l''eau.
verses.am: ደሙን ግን እንደ ውኃ በምድር ላይ አፍስሰው እንጂ አትብላው።

verses.en: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:
verses.fr: Tu ne pourras pas manger dans tes portes la dîme de ton blé, de ton moût et de ton huile, ni les premiers-nés de ton gros et de ton menu bétail, ni aucune de tes offrandes en accomplissement d''un voeu, ni tes offrandes volontaires, ni tes prémices.
verses.am: የእህልህን የወይን ጠጅህን የዘይትህንም አሥራት፥ የላምህንና የበግህንም በኩራት፥ የተሳልኸውንም ስእለት ሁሉ፥ በፈቃድህም ያቀረብኸውን፥ በእጅህም ያነሣኸውን ቍርባን በደጆችህ ውስጥ መብላት አትችልም።

verses.en: But thou must eat them before the Lord thy God in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates: and thou shalt rejoice before the Lord thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto.
verses.fr: Mais c''est devant l''Eternel, ton Dieu, que tu les mangeras, dans le lieu que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, choisira, toi, ton fils et ta fille, ton serviteur et ta servante, et le Lévite qui sera dans tes portes; et c''est devant l''Eternel, ton Dieu, que tu feras servir à ta joie tous les biens que tu posséderas.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አንተ፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችህም፥ ባሪያዎችህና ገረዶችህም፥ በአገርህም ደጅ ያለው ሌዋዊ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በመረጠው ስፍራ በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ብሉት፤ እጅህንም በምትዘረጋበት ነገር ሁሉ በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ደስ ይበልህ።

verses.en: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.
verses.fr: Aussi longtemps que tu vivras dans ton pays, garde-toi de délaisser le Lévite.
verses.am: በምድርህ ላይ በምትኖርበት ዘመን ሁሉ ሌዋዊውን ቸል እንዳትል ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.en: When the Lord thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he hath promised thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul longeth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.
verses.fr: Lorsque l''Eternel, ton Dieu, aura élargi tes frontières, comme il te l''a promis, et que le désir de manger de la viande te fera dire: Je voudrais manger de la viande! tu pourras en manger, selon ton désir.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ነገረህ አገርህን ባሰፋ ጊዜ፥ ሰውነትህም ሥጋ መብላት ስለ ወደደች። ሥጋ ልብላ ስትል፥ እንደ ሰውነትህ ፈቃድ ሥጋን ብላ።

verses.en: If the place which the Lord thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which the Lord hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.
verses.fr: Si le lieu que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, aura choisi pour y placer son nom est éloigné de toi, tu pourras tuer du gros et du menu bétail, comme je te l''ai prescrit, et tu pourras en manger dans tes portes selon ton désir.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በዚያ ስሙን ያኖር ዘንድ የመረጠው ስፍራ ከአንተ ሩቅ ቢሆንም፥ እግዚአብሔር ከሰጠህ ከላምና ከበግ መንጋህ እንዳዘዝሁህ እረድ፥ እንደ ሰውነትህም ፈቃድ ሁሉ በአገርህ ደጅ ውስጥ ብላው።

verses.en: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike.
verses.fr: Tu en mangeras comme on mange de la gazelle et du cerf; celui qui sera impur, et celui qui sera pur en mangeront l''un et l''autre.
verses.am: ሚዳቋና ዋላ እንደሚበሉ እንዲሁ ብላው፤ ንጹሕ ሰው ንጹሕም ያልሆነ ይብላው።

verses.en: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood is the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.
verses.fr: Seulement, garde-toi de manger le sang, car le sang, c''est l''âme; et tu ne mangeras pas l''âme avec la chair.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ደሙ ነፍሱ ነውና፥ ነፍሱንም ከሥጋው ጋር መብላት አይገባህምና ደሙን እንዳትበላ ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.
verses.fr: Tu ne le mangeras pas: tu le répandras sur la terre comme de l''eau.
verses.am: በምድር ላይ እንደ ውኃ አፍስሰው እንጂ አትብላው።

verses.en: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu ne le mangeras pas, afin que tu sois heureux, toi et tes enfants après toi, en faisant ce qui est droit aux yeux de l''Eternel.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መልካም የሆነውን ነገር ስታደርግ ለአንተ ከአንተም በኋላ ለልጆችህ መልካም እንዲሆንላችሁ፥ አትብላው።

verses.en: Only thy holy things which thou hast, and thy vows, thou shalt take, and go unto the place which the Lord shall choose:
verses.fr: Mais les choses que tu voudras consacrer et les offrandes que tu feras en accomplissement d''un voeu, tu iras les présenter au lieu qu''aura choisi l''Eternel.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የተቀደሰውን ነገርህን ስእለትህንም ይዘህ እግዚአብሔር ወደ መረጠው ስፍራ ሂድ።

verses.en: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the Lord thy God: and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the Lord thy God, and thou shalt eat the flesh.
verses.fr: Tu offriras tes holocaustes, la chair et le sang, sur l''autel de l''Eternel, ton Dieu; dans tes autres sacrifices, le sang sera répandu sur l''autel de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, et tu mangeras la chair.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕትህን፥ ሥጋውንና ደሙን፥ በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ላይ አቅርብ፤ የመሥዋዕትህም ደም በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ላይ ይፍሰስ፥ ሥጋውንም ብላው።

verses.en: Observe and hear all these words which I command thee, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest that which is good and right in the sight of the Lord thy God.
verses.fr: Garde et écoute toutes ces choses que je t''ordonne, afin que tu sois heureux, toi et tes enfants après toi, à perpétuité, en faisant ce qui est bien et ce qui est droit aux yeux de l''Eternel, ton Dieu.
verses.am: በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መልካምና ቅን የሆነውን ነገር ስታደርግ ለአንተ ከአንተም በኋላ ለልጆችህ ለዘላለም መልካም ይሆንላችሁ ዘንድ እኔ የማዝዝህን እነዚህን ቃሎች ሁሉ ሰምተህ ጠብቅ።

verses.en: When the Lord thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee, whither thou goest to possess them, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their land;
verses.fr: Lorsque l''Eternel, ton Dieu, aura exterminé les nations que tu vas chasser devant toi, lorsque tu les auras chassées et que tu te seras établi dans leur pays,
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ትወርሳቸው ዘንድ የምትሄድባቸውን አሕዛብን በፊትህ ባጠፋ ጊዜ፥ አንተም በወረስሃቸው ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them, after that they be destroyed from before thee; and that thou enquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.
verses.fr: garde-toi de te laisser prendre au piège en les imitant, après qu''elles auront été détruites devant toi. Garde-toi de t''informer de leurs dieux et de dire: Comment ces nations servaient-elles leurs dieux? Moi aussi, je veux faire de même.
verses.am: በምድራቸውም በተቀመጥህ ጊዜ፥ ከፊትህ ከጠፉ በኋላ እነርሱን ለመከተል እንዳትጠመድ። እነዚህስ አሕዛብ አማልክቶቻቸውን ያመለኩት እንዴት ነው? እንዲሁ ደግሞ እኔ አደርጋለሁ ብለህ ስለ አማልክቶቻቸው እንዳትጠይቅ ተጠንቀቅ።
