verses.en: Thou shalt not do so unto the Lord thy God: for every abomination to the Lord, which he hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.
verses.fr: Tu n''agiras pas ainsi à l''égard de l''Eternel, ton Dieu; car elles servaient leurs dieux en faisant toutes les abominations qui sont odieuses à l''Eternel, et même elles brûlaient au feu leurs fils et leurs filles en l''honneur de leurs dieux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የሚጠላውን ርኵሰት ሁሉ እነርሱ ለአማልክቶቻቸው አድርገዋልና፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን ደግሞ ለአማልክቶቻቸው በእሳት ያቃጥሉአቸዋልና አንተ ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር እንዲሁ አታድርግ።

verses.en: What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it.
verses.fr: Vous observerez et vous mettrez en pratique toutes les choses que je vous ordonne; vous n''y ajouterez rien, et vous n''en retrancherez rien.
verses.am: እኔ የማዝዝህን ነገር ሁሉ ታደርገው ዘንድ ጠብቅ፤ ምንም በእርሱ ላይ አትጨምር፥ ከእርሱም ምንም አታጕድል።

verses.en: If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and giveth thee a sign or a wonder,
verses.fr: S''il s''élève au milieu de toi un prophète ou un songeur qui t''annonce un signe ou un prodige,
verses.am: በመካከልህም ነቢይ ወይም ሕልም አላሚ ቢነሣ፥ ምልክትም ተአምራትም ቢሰጥህ፥

verses.en: And the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spake unto thee, saying, Let us go after other gods, which thou hast not known, and let us serve them;
verses.fr: et qu''il y ait accomplissement du signe ou du prodige dont il t''a parlé en disant: Allons après d''autres dieux, -des dieux que tu ne connais point, -et servons-les!
verses.am: እንደ ነገረህም ምልክቱ ተአምራቱም ቢፈጸም፥ እርሱም። ሄደን የማታውቃቸውን ሌሎች አማልክት እንከተል እናምልካቸውም ቢልህ፥

verses.en: Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for the Lord your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.fr: tu n''écouteras pas les paroles de ce prophète ou de ce songeur, car c''est l''Eternel, votre Dieu, qui vous met à l''épreuve pour savoir si vous aimez l''Eternel, votre Dieu, de tout votre coeur et de toute votre âme.
verses.am: አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን በፍጹም ልባችሁ በፍጹምም ነፍሳችሁ ትወድዱት እንደ ሆነ ያውቅ ዘንድ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ሊፈትናችሁ ነውና የዚያን ነቢይ ቃል ወይም ያን ሕልም አላሚ አትስማ።

verses.en: Ye shall walk after the Lord your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.
verses.fr: Vous irez après l''Eternel, votre Dieu, et vous le craindrez; vous observerez ses commandements, vous obéirez à sa voix, vous le servirez, et vous vous attacherez à lui.
verses.am: አምላካችሁን አግዚአብሔርን ተከተሉ፥ እርሱንም ፍሩ፥ ትእዛዙንም ጠብቁ፥ ቃሉንም ስሙ፥ እርሱንም አምልኩ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ተጣበቁ።

verses.en: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he hath spoken to turn you away from the Lord your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the Lord thy God commanded thee to walk in. So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee.
verses.fr: Ce prophète ou ce songeur sera puni de mort, car il a parlé de révolte contre l''Eternel, votre Dieu, qui vous a fait sortir du pays d''Egypte et vous a délivrés de la maison de servitude, et il a voulu te détourner de la voie dans laquelle l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''a ordonné de marcher. Tu ôteras ainsi le mal du milieu de toi.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ትሄድባት ዘንድ ካዘዘህ መንገድ ሊያወጣህ፥ ከግብፅ ምድር ካወጣችሁ ከባርነትም ቤት ካዳናችሁ ከአምላካችሁ ከእግዚአብሔር ሊያስታችሁ ተናግሮአልና ያ ነቢይ ወይም ያ ሕልም አላሚ ይገደል፤ እንዲሁም ክፉውን ነገር ከመካከልህ አርቅ።

verses.en: If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers;
verses.fr: Si ton frère, fils de ta mère, ou ton fils, ou ta fille, ou la femme qui repose sur ton sein, ou ton ami que tu aimes comme toi-même, t''incite secrètement en disant: Allons, et servons d''autres dieux! -des dieux que ni toi ni tes pères n''avez connus,
verses.am: የእናትህ ልጅ ወንድምህ ወይም ወንድ ልጅህ ወይም ሴት ልጅህ ወይም በብብትህ ያለች ሚስትህ ወይም እንደ ነፍስህ ያለ ወዳጅህ በስውር። ና፥ ሄደን ከምድር ዳር ጀምሮ እስከ ምድር ዳር ድረስ ወደ አንተ የቀረቡት ከአንተም የራቁት አንተን ከብበውህ ያሉ አሕዛብ ከሚያመልኩአቸው አማልክት፥ አንተም አባቶችህም የማታውቋቸውን ሌሎች አማልክት እናምልክ ብሎ ቢያስትህ፥ እሺ አትበለው፥

verses.en: Namely, of the gods of the people which are round about you, nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth;
verses.fr: d''entre les dieux des peuples qui vous entourent, près de toi ou loin de toi, d''une extrémité de la terre à l''autre-
verses.am: የእናትህ ልጅ ወንድምህ ወይም ወንድ ልጅህ ወይም ሴት ልጅህ ወይም በብብትህ ያለች ሚስትህ ወይም እንደ ነፍስህ ያለ ወዳጅህ በስውር። ና፥ ሄደን ከምድር ዳር ጀምሮ እስከ ምድር ዳር ድረስ ወደ አንተ የቀረቡት ከአንተም የራቁት አንተን ከብበውህ ያሉ አሕዛብ ከሚያመልኩአቸው አማልክት፥ አንተም አባቶችህም የማታውቋቸውን ሌሎች አማልክት እናምልክ ብሎ ቢያስትህ፥ እሺ አትበለው፥

verses.en: Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him:
verses.fr: tu n''y consentiras pas, et tu ne l''écouteras pas; tu ne jetteras pas sur lui un regard de pitié, tu ne l''épargneras pas, et tu ne le couvriras pas.
verses.am: አትስማውም፤ ዓይንህም አይራራለት፥ እትማረውም፥ አትሸሽገውም፤

verses.en: But thou shalt surely kill him; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.
verses.fr: Mais tu le feras mourir; ta main se lèvera la première sur lui pour le mettre à mort, et la main de tout le peuple ensuite;
verses.am: ነገር ግን ፈጽመህ ግደለው፤ እርሱን ለመግደል በፊት የአንተ እጅ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ የሕዝቡ ሁሉ እጅ በላዩ ትሁን።

verses.en: And thou shalt stone him with stones, that he die; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.fr: tu le lapideras, et il mourra, parce qu''il a cherché à te détourner de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, qui t''a fait sortir du pays d''Egypte, de la maison de servitude.
verses.am: ከግብፅ ምድር ከባርነት ቤት ካወጣህ ከአምላክህ ከእግዚአብሔር ሊያርቅህ ወድዶአልና እስኪሞት ድረስ በድንጋይ ውገረው።

verses.en: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you.
verses.fr: Il en sera ainsi, afin que tout Israël entende et craigne, et que l''on ne commette plus un acte aussi criminel au milieu de toi.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ሁሉ ሰምተው ይፈራሉ፥ እንዲህም ያለ ክፉ ሥራ እንደ ገና በአንተ መካከል አያደርጉም።

verses.en: If thou shalt hear say in one of thy cities, which the Lord thy God hath given thee to dwell there, saying,
verses.fr: Si tu entends dire au sujet de l''une des villes que t''a données pour demeure l''Eternel, ton Dieu:
verses.am: ትፈልጋለህ፥ ትመረምራለህም፥ ትጠይቃለህም፤ እነሆም፥ እውነት ቢሆን፥ ይህም ክፉ ነገር በመካከልህ እንደ ተደረገ እርግጥ ሆኖ ቢገኝ፥

verses.en: Certain men, the children of Belial, are gone out from among you, and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye have not known;
verses.fr: Des gens pervers sont sortis du milieu de toi, et ont séduit les habitants de leur ville en disant: Allons, et servons d''autres dieux! des dieux que tu ne connais point
verses.am: ትፈልጋለህ፥ ትመረምራለህም፥ ትጠይቃለህም፤ እነሆም፥ እውነት ቢሆን፥ ይህም ክፉ ነገር በመካከልህ እንደ ተደረገ እርግጥ ሆኖ ቢገኝ፥

verses.en: Then shalt thou enquire, and make search, and ask diligently; and, behold, if it be truth, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought among you;
verses.fr: tu feras des recherches, tu examineras, tu interrogeras avec soin. La chose est-elle vraie, le fait est-il établi, cette abomination a-t-elle été commise au milieu de toi,
verses.am: የዚያችን ከተማ ሰዎች በሰይፍ ስለት ፈጽሞ ትመታቸዋለህ፤ ከተማይቱን፥ በእርስዋም ያለውን ሁሉ፥ እንስሳውንም በሰይፍ ስለት ታጠፋቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, and all that is therein, and the cattle thereof, with the edge of the sword.
verses.fr: alors tu frapperas du tranchant de l''épée les habitants de cette ville, tu la dévoueras par interdit avec tout ce qui s''y trouvera, et tu en passeras le bétail au fil de l''épée.
verses.am: ዕቃዋንም ሁሉ ወደ አደባባይዋ ትሰበሰባለህ፥ ከተማይቱንም ዕቃዋንም ሁሉ ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር በእሳት ፈጽመህ ታቃጥላለህ፤ ለዘላለምም ወና ትሆናለች፥ ደግሞም አትሠራም።

verses.en: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof, and shalt burn with fire the city, and all the spoil thereof every whit, for the Lord thy God: and it shall be an heap for ever; it shall not be built again.
verses.fr: Tu amasseras tout le butin au milieu de la place, et tu brûleras entièrement au feu la ville avec tout son butin, devant l''Eternel, ton Dieu: elle sera pour toujours un monceau de ruines, elle ne sera jamais rebâtie.
verses.am: ፤ ዕቃዋንም ሁሉ ወደ አደባባይዋ ትሰበሰባለህ፥ ከተማይቱንም ዕቃዋንም ሁሉ ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር በእሳት ፈጽመህ ታቃጥላለህ፤ ለዘላለምም ወና ትሆናለች፥ ደግሞም አትሠራም።

verses.en: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to thine hand: that the Lord may turn from the fierceness of his anger, and shew thee mercy, and have compassion upon thee, and multiply thee, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers;
verses.fr: Rien de ce qui sera dévoué par interdit ne s''attachera à ta main, afin que l''Eternel revienne de l''ardeur de sa colère, qu''il te fasse miséricorde et grâce, et qu''il te multiplie, comme il l''a juré à tes pères,

verses.en: When thou shalt hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day, to do that which is right in the eyes of the Lord thy God.
verses.fr: si tu obéis à la voix de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, en observant tous ses commandements que je te prescris aujourd''hui, et en faisant ce qui est droit aux yeux de l''Eternel, ton Dieu.
verses.am: ፤ ዛሬም እኔ የማዝዝህን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ትጠብቅ ዘንድ፥ በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ደስ የሚያሰኘውን ታደርግ ዘንድ የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስትሰማ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መቅሠፍት ቍጣ ይመለስ ዘንድ፥ ለአባቶችህም እንደ ማለላቸው ይምርህ ዘንድ፥ ይራራልህም ዘንድ፥ ያበዛህም ዘንድ፥ እርም ከሆነው አንዳች ነገር በእጅህ አይንጠልጠልብህ።

verses.en: Ye are the children of the Lord your God: ye shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.
verses.fr: Vous êtes les enfants de l''Eternel, votre Dieu. Vous ne vous ferez point d''incisions et vous ne vous ferez point de place chauve entre les yeux pour un mort.
verses.am: እናንተ የአምላካችሁ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ናችሁ

verses.en: For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God, and the Lord hath chosen thee to be a peculiar people unto himself, above all the nations that are upon the earth.
verses.fr: Car tu es un peuple saint pour l''Eternel, ton Dieu; et l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''a choisi, pour que tu fusses un peuple qui lui appartînt entre tous les peuples qui sont sur la face de la terre.
verses.am: ፤ ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔ አንተ ቅዱስ ሕዝብ ነህና፥ በምድርም ላይ ከሚኖሩ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ይልቅ ለእርሱ ለራሱ ሕዝብ ትሆንለት ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር አንተን መርጦአልና ስለ ሞተው ሰው አካላችሁን አትንጩ፥ በዓይኖቻችሁም መካከል ራሳችሁን አትላጩ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not eat any abominable thing.
verses.fr: Tu ne mangeras aucune chose abominable.
verses.am: ርኩስን ነገር ሁሉ አትብላ። የምትበሉአቸው እንስሶች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ በሬ፥

verses.en: These are the beasts which ye shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,
verses.fr: Voici les animaux que vous mangerez: le boeuf, la brebis et la chèvre;
verses.am: ርኩስን ነገር ሁሉ አትብላ። የምትበሉአቸው እንስሶች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ በሬ፥

verses.en: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.
verses.fr: le cerf, la gazelle et le daim; le bouquetin, le chevreuil, la chèvre sauvage et la girafe.
verses.am: በግ፥ ፍየል፥ ዋላ፥ ሚዳቋ፥ የበረሃ ፍየል፥ አጋዘን፥ አጭ፥ በራይሌ፥ ድኵላ።

verses.en: And every beast that parteth the hoof, and cleaveth the cleft into two claws, and cheweth the cud among the beasts, that ye shall eat.
verses.fr: Vous mangerez de tout animal qui a la corne fendue, le pied fourchu, et qui rumine.
verses.am: ከእንስሶች ሰኮናው የተሰነጠቀውን፥ ጥፍሩም ከሁለት የተከፈለውን፥ የሚያመሰኳውንም እንስሳ ሁሉ ትበላለህ።

verses.en: Nevertheless these ye shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the cloven hoof; as the camel, and the hare, and the coney: for they chew the cud, but divide not the hoof; therefore they are unclean unto you.
verses.fr: Mais vous ne mangerez pas de ceux qui ruminent seulement, ou qui ont la corne fendue et le pied fourchu seulement. Ainsi, vous ne mangerez pas le chameau, le lièvre et le daman, qui ruminent, mais qui n''ont pas la corne fendue: vous les regarderez comme impurs.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከሚያመሰኩ ወይም ሰኮናቸው ከተሰነጠቀ እነዚህን አትበሉም፤ ግመልን፥ ጥንቸልን፥ ሽኮኮን አትበሉም። ያመሰኳሉና፥ ነገር ግን ሰኮናቸው አልተሰነጠቀምና እነዚህ ለእናንተ ርኩሶች ናቸው።

verses.en: And the swine, because it divideth the hoof, yet cheweth not the cud, it is unclean unto you: ye shall not eat of their flesh, nor touch their dead carcase.
verses.fr: Vous ne mangerez pas le porc, qui a la corne fendue, mais qui ne rumine pas: vous le regarderez comme impur. Vous ne mangerez pas de leur chair, et vous ne toucherez pas leurs corps morts.
verses.am: እርያም፥ ሰኮናው ስለ ተሰነጠቀ ነገር ግን ስላላመሰኳ እርሱ ለእናንተ ርኩስ ነው፤ ሥጋውን አትብሉ፥ በድኑንም አትንኩ።

verses.en: These ye shall eat of all that are in the waters: all that have fins and scales shall ye eat:
verses.fr: Voici les animaux dont vous mangerez parmi tous ceux qui sont dans les eaux: vous mangerez de tous ceux qui ont des nageoires et des écailles.
verses.am: በውኆች ውስጥ ከሚኖሩት ሁሉ የምትበሉአቸው እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ክንፍና ቅርፊት ያላቸውን ትበላላችሁ።

verses.en: And whatsoever hath not fins and scales ye may not eat; it is unclean unto you.
verses.fr: Mais vous ne mangerez d''aucun de ceux qui n''ont pas des nageoires et des écailles: vous les regarderez comme impurs.
verses.am: ክንፍና ቅርፊትም የሌላቸውን አትበሉም፤ ለእናንተ ርኩስ ናቸው።

verses.en: Of all clean birds ye shall eat.
verses.fr: Vous mangerez tout oiseau pur.
verses.am: ንጹሕ የሆኑትን ወፎች ሁሉ ብሉ።

verses.en: But these are they of which ye shall not eat: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
verses.fr: Mais voici ceux dont vous ne mangerez pas: l''aigle, l''orfraie et l''aigle de mer;
verses.am: ሊበሉ የማይገባቸው ግን እነዚህ ናቸው፤

verses.en: And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind,
verses.fr: le milan, l''autour, le vautour et ce qui est de son espèce;
verses.am: ንስር፥ ገዴ፥ ዓሣ አውጭ፥ ጭልፊት፥ ጭላት በየወገኑ፥

verses.en: And every raven after his kind,
verses.fr: le corbeau et toutes ses espèces;
verses.am: ጠላቋ፥ ዝዪ፥ በቋል በየወገኑ፥ ጕጕት፥

verses.en: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
verses.fr: l''autruche, le hibou, la mouette, l''épervier et ce qui est de son espèce;
verses.am: ጠላቋ፥ ዝዪ፥ በቋል በየወገኑ፥ ጕጕት፥

verses.en: The little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,
verses.fr: le chat-huant, la chouette et le cygne;
verses.am: ጋጋኖ፥ የውኃ ዶሮ፥ ይብራ፥ ጥምብ አንሣ አሞራ፥

verses.en: And the pelican, and the gier eagle, and the cormorant,
verses.fr: le pélican, le cormoran et le plongeon;
verses.am: እርኩም፥ ሽመላ፥ ሳቢሳ በየወገኑ፥ ጅንጅላቴ ወፍ፥ የሌሊት ወፍ።

verses.en: And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
verses.fr: la cigogne, le héron et ce qui est de son espèce, la huppe et la chauve-souris.
verses.am: የሚበርርም ተንቀሳቃሽ ሁሉ ለእናንተ ርኩስ ነው፤ አይበላም።

verses.en: And every creeping thing that flieth is unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.
verses.fr: Vous regarderez comme impur tout reptile qui vole: on n''en mangera point.
verses.am: ንጹሕ የሆኑትን ወፎች ሁሉ ብሉ።

verses.en: But of all clean fowls ye may eat.
verses.fr: Vous mangerez tout oiseau pur.
verses.am: አንተ ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ሕዝብ ነህና የበከተውን ሁሉ አትብላ፤ ይበላው ዘንድ በአገርህ ደጅ ለተቀመጠ መጻተኛ ትሰጠዋለህ፥ ወይም ለእንግዳ ትሸጠዋለህ። የፍየሉን ጠቦት በእናቱ ወተት አትቀቅል።

verses.en: Ye shall not eat of anything that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it unto the stranger that is in thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto an alien: for thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
verses.fr: Vous ne mangerez d''aucune bête morte; tu la donneras à l''étranger qui sera dans tes portes, afin qu''il la mange, ou tu la vendras à un étranger; car tu es un peuple saint pour l''Eternel, ton Dieu. Tu ne feras point cuire un chevreau dans le lait de sa mère.
verses.am: ከእርሻህ በየዓመቱ ከምታገኘው ከዘርህ ፍሬ ሁሉ አሥራት ታወጣለህ።

verses.en: Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year.
verses.fr: Tu lèveras la dîme de tout ce que produira ta semence, de ce que rapportera ton champ chaque année.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜ አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ትማር ዘንድ፥ ስሙ እንዲጠራበት በመረጠው ስፍራ በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የእህልህን የወይን ጠጅህንም የዘይትህንም አሥራት የላምህንና የበግህንም በኵራት ብላ።

verses.en: And thou shalt eat before the Lord thy God, in the place which he shall choose to place his name there, the tithe of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the firstlings of thy herds and of thy flocks; that thou mayest learn to fear the Lord thy God always.
verses.fr: Et tu mangeras devant l''Eternel, ton Dieu, dans le lieu qu''il choisira pour y faire résider son nom, la dîme de ton blé, de ton moût et de ton huile, et les premiers-nés de ton gros et de ton menu bétail, afin que tu apprennes à craindre toujours l''Eternel, ton Dieu.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በባረከህ ጊዜ፥ መንገዱ ሩቅ ቢሆን፥ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር ስሙን ያኖርበት ዘንድ የመረጠው ስፍራ ቢርቅብህ፥ ይህን ወደዚያ ለመሸከም ባትችል፥ ትሸጠዋለህ፥

verses.en: And if the way be too long for thee, so that thou art not able to carry it; or if the place be too far from thee, which the Lord thy God shall choose to set his name there, when the Lord thy God hath blessed thee:
verses.fr: Peut-être lorsque l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''aura béni, le chemin sera-t-il trop long pour que tu puisses transporter ta dîme, à cause de ton éloignement du lieu qu''aura choisi l''Eternel, ton Dieu, pour y faire résider son nom.
verses.am: የዋጋውንም ገንዘብ በእጅህ ይዘህ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ወደ መረጠው ስፍራ ትሄዳለህ።

verses.en: Then shalt thou turn it into money, and bind up the money in thine hand, and shalt go unto the place which the Lord thy God shall choose:
verses.fr: Alors, tu échangeras ta dîme contre de l''argent, tu serreras cet argent dans ta main, et tu iras au lieu que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, aura choisi.
verses.am: በዚያም በገንዘቡ ሰውነትህ የፈለገውን፥ በሬ ወይም በግ ወይም የወይን ጠጅ ወይም ብርቱ መጠጥ ሰውነትህም የሚሻውን ሁሉ ትገዛለህ፤ በዚያም በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ትበላዋለህ፥ አንተና ቤተ ሰብህም ደስ ይላችኋል።

verses.en: And thou shalt bestow that money for whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatsoever thy soul desireth: and thou shalt eat there before the Lord thy God, and thou shalt rejoice, thou, and thine household,
verses.fr: Là, tu achèteras avec l''argent tout ce que tu désireras, des boeufs, des brebis, du vin et des liqueurs fortes, tout ce qui te fera plaisir, tu mangeras devant l''Eternel, ton Dieu, et tu te réjouiras, toi et ta famille.
verses.am: ድርሻና ርስት ከአንተ ጋር ስለሌለው በአገርህ ደጅ ውስጥ ያለውን ሌዋዊ ቸል አትበል።

verses.en: And the Levite that is within thy gates; thou shalt not forsake him; for he hath no part nor inheritance with thee.
verses.fr: Tu ne délaisseras point le Lévite qui sera dans tes portes, car il n''a ni part ni héritage avec toi.
verses.am: በየሦስተኛው ዓመት መጨረሻ በዚያ ዓመት የፍሬህን አሥራት ሁሉ አምጥተህ በአገርህ ደጅ ውስጥ ታኖረዋለህ፤

verses.en: At the end of three years thou shalt bring forth all the tithe of thine increase the same year, and shalt lay it up within thy gates:
verses.fr: Au bout de trois ans, tu sortiras toute la dîme de tes produits pendant la troisième année, et tu la déposeras dans tes portes.
verses.am: ሌዋዊውም፥ ከአንተ ጋር ክፍልና ርስት የለውምና፥ በአገርህም ደጅ ያለ መጻተኛ ድሀ አደግም መበለትም መጥተው ይበላሉ ይጠግባሉም፤ ይኸውም አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በምታደርገው በእጅህ ሥራ ሁሉ ይባርክህ ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: And the Levite, (because he hath no part nor inheritance with thee,) and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, which are within thy gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the Lord thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hand which thou doest.
verses.fr: Alors viendront le Lévite, qui n''a ni part ni héritage avec toi, l''étranger, l''orphelin et la veuve, qui seront dans tes portes, et ils mangeront et se rassasieront, afin que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te bénisse dans tous les travaux que tu entreprendras de tes mains.
verses.am: ፤ ሌዋዊውም፥ ከአንተ ጋር ክፍልና ርስት የለውምና፥ በአገርህም ደጅ ያለ መጻተኛ ድሀ አደግም መበለትም መጥተው ይበላሉ ይጠግባሉም፤ ይኸውም አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በምታደርገው በእጅህ ሥራ ሁሉ ይባርክህ ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: At the end of every seven years thou shalt make a release.
verses.fr: Tous les sept ans, tu feras relâche.
verses.am: በየሰባቱ ዓመት መጨረሻ የዕዳ ምሕረት ታደርጋለህ።

verses.en: And this is the manner of the release: Every creditor that lendeth ought unto his neighbour shall release it; he shall not exact it of his neighbour, or of his brother; because it is called the Lord's release.
verses.fr: Et voici comment s''observera le relâche. Quand on aura publié le relâche en l''honneur de l''Eternel, tout créancier qui aura fait un prêt à son prochain se relâchera de son droit, il ne pressera pas son prochain et son frère pour le paiement de sa dette.
verses.am: ለምሕረቱም የሚገባ ወግ ይህ ነው፤ አበዳሪ ሁሉ ለባልንጀራው ያበደረውን ይተዋል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ይቅርታ ታውጆአልና ያበደረውን ከባልንጀራው ወይም ከወንድሙ አይሻ።

verses.en: Of a foreigner thou mayest exact it again: but that which is thine with thy brother thine hand shall release;
verses.fr: Tu pourras presser l''étranger; mais tu te relâcheras de ton droit pour ce qui t''appartiendra chez ton frère.
verses.am: ከእንግዳ ላይ ያበደርኸውን መፈለግ ትችላለህ፤ በወንድምህ ላይ ያለውን ሁሉ ግን እጅህ ይተወዋል።

verses.en: Save when there shall be no poor among you; for the Lord shall greatly bless thee in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it:
verses.fr: Toutefois, il n''y aura point d''indigent chez toi, car l''Eternel te bénira dans le pays que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te fera posséder en héritage,
verses.am: አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር ትወርሳት ዘንድ ርስት አድርጎ በሰጠህ ምድር ላይ እግዚአብሔር በእውነት ይባርክሃልና አንተ የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ፈጽመህ ብትሰማ፥ ታደርጋትም ዘንድ ዛሬ የማዝዝህን ይህችን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ብትጠብቅ፥ በመካከልህ ድሀ አይኖርም።

verses.en: Only if thou carefully hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all these commandments which I command thee this day.
verses.fr: pourvu seulement que tu obéisses à la voix de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, en mettant soigneusement en pratique tous ces commandements que je te prescris aujourd''hui.
verses.am: አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር ትወርሳት ዘንድ ርስት አድርጎ በሰጠህ ምድር ላይ እግዚአብሔር በእውነት ይባርክሃልና አንተ የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ፈጽመህ ብትሰማ፥ ታደርጋትም ዘንድ ዛሬ የማዝዝህን ይህችን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ብትጠብቅ፥ በመካከልህ ድሀ አይኖርም።

verses.en: For the Lord thy God blesseth thee, as he promised thee: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over thee.
verses.fr: L''Eternel, ton Dieu, te bénira comme il te l''a dit, tu prêteras à beaucoup de nations, et tu n''emprunteras point; tu domineras sur beaucoup de nations, et elles ne domineront point sur toi.
verses.am: አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር ተስፋ እንደ ሰጠህ ይባርክሃል፤ ለብዙ አሕዛብም ታበድራለህ፥ አንተ ግን አትበደርም፤ ብዙ አሕዛብንም ትገዛለህ፥ አንተን ግን አይገዙህም።

verses.en: If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the Lord thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not harden thine heart, nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother:
verses.fr: S''il y a chez toi quelque indigent d''entre tes frères, dans l''une de tes portes, au pays que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne, tu n''endurciras point ton coeur et tu ne fermeras point ta main devant ton frère indigent.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በሰጠህ በአገርህ ደጅ ውስጥ ከሚኖሩ ከወንድሞችህ አንዱ ቢደኸይ፥ ልብህን አታጽና፥ በድሀው ወንድምህ ላይ እጅህን አትጨብጥ።

verses.en: But thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him, and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need, in that which he wanteth.
verses.fr: Mais tu lui ouvriras ta main, et tu lui prêteras de quoi pourvoir à ses besoins.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እጅህን ለእርሱ ክፈት፥ የለመነህንም አስፈላጊውን ነገር አበድረው።

verses.en: Beware that there be not a thought in thy wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and thine eye be evil against thy poor brother, and thou givest him nought; and he cry unto the Lord against thee, and it be sin unto thee.
verses.fr: Garde-toi d''être assez méchant pour dire en ton coeur: La septième année, l''année du relâche, approche! Garde-toi d''avoir un oeil sans pitié pour ton frère indigent et de lui faire un refus. Il crierait à l''Eternel contre toi, et tu te chargerais d''un péché.
verses.am: ሰባተኛው ዓመት የዕዳ ምሕረት ዓመት ቀርቦአል ብለህ ክፉ አሳብ በልብህ እንዳታስብ፥ ለድሀውም ወንድምህ አንዳች የማትሰጥ እንዳትሆን፥ ዓይንህም በእርሱ ላይ ክፉ እንዳይሆን፥ እርሱም ወደ እግዚአብሔር በአንተ ላይ እንዳይጮህ፥ ኃጢአትም እንዳይሆንብህ ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.en: Thou shalt surely give him, and thine heart shall not be grieved when thou givest unto him: because that for this thing the Lord thy God shall bless thee in all thy works, and in all that thou puttest thine hand unto.
verses.fr: Donne-lui, et que ton coeur ne lui donne point à regret; car, à cause de cela, l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te bénira dans tous tes travaux et dans toutes tes entreprises.
verses.am: እጅህን በምትጥልበት ሁሉ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ስለዚህ በሥራህ ሁሉ ይባርክሃልና ፈጽመህ ስጠው፥ በሰጠኸውም ጊዜ በልብህ አትጸጸት።

verses.en: For the poor shall never cease out of the land: therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy, in thy land.
verses.fr: Il y aura toujours des indigents dans le pays; c''est pourquoi je te donne ce commandement: Tu ouvriras ta main à ton frère, au pauvre et à l''indigent dans ton pays.
verses.am: ድሆች ከምድሪቱ ላይ አያልቁምና ስለዚህ እኔ። በአገርህ ውስጥ ላለው ድሀ ለተቸገረውም ወንድምህ እጅህን ትከፍታለህ ብዬ አዝዝሃለሁ።

verses.en: And if thy brother, an Hebrew man, or an Hebrew woman, be sold unto thee, and serve thee six years; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free from thee.
verses.fr: Si l''un de tes frères hébreux, homme ou femme, se vend à toi, il te servira six années; mais la septième année, tu le renverras libre de chez toi.
verses.am: አንተም ወንድምህን ዕብራዊውን ወይም ዕብራዊቱን ብትገዛ ስድስት ዓመት ያገልግሉህ፤ በሰባተኛውም ዓመት ከአንተ ዘንድ አርነት አውጣው።

verses.en: And when thou sendest him out free from thee, thou shalt not let him go away empty:
verses.fr: Et lorsque tu le renverras libre de chez toi, tu ne le renverras point à vide;
verses.am: ከአንተም ዘንድ አርነት ባወጣኸው ጊዜ ባዶውን አትስደደው፤

verses.en: Thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock, and out of thy floor, and out of thy winepress: of that wherewith the Lord thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give unto him.
verses.fr: tu lui feras des présents de ton menu bétail, de ton aire, de ton pressoir, de ce que tu auras par la bénédiction de l''Eternel, ton Dieu.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከመንጋህ፥ ከአውድማህም፥ ከወይንህም መጥመቂያ ትለግስለታለህ፤ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ባረከህ መጠን ትሰጠዋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt, and the Lord thy God redeemed thee: therefore I command thee this thing to day.
verses.fr: Tu te souviendras que tu as été esclave au pays d''Egypte, et que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''a racheté; c''est pourquoi je te donne aujourd''hui ce commandement.
verses.am: አንተም በግብፅ ምድር ባሪያ እንደ ነበርህ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዳነህ አስብ፤ ስለዚህ እኔ ዛሬ ይህን ነገር አዝዝሃለሁ።

verses.en: And it shall be, if he say unto thee, I will not go away from thee; because he loveth thee and thine house, because he is well with thee;
verses.fr: Si ton esclave te dit: Je ne veux pas sortir de chez toi, -parce qu''il t''aime, toi et ta maison, et qu''il se trouve bien chez toi, -
verses.am: እርሱ ግን አንተንና ቤትህን ስለወደደ፥ ከአንተም ጋር መልካም ስለ ሆነለት። ልወጣ አልወድድም ቢል፥

verses.en: Then thou shalt take an aul, and thrust it through his ear unto the door, and he shall be thy servant for ever. And also unto thy maidservant thou shalt do likewise.
verses.fr: alors tu prendras un poinçon et tu lui perceras l''oreille contre la porte, et il sera pour toujours ton esclave. Tu feras de même pour ta servante.
verses.am: አንተ ወስፌ ወስደህ በቤትህ በር ላይ ጆሮውን ትበሳዋለህ፥ ለዘላለምም ባሪያ ይሆንልሃል። በሴት ባሪያህ ደግሞ እንዲሁ ታደርጋለህ።

verses.en: It shall not seem hard unto thee, when thou sendest him away free from thee; for he hath been worth a double hired servant to thee, in serving thee six years: and the Lord thy God shall bless thee in all that thou doest.
verses.fr: Tu ne trouveras point dur de le renvoyer libre de chez toi, car il t''a servi six ans, ce qui vaut le double du salaire d''un mercenaire; et l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te bénira dans tout ce que tu feras.
verses.am: እርሱንም አርነት ባወጣኸው ጊዜ የምንደኝነቱን ሥራ ሁለት እጥፍ አድርጎ ስድስት ዓመት አገልግሎሃልና አይክበድህ፤ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር በምትሠራው ሁሉ ይባርክሃል።

verses.en: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the Lord thy God: thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock, nor shear the firstling of thy sheep.
verses.fr: Tu consacreras à l''Eternel, ton Dieu, tout premier-né mâle qui naîtra dans ton gros et dans ton menu bétail. Tu ne travailleras point avec le premier-né de ton boeuf, et tu ne tondras point le premier-né de tes brebis.
verses.am: ላምህና በግህ የወለዱትን ተባት የሆነውን በኵራት ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር ትቀድሳለህ፤ በበሬህ በኵራት አትሥራበት፥ የበግህንም በኵራት አትሸልት።

verses.en: Thou shalt eat it before the Lord thy God year by year in the place which the Lord shall choose, thou and thy household.
verses.fr: Tu le mangeras chaque année, toi et ta famille, devant l''Eternel, ton Dieu, dans le lieu qu''il choisira.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በመረጠው ስፍራ አንተና ቤተ ሰብህ በየዓመቱ በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ብሉአቸው።

verses.en: And if there be any blemish therein, as if it be lame, or blind, or have any ill blemish, thou shalt not sacrifice it unto the Lord thy God.
verses.fr: S''il a quelque défaut, s''il est boiteux ou aveugle, ou s''il a quelque autre difformité, tu ne l''offriras point en sacrifice à l''Eternel, ton Dieu.
verses.am: ነውረኛ ወይም አንካሳ ወይም ዕውር ቢሆን፥ ወይም አንዳች ክፉ ነውር ቢኖረው፥ ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር አትሠዋው።

verses.en: Thou shalt eat it within thy gates: the unclean and the clean person shall eat it alike, as the roebuck, and as the hart.
verses.fr: Tu le mangeras dans tes portes; celui qui sera impur et celui qui sera pur en mangeront l''un et l''autre, comme on mange de la gazelle et du cerf.
verses.am: በአገርህ ደጅ ውስጥ ትበላዋለህ፤ ንጹሕ ሰው ንጹሕም ያልሆነ ሚዳቋና ዋላ እንደሚበሉ ይበሉታል።

verses.en: Only thou shalt not eat the blood thereof; thou shalt pour it upon the ground as water.
verses.fr: Seulement, tu n''en mangeras pas le sang; tu le répandras sur la terre comme de l''eau.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ደሙን እንደ ውኃ በምድር ላይ አፍስሰው እንጂ አትብላው።

verses.en: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the passover unto the Lord thy God: for in the month of Abib the Lord thy God brought thee forth out of Egypt by night.
verses.fr: Observe le mois des épis, et célèbre la Pâque en l''honneur de l''Eternel, ton Dieu; car c''est dans le mois des épis que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''a fait sortir d''Egypte, pendant la nuit.
verses.am: በአቢብ ወር አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በሌሊት ከግብፅ ስላወጣህ የአቢብን ወር ጠብቅ፥ የአምላክህንም የእግዚአብሔርን ፋሲካ አድርግበት።

verses.en: Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover unto the Lord thy God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the Lord shall choose to place his name there.
verses.fr: Tu sacrifieras la Pâque à l''Eternel, ton Dieu, tes victimes de menu et de gros bétail, dans le lieu que l''Eternel choisira pour y faire résider son nom.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በዚያ ስሙ ይጠራበት ዘንድ በመረጠው ስፍራ ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር ከበግና ከላም መንጋ ፋሲካ ሠዋ።

verses.en: Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread therewith, even the bread of affliction; for thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt in haste: that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of thy life.
verses.fr: Pendant la fête, tu ne mangeras pas du pain levé, mais tu mangeras sept jours des pains sans levain, du pain d''affliction, car c''est avec précipitation que tu es sorti du pays d''Egypte: il en sera ainsi, afin que tu te souviennes toute ta vie du jour où tu es sorti du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: የቦካውን እንጀራ ከእርሱ ጋር አትብላ፤ ከግብፅ አገር በችኰላ ስለ ወጣህ ከግብፅ አገር የወጣህበትን ቀን በዕድሜህ ሁሉ ታስብ ዘንድ የመከራን እንጀራ፥ ቂጣ እንጀራ፥ ሰባት ቀን ከእርሱ ጋር ብላ።

verses.en: And there shall be no leavened bread seen with thee in all thy coast seven days; neither shall there any thing of the flesh, which thou sacrificedst the first day at even, remain all night until the morning.
verses.fr: On ne verra point chez toi de levain, dans toute l''étendue de ton pays, pendant sept jours; et aucune partie des victimes que tu sacrifieras le soir du premier jour ne sera gardée pendant la nuit jusqu''au matin.
verses.am: ሰባት ቀንም በአገርህ ሁሉ እርሾ አይታይም፤ በመጀመሪያው ቀን ማታ ከሠዋኸው ሥጋ እስከ ነገ ድረስ ምንም አይደር።

verses.en: Thou mayest not sacrifice the passover within any of thy gates, which the Lord thy God giveth thee:
verses.fr: Tu ne pourras point sacrifier la Pâque dans l''un quelconque des lieux que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne pour demeure;
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከሰጠህ ከአገርህ ደጆች በማንኛይቱም ፋሲካን ትሠዋ ዘንድ አይገባህም።

verses.en: But at the place which the Lord thy God shall choose to place his name in, there thou shalt sacrifice the passover at even, at the going down of the sun, at the season that thou camest forth out of Egypt.
verses.fr: mais c''est dans le lieu que choisira l''Eternel, ton Dieu, pour y faire résider son nom, que tu sacrifieras la Pâque, le soir, au coucher du soleil, à l''époque de ta sortie d''Egypte.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ስሙ ይጠራበት ዘንድ በመረጠው በዚያ ስፍራ ከግብፅ በወጣህበት ወራት፥ ፀሐይ ሲገባ፥ ማታ ፋሲካን ሠዋ።

verses.en: And thou shalt roast and eat it in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose: and thou shalt turn in the morning, and go unto thy tents.
verses.fr: Tu feras cuire la victime, et tu la mangeras dans le lieu que choisira l''Eternel, ton Dieu. Et le matin, tu pourras t''en retourner et t''en aller vers tes tentes.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በመረጠው ስፍራ ታበስለዋለህ፥ ትበላውማለህ፤ በነጋውም ተነሥተህ ወደ ድንኳንህ ትሄዳለህ።

verses.en: Six days thou shalt eat unleavened bread: and on the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the Lord thy God: thou shalt do no work therein.
verses.fr: Pendant six jours, tu mangeras des pains sans levain; et le septième jour, il y aura une assemblée solennelle en l''honneur de l''Eternel, ton Dieu: tu ne feras aucun ouvrage.
verses.am: ስድስት ቀን ቂጣ እንጀራ ብላ፤ በሰባተኛውም ቀን ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር ጉባኤ ይሁን፤ ሥራን ሁሉ አታድርግበት።

verses.en: Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee: begin to number the seven weeks from such time as thou beginnest to put the sickle to the corn.
verses.fr: Tu compteras sept semaines; dès que la faucille sera mise dans les blés, tu commenceras à compter sept semaines.
verses.am: ሰባት ሳምንትም ትቈጥራለህ፤ መከሩን ማጨድ ከምትጀምርበት ቀን ጀምሮ ሰባት ሳምንት መቍጠር ትጀምራለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks unto the Lord thy God with a tribute of a freewill offering of thine hand, which thou shalt give unto the Lord thy God, according as the Lord thy God hath blessed thee:
verses.fr: Puis tu célébreras la fête des semaines, et tu feras des offrandes volontaires, selon les bénédictions que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''aura accordées.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በባረከህ መጠን በፈቃድህ የምታቀርበውን አምጥተህ ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር የሰባቱ ሱባዔ በዓል ታደርጋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt rejoice before the Lord thy God, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are among you, in the place which the Lord thy God hath chosen to place his name there.
verses.fr: Tu te réjouiras devant l''Eternel, ton Dieu, dans le lieu que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, choisira pour y faire résider son nom, toi, ton fils et ta fille, ton serviteur et ta servante, le Lévite qui sera dans tes portes, et l''étranger, l''orphelin et la veuve qui seront au milieu de toi.
verses.am: አንተ፥ ወንድ ልጅህና ሴት ልጅህ፥ ወንድ ባሪያህና ሴት ባሪያህ፥ በአገርህም ደጅ ውስጥ ያለው ሌዋዊ፥ በመካከልህም ያሉት መጻተኛና ድሀ አደግ መበለትም አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በዚያ ስሙ ይጠራበት ዘንድ በሚመርጠው ስፍራ በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.en: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt: and thou shalt observe and do these statutes.
verses.fr: Tu te souviendras que tu as été esclave en Egypte, et tu observeras et mettras ces lois en pratique.
verses.am: አንተም በግብፅ ባሪያ እንደ ነበርህ አስብ፤ ይህንንም ሥርዓት ጠብቅ፥ አድርገውም።

verses.en: Thou shalt observe the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that thou hast gathered in thy corn and thy wine:
verses.fr: Tu célébreras la fête des tabernacles pendant sept jours, quand tu recueilleras le produit de ton aire et de ton pressoir.
verses.am: ከአውድማህና ከመጥመቂያህ ፍሬህን በሰበሰብህ ጊዜ የዳስ በዓል ሰባትን ቀን ትጠብቃለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite, the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are within thy gates.
verses.fr: Tu te réjouiras à cette fête, toi, ton fils et ta fille, ton serviteur et ta servante, et le Lévite, l''étranger, l''orphelin et la veuve qui seront dans tes portes.
verses.am: አንተም፥ ወንድ ልጅህና ሴት ልጅህ፥ ወንድ ባሪያህና ሴት ባሪያህ፥ በአገርህም ደጅ ውስጥ ያለ ሌዋዊና መጻተኛ፥ ድሀ አደግና መበለትም በበዓል ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.en: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the Lord thy God in the place which the Lord shall choose: because the Lord thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase, and in all the works of thine hands, therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.
verses.fr: Tu célébreras la fête pendant sept jours en l''honneur de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, dans le lieu que choisira l''Eternel; car l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te bénira dans toutes tes récoltes et dans tout le travail de tes mains, et tu te livreras entièrement à la joie.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በፍሬህ ሁሉ በእጅህም ሥራ ሁሉ ይባርክሃልና እግዚአብሔር በመረጠው ስፍራ ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር ሰባት ቀን በዓል ታደርጋለህ፤ አንተም ፈጽሞ ደስ ይልሃል።

verses.en: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the Lord thy God in the place which he shall choose; in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles: and they shall not appear before the Lord empty:
verses.fr: Trois fois par année, tous les mâles d''entre vous se présenteront devant l''Eternel, ton Dieu, dans le lieu qu''il choisira: à la fête des pains sans levain, à la fête des semaines, et à la fête des tabernacles. On ne paraîtra point devant l''Eternel les mains vides.
verses.am: በዓመት ሦስት ጊዜ፥ በቂጣ በዓል፥ በሰባቱ ሱባዔም በዓል፥ በዳስም በዓል ወንዶችህ ሁሉ በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እርሱ በመረጠው ስፍራ ይታዩ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ባዶ እጃቸውን አይታዩ።

verses.en: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the Lord thy God which he hath given thee.
verses.fr: Chacun donnera ce qu''il pourra, selon les bénédictions que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, lui aura accordées.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በረከት እንደ ሰጠህ መጠን እያንዳንዱ ሰው እንደ ችሎታው ይስጥ።

verses.en: Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates, which the Lord thy God giveth thee, throughout thy tribes: and they shall judge the people with just judgment.
verses.fr: Tu établiras des juges et des magistrats dans toutes les villes que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne, selon tes tribus; et ils jugeront le peuple avec justice.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በሚሰጥህ በአገርህ ደጅ ሁሉ በየነገዶችህ ፈራጆችንና አለቆችን ሹም፤ ለሕዝቡም ቅን ፍርድ ይፍረዱ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not wrest judgment; thou shalt not respect persons, neither take a gift: for a gift doth blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous.
verses.fr: Tu ne porteras atteinte à aucun droit, tu n''auras point égard à l''apparence des personnes, et tu ne recevras point de présent, car les présents aveuglent les yeux des sages et corrompent les paroles des justes.
verses.am: ፍርድን አታጣምም፤ ፊት አይተህም አታድላ፤ ጉቦ የጥበበኞችን ዓይን ያሳውራልና፥ የጻድቃንንም ቃል ያጣምማልና ጉቦ አትቀበል።

verses.en: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.
verses.fr: Tu suivras ponctuellement la justice, afin que tu vives et que tu possèdes le pays que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne.
verses.am: በሕይወት ትኖር ዘንድ፥ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔርም የሚሰጥህን ምድር ትወርስ ዘንድ እውነተኛውን ፍርድ ተከተል።

verses.en: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the Lord thy God, which thou shalt make thee.
verses.fr: Tu ne fixeras aucune idole de bois à côté de l''autel que tu élèveras à l''Eternel, ton Dieu.
verses.am: ለአንተ በምትሠራው በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ አጠገብ ከማናቸውም ዛፍ የማምለኪያ ዐፀድ አድርገህ አትትከል።

verses.en: Neither shalt thou set thee up any image; which the Lord thy God hateth.
verses.fr: Tu ne dresseras point des statues, qui sont en aversion à l''Eternel, ton Dieu.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔርም የሚጠላውን ሐውልት ለአንተ አታቁም።

verses.en: Thou shalt not sacrifice unto the Lord thy God any bullock, or sheep, wherein is blemish, or any evilfavouredness: for that is an abomination unto the Lord thy God.
verses.fr: Tu n''offriras en sacrifice à l''Eternel, ton Dieu, ni boeuf, ni agneau qui ait quelque défaut ou difformité; car ce serait en abomination à l''Eternel, ton Dieu.
verses.am: በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የተጠላ ነውና ነውር ወይም ክፉ ነገር ያለበትን በሬ ወይም በግ ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር አትሠዋ።

verses.en: If there be found among you, within any of thy gates which the Lord thy God giveth thee, man or woman, that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the Lord thy God, in transgressing his covenant,
verses.fr: Il se trouvera peut-être au milieu de toi dans l''une des villes que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne, un homme ou une femme faisant ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, et transgressant son alliance;
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከሰጠህ ከአገርህ ደጆች በማንኛይቱም ውስጥ ወንድ ወይም ሴት ቢሆን ቃል ኪዳኑን በማፍረስ በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፋት የሠራ ቢገኝ፥

verses.en: And hath gone and served other gods, and worshipped them, either the sun, or moon, or any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded;
verses.fr: allant après d''autres dieux pour les servir et se prosterner devant eux, après le soleil, la lune, ou toute l''armée des cieux. Ce n''est point là ce que j''ai commandé.
verses.am: ሄዶም ሌሎች አማልክትን ያመለከ፥ እኔ ላላዘዝኋቸው ለፀሐይና ለጨረቃ ለሰማይም ሠራዊት ሁሉ የሰገደ ቢገኝ፥

verses.en: And it be told thee, and thou hast heard of it, and enquired diligently, and, behold, it be true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought in Israel:
verses.fr: Dès que tu en auras connaissance, dès que tu l''auras appris, tu feras avec soin des recherches. La chose est-elle vraie, le fait est-il établi, cette abomination a-t-elle été commise en Israël,
verses.am: ቢያወሩልህም ብትሰማም፥ ያንን ፈጽመህ መርምር፤ እነሆም፥ እውነት ቢሆን፥ በእስራኤልም መካከል እንዲህ ያለ ርኵሰት እንደ ተሠራ እርግጥ ሆኖ ቢገኝ፥

verses.en: Then shalt thou bring forth that man or that woman, which have committed that wicked thing, unto thy gates, even that man or that woman, and shalt stone them with stones, till they die.
verses.fr: alors tu feras venir à tes portes l''homme ou la femme qui sera coupable de cette mauvaise action, et tu lapideras ou puniras de mort cet homme ou cette femme.
verses.am: ይህን ክፉ ነገር የሠሩትን ያን ወንድ ወይም ያችን ሴት ወደ በርህ ታመጣቸዋለህ፥ እስኪሞቱም ድረስ በድንጋይ ትወግራቸዋለህ።

verses.en: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death; but at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.
verses.fr: Celui qui mérite la mort sera exécuté sur la déposition de deux ou de trois témoins; il ne sera pas mis à mort sur la déposition d''un seul témoin.
verses.am: በሁለት ወይም በሦስት ምስክሮች አፍ ሞት የሚገባው ይገደል፤ በአንድ ምስክር አፍ አይገደል።

verses.en: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So thou shalt put the evil away from among you.
verses.fr: La main des témoins se lèvera la première sur lui pour le faire mourir, et la main de tout le peuple ensuite. Tu ôteras ainsi le mal du milieu de toi.
verses.am: እርሱን ለመግደል በመጀመሪያ የምስክሮች እጅ በኋላም የሕዝቡ ሁሉ እጅ ትሁንበት፤ እንዲሁም ክፋቱን ከመካከልህ አስወግድ።

verses.en: If there arise a matter too hard for thee in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within thy gates: then shalt thou arise, and get thee up into the place which the Lord thy God shall choose;
verses.fr: Si une cause relative à un meurtre, à un différend, à une blessure, te paraît trop difficile à juger et fournit matière à contestation dans tes portes, tu te lèveras et tu monteras au lieu que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, choisira.
verses.am: በደምና በደም፥ በፍርድና በፍርድ፥ በመቍሰልና በመቍሰል መካከል በአገርህ ደጅ ውስጥ ሰዎች ስለሚከራከሩበት ክርክር የሚሳንህ የፍርድ ነገር ቢነሣ፥ አንተ ተነሥተህ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ወደ መረጠው ስፍራ ትወጣለህ፤

verses.en: And thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites, and unto the judge that shall be in those days, and enquire; and they shall shew thee the sentence of judgment:
verses.fr: Tu iras vers les sacrificateurs, les Lévites, et vers celui qui remplira alors les fonctions de juge; tu les consulteras, et ils te feront connaître la sentence.
verses.am: ወደ ሌዋውያን ካህናት በዚያም ዘመን ወደ ተሾመው ፈራጅ መጥተህ ትጠይቃለህ፤ እነርሱም የፍርዱን ነገር ይነግሩሃል።

verses.en: And thou shalt do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the Lord shall choose shall shew thee; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee:
verses.fr: Tu te conformeras à ce qu''ils te diront dans le lieu que choisira l''Eternel, et tu auras soin d''agir d''après tout ce qu''ils t''enseigneront.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በመረጠው ስፍራ የነገሩህን የፍርድ ነገር ታደርጋለህ፤ እንዳስተማሩህም ታደርግ ዘንድ ጠብቅ።

verses.en: According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee, and according to the judgment which they shall tell thee, thou shalt do: thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall shew thee, to the right hand, nor to the left.
verses.fr: Tu te conformeras à la loi qu''ils t''enseigneront et à la sentence qu''ils auront prononcée; tu ne te détourneras de ce qu''ils te diront ni à droite ni à gauche.
verses.am: እንዳስተማሩህም ሕግ፥ እንደ ነገሩህም ፍርድ አድርግ፤ ከነገሩህ ፍርድ ወደ ቀኝም ወደ ግራም አትበል።

verses.en: And the man that will do presumptuously, and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the Lord thy God, or unto the judge, even that man shall die: and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel.
verses.fr: L''homme qui, par orgueil, n''écoutera pas le sacrificateur placé là pour servir l''Eternel, ton Dieu, ou qui n''écoutera pas le juge, cet homme sera puni de mort. Tu ôteras ainsi le mal du milieu d''Israël,
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው ቢኰራ፥ በዚያም አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን ለማገልገል የሚቆመውን ካህኑን ወይም ፈራጁን ለመስማት ባይወድድ፥ ያ ሰው ይሙት፥ ከእስራኤልም ዘንድ ክፋትን አስወግድ፤

verses.en: And all the people shall hear, and fear, and do no more presumptuously.
verses.fr: afin que tout le peuple entende et craigne, et qu''il ne se livre plus à l''orgueil.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ሰምቶ ይፈራል፥ ከዚያም ወዲያ አይኰራም።

verses.en: When thou art come unto the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee, and shalt possess it, and shalt dwell therein, and shalt say, I will set a king over me, like as all the nations that are about me;
verses.fr: Lorsque tu seras entré dans le pays que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne, lorsque tu le posséderas, que tu y auras établi ta demeure, et que tu diras: Je veux mettre un roi sur moi, comme toutes les nations qui m''entourent, -
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ወደሚሰጥህ ምድር በገባህ፥ በወረስሃትም ጊዜ፥ በተቀመጥህባትም ጊዜ። በዙሪያዬ እንዳሉት አሕዛብ ሁሉ በላዬ ንጉሥ አነግሣለሁ ስትል፥

verses.en: Thou shalt in any wise set him king over thee, whom the Lord thy God shall choose: one from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee: thou mayest not set a stranger over thee, which is not thy brother.
verses.fr: tu mettras sur toi un roi que choisira l''Eternel, ton Dieu, tu prendras un roi du milieu de tes frères, tu ne pourras pas te donner un étranger, qui ne soit pas ton frère.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር የመረጠውን በላይህ ታነግሣለህ፤ ከወንድሞችህ መካከል የሆነውን በአንተ ላይ ንጉሥ ታነግሣለህ፤ ወንድምህ ያልሆነውን ከሌላ ወገን ሰው በላይህ ንጉሥ ታደርግ ዘንድ አይገባህም።

verses.en: But he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he should multiply horses: forasmuch as the Lord hath said unto you, Ye shall henceforth return no more that way.
verses.fr: Mais qu''il n''ait pas un grand nombre de chevaux; et qu''il ne ramène pas le peuple en Egypte pour avoir beaucoup de chevaux; car l''Eternel vous a dit: Vous ne retournerez plus par ce chemin-là.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለእርሱ ፈረሶችን አያበዛም፤ እግዚአብሔር። በዚያ መንገድ ደግማችሁ አትመለሱም ብሎአችኋልና ፈረሶችን ለማብዛት ሕዝቡን ወደ ግብፅ አይመልስም።

verses.en: Neither shall he multiply wives to himself, that his heart turn not away: neither shall he greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.
verses.fr: Qu''il n''ait pas un grand nombre de femmes, afin que son coeur ne se détourne point; et qu''il ne fasse pas de grands amas d''argent et d''or.
verses.am: ልቡም እንዳይስት ሚስቶችን ለእርሱ አያበዛም፤ ወርቅና ብርም ለእርሱ እጅግ አያበዛም።

verses.en: And it shall be, when he sitteth upon the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book out of that which is before the priests the Levites:
verses.fr: Quand il s''assiéra sur le trône de son royaume, il écrira pour lui, dans un livre, une copie de cette loi, qu''il prendra auprès des sacrificateurs, les Lévites.
verses.am: በመንግሥቱም ዙፋን በተቀመጠ ጊዜ ከሌዋውያን ካህናት ወስዶ ይህን ሕግ ለራሱ በመጽሐፍ ይጻፍ።

verses.en: And it shall be with him, and he shall read therein all the days of his life: that he may learn to fear the Lord his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them:
verses.fr: Il devra l''avoir avec lui et y lire tous les jours de sa vie, afin qu''il apprenne à craindre l''Eternel, son Dieu, à observer et à mettre en pratique toutes les paroles de cette loi et toutes ces ordonnances;
verses.am: አምላኩን እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ይማር ዘንድ፥ የዚህን ሕግ ቃል ሁሉ ይህችንም ሥርዓት ጠብቆ ያደርግ ዘንድ፥ ልቡ በወንድሞቹ ላይ እንዳይኰራ ከትእዛዙም ቀኝና ግራ እንዳይል፥ እርሱም ልጆቹም በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ረጅም ዘመን ይነግሡ ዘንድ መጽሐፉ ከእርሱ ጋር ይኑር፥ ዕድሜውንም ሁሉ ያንብበው።

verses.en: That his heart be not lifted up above his brethren, and that he turn not aside from the commandment, to the right hand, or to the left: to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he, and his children, in the midst of Israel.
verses.fr: afin que son coeur ne s''élève point au-dessus de ses frères, et qu''il ne se détourne de ces commandements ni à droite ni à gauche; afin qu''il prolonge ses jours dans son royaume, lui et ses enfants, au milieu d''Israël.
verses.am: አምላኩን እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ይማር ዘንድ፥ የዚህን ሕግ ቃል ሁሉ ይህችንም ሥርዓት ጠብቆ ያደርግ ዘንድ፥ ልቡ በወንድሞቹ ላይ እንዳይኰራ ከትእዛዙም ቀኝና ግራ እንዳይል፥ እርሱም ልጆቹም በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ረጅም ዘመን ይነግሡ ዘንድ መጽሐፉ ከእርሱ ጋር ይኑር፥ ዕድሜውንም ሁሉ ያንብበው።

verses.en: The priests the Levites, and all the tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel: they shall eat the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and his inheritance.
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs, les Lévites, la tribu entière de Lévi, n''auront ni part ni héritage avec Israël; ils se nourriront des sacrifices consumés par le feu en l''honneur de l''Eternel et de l''héritage de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለሌዋውያን ካህናት፥ ለሌዊም ነገድ ሁሉ ከእስራኤል ጋር ድርሻና ርስት አይሆንላቸውም፤ በእሳት ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቀርበውን መሥዋዕቱንና ርስቱን ይበላሉ።

verses.en: Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren: the Lord is their inheritance, as he hath said unto them.
verses.fr: Ils n''auront point d''héritage au milieu de leurs frères: l''Eternel sera leur héritage, comme il le leur a dit.
verses.am: በወንድሞቻቸውም መካከል ርስት አይሆንላቸውም፤ እርሱ እንደተናገራቸው ርስታቸው እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: And this shall be the priest's due from the people, from them that offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder, and the two cheeks, and the maw.
verses.fr: Voici quel sera le droit des sacrificateurs sur le peuple, sur ceux qui offriront un sacrifice, un boeuf ou un agneau: on donnera au sacrificateur l''épaule, les mâchoires et l''estomac.
verses.am: በሬ ወይም በግ ለመሥዋዕት ከሚያቀርቡት ሕዝብ የካህናቱ ወግ ይህ ይሆናል፤ ወርቹንና ሁለቱን ጉንጮቹን ጨጓራውንም ለካህኑ ይሰጣሉ።

verses.en: The firstfruit also of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give him.
verses.fr: Tu lui donneras les prémices de ton blé, de ton moût et de ton huile, et les prémices de la toison de tes brebis;
verses.am: የእህልህን የወይን ጠጅህን የዘይትህንም በኵራት፥ አስቀድሞም የተሸለተውን የበግህን ጠጕር ለእርሱ ትሰጣለህ።

verses.en: For the Lord thy God hath chosen him out of all thy tribes, to stand to minister in the name of the Lord, him and his sons for ever.
verses.fr: car c''est lui que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, a choisi entre toutes les tribus, pour qu''il fasse le service au nom de l''Eternel, lui et ses fils, à toujours.
verses.am: እርሱ ከልጆቹ ጋር ተነሥቶ በእግዚአብሔር ስም ለዘላለም ያገለግል ዘንድ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከነገዶችህ ሁሉ ስለ መረጠው ነው።

verses.en: And if a Levite come from any of thy gates out of all Israel, where he sojourned, and come with all the desire of his mind unto the place which the Lord shall choose;
verses.fr: Lorsque le Lévite quittera l''une de tes portes, le lieu quelconque où il demeure en Israël, pour se rendre, selon la plénitude de son désir, au lieu que choisira l''Eternel,
verses.am: አንድ ሌዋዊ ሰው ከሚቀመጥባቸው በእስራኤል ሁሉ ዘንድ ካሉት ከአገር ደጆች ከአንዲቱ ቢወጣ፥ በፍጹም ፈቃድም እግዚአብሔር ወደ መረጠው ስፍራ ቢመጣ፥

verses.en: Then he shall minister in the name of the Lord his God, as all his brethren the Levites do, which stand there before the Lord.
verses.fr: et qu''il fera le service au nom de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, comme tous ses frères les Lévites qui se tiennent là devant l''Eternel,
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንደሚቆሙት እንደ ወንድሞቹ እንደ ሌዋውያን ሁሉ በአምላኩ በእግዚአብሔር ስም ያገለግላል።

verses.en: They shall have like portions to eat, beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony.
verses.fr: il recevra pour sa nourriture une portion égale à la leur, et jouira, en outre, des revenus de la vente de son patrimoine.
verses.am: ከተሸጠው ከአባቶቹ ከብት ዋጋ ሌላ እንደ ባልንጀሮቹ ከመብል ድርሻውን ይወስዳል።

verses.en: When thou art come into the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations.
verses.fr: Lorsque tu seras entré dans le pays que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne, tu n''apprendras point à imiter les abominations de ces nations-là.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ወደሚሰጥህ ምድር በገባህ ጊዜ እነዚያ አሕዛብ የሚያደርጉትን ርኵሰት ታደርግ ዘንድ አትማር።

verses.en: There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch.
verses.fr: Qu''on ne trouve chez toi personne qui fasse passer son fils ou sa fille par le feu, personne qui exerce le métier de devin, d''astrologue, d''augure, de magicien,
verses.am: ወንድ ልጁን ሴት ልጁን በእሳት የሚያሳልፍ፥ ምዋርተኛም፥ ሞራ ገላጭም፥

verses.en: Or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer.
verses.fr: d''enchanteur, personne qui consulte ceux qui évoquent les esprits ou disent la bonne aventure, personne qui interroge les morts.
verses.am: አስማተኛም፥ መተተኛም፥ በድግምት የሚጠነቍልም፥ መናፍስትንም የሚጠራ፥ ጠንቋይም፥ ሙታን ሳቢም በአንተ ዘንድ አይገኝ።

verses.en: For all that do these things are an abomination unto the Lord: and because of these abominations the Lord thy God doth drive them out from before thee.
verses.fr: Car quiconque fait ces choses est en abomination à l''Eternel; et c''est à cause de ces abominations que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, va chasser ces nations devant toi.
verses.am: ይህንም የሚያደርግ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የተጠላ ነው፤ ስለዚህም ርኵሰት አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከፊትህ ያሳድዳቸዋል።

verses.en: Thou shalt be perfect with the Lord thy God.
verses.fr: Tu seras entièrement à l''Eternel, ton Dieu.
verses.am: አንተ ግን በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ፍጹም ሁን።

verses.en: For these nations, which thou shalt possess, hearkened unto observers of times, and unto diviners: but as for thee, the Lord thy God hath not suffered thee so to do.
verses.fr: Car ces nations que tu chasseras écoutent les astrologues et les devins; mais à toi, l''Eternel, ton Dieu, ne le permet pas.
verses.am: የምትወርሳቸው እነዚህ አሕዛብ ሞራ ገላጮችንና ምዋርተኞችን ያዳምጣሉ፤ አንተ ግን እንዲሁ ታደርግ ዘንድ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከልክሎሃል።

verses.en: The Lord thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;
verses.fr: L''Eternel, ton Dieu, te suscitera du milieu de toi, d''entre tes frères, un prophète comme moi: vous l''écouterez!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለኝ። የተናገሩት መልካም ነው፤

verses.en: According to all that thou desiredst of the Lord thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, Let me not hear again the voice of the Lord my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I die not.
verses.fr: Il répondra ainsi à la demande que tu fis à l''Eternel, ton Dieu, à Horeb, le jour de l''assemblée, quand tu disais: Que je n''entende plus la voix de l''Eternel, mon Dieu, et que je ne voie plus ce grand feu, afin de ne pas mourir.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለኝ። የተናገሩት መልካም ነው፤

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me, They have well spoken that which they have spoken.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: Ce qu''ils ont dit est bien.
verses.am: ከወንድሞቻቸው መካከል እንደ አንተ ያለ ነቢይ አስነሣላቸዋለሁ፤ ቃሌንም በአፉ አደርጋለሁ፥ ያዘዝሁትንም ቃል ሁሉ ይነግራቸዋል፤

verses.en: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren, like unto thee, and will put my words in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him.
verses.fr: Je leur susciterai du milieu de leurs frères un prophète comme toi, je mettrai mes paroles dans sa bouche, et il leur dira tout ce que je lui commanderai.
verses.am: በስሜም የሚናገረውን ቃሌን የማይሰማውን ሰው እኔ እበቀልለታለሁ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever will not hearken unto my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.
verses.fr: Et si quelqu''un n''écoute pas mes paroles qu''il dira en mon nom, c''est moi qui lui en demanderai compte.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ይናገር ዘንድ ያላዘዝሁትን በስሜ በድፍረት የሚናገር ወይም በሌላ አማልክት ስም የሚናገር ነቢይ፥ እርሱ ይገደል።

verses.en: But the prophet, which shall presume to speak a word in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or that shall speak in the name of other gods, even that prophet shall die.
verses.fr: Mais le prophète qui aura l''audace de dire en mon nom une parole que je ne lui aurai point commandé de dire, ou qui parlera au nom d''autres dieux, ce prophète-là sera puni de mort.
verses.am: በልብህም። እግዚአብሔር ያልተናገውን ቃል እናውቅ ዘንድ እንዴት ይቻለናል? ብትል፥

verses.en: And if thou say in thine heart, How shall we know the word which the Lord hath not spoken?
verses.fr: Peut-être diras-tu dans ton coeur: Comment connaîtrons-nous la parole que l''Eternel n''aura point dite?
verses.am: ነቢዩ በእግዚአብሔር ስም በተናገረ ጊዜ የተናገረው ነገር ባይሆን ባይመጣም፥ ያ ነገር እግዚአብሔር ያልተናገረው ነው፤ ነቢዩ በድፍረቱ ተናግሮታል እርሱን አትፍራው።

verses.en: When a prophet speaketh in the name of the Lord, if the thing follow not, nor come to pass, that is the thing which the Lord hath not spoken, but the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously: thou shalt not be afraid of him.
verses.fr: Quand ce que dira le prophète n''aura pas lieu et n''arrivera pas, ce sera une parole que l''Eternel n''aura point dite. C''est par audace que le prophète l''aura dite: n''aie pas peur de lui. Deutéronome
verses.am: ፤ ነቢዩ በእግዚአብሔር ስም በተናገረ ጊዜ የተናገረው ነገር ባይሆን ባይመጣም፥ ያ ነገር እግዚአብሔር ያልተናገረው ነው፤ ነቢዩ በድፍረቱ ተናግሮታል እርሱን አትፍራው።

verses.en: When the Lord thy God hath cut off the nations, whose land the Lord thy God giveth thee, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their cities, and in their houses;
verses.fr: Lorsque l''Eternel, ton Dieu, aura exterminé les nations dont l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne le pays, lorsque tu les auras chassées et que tu habiteras dans leurs villes et dans leurs maisons,
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ምድራቸውን የሚሰጥህን አሕዛብ ባጠፋ ጊዜ፥ በወረስሃትም ጊዜ፥ በከተሞቻቸውና በቤቶቻቸውም በተቀመጥህ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Thou shalt separate three cities for thee in the midst of thy land, which the Lord thy God giveth thee to possess it.
verses.fr: tu sépareras trois villes au milieu du pays dont l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne la possession.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ርስት አድርጎ በሚሰጥህ በምድርህ መካከል ሦስት ከተሞችን ለራስህ ትለያለህ።

verses.en: Thou shalt prepare thee a way, and divide the coasts of thy land, which the Lord thy God giveth thee to inherit, into three parts, that every slayer may flee thither.
verses.fr: Tu établiras des routes, et tu diviseras en trois parties le territoire du pays que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, va te donner en héritage. Il en sera ainsi afin que tout meurtrier puisse s''enfuir dans ces villes.
verses.am: ነፍሰ ገዳይ ይሸሽባቸው ዘንድ ወደ እነርሱ የሚወስደውን መንገድ ታዘጋጃለህ፥ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር የሚያወርስህን ምድር ከሦስት አድርገህ ትከፍላለህ።

verses.en: And this is the case of the slayer, which shall flee thither, that he may live: Whoso killeth his neighbour ignorantly, whom he hated not in time past;
verses.fr: Cette loi s''appliquera au meurtrier qui s''enfuira là pour sauver sa vie, lorsqu''il aura involontairement tué son prochain, sans avoir été auparavant son ennemi.
verses.am: የነፍሰ ገዳይ ወግ ይህ ነው፤ አስቀድሞ ጠላቱ ሳይሆን ባልንጀራውን ሳያስብ የገደለ ወደዚያ ሸሽቶ በሕይወት ይኑር።

verses.en: As when a man goeth into the wood with his neighbour to hew wood, and his hand fetcheth a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree, and the head slippeth from the helve, and lighteth upon his neighbour, that he die; he shall flee unto one of those cities, and live:
verses.fr: Un homme, par exemple, va couper du bois dans la forêt avec un autre homme; la hache en main, il s''élance pour abattre un arbre; le fer échappe du manche, atteint le compagnon de cet homme, et lui donne la mort. Alors il s''enfuira dans l''une de ces villes pour sauver sa vie,
verses.am: ሰው ከባልንጀራው ጋር እንጨት ሊቈርጥ ወደ ዱር ቢሄድ፥ ዛፉንም ሊቈርጥ ምሳሩን ሲያነሣ ብረቱ ከእጀታው ቢወልቅ፥ ባልንጀራውንም እስኪሞት ድረስ ቢመታው፥ ደም ተበቃዩ ነፍሰ ገዳዩን በልቡ ተናድዶ እንዳያሳድደው መንገዱም ሩቅ ስለ ሆነ አግኝቶ እንዳይገድለው፥ ከእነዚህ ከተሞች ወደ አንዲቱ ሸሽቶ በሕይወት ይኖራል፤ አስቀድሞ ጠላቱ፤ አልነበረምና ሞት አይገባውም።

verses.en: Lest the avenger of the blood pursue the slayer, while his heart is hot, and overtake him, because the way is long, and slay him; whereas he was not worthy of death, inasmuch as he hated him not in time past.
verses.fr: de peur que le vengeur du sang, échauffé par la colère et poursuivant le meurtrier, ne finisse par l''atteindre s''il y avait à faire beaucoup de chemin, et ne frappe mortellement celui qui ne mérite pas la mort, puisqu''il n''était point auparavant l''ennemi de son prochain.
verses.am: ሰው ከባልንጀራው ጋር እንጨት ሊቈርጥ ወደ ዱር ቢሄድ፥ ዛፉንም ሊቈርጥ ምሳሩን ሲያነሣ ብረቱ ከእጀታው ቢወልቅ፥ ባልንጀራውንም እስኪሞት ድረስ ቢመታው፥ ደም ተበቃዩ ነፍሰ ገዳዩን በልቡ ተናድዶ እንዳያሳድደው መንገዱም ሩቅ ስለ ሆነ አግኝቶ እንዳይገድለው፥ ከእነዚህ ከተሞች ወደ አንዲቱ ሸሽቶ በሕይወት ይኖራል፤ አስቀድሞ ጠላቱ፤ አልነበረምና ሞት አይገባውም።

verses.en: Wherefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt separate three cities for thee.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je te donne cet ordre: Tu sépareras trois villes.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እኔ። ለአንተ ሦስት ከተሞችን ለይ ብዬ አዝዤሃለሁ።

verses.en: And if the Lord thy God enlarge thy coast, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, and give thee all the land which he promised to give unto thy fathers;
verses.fr: Lorsque l''Eternel, ton Dieu, aura élargi tes frontières, comme il l''a juré à tes pères, et qu''il t''aura donné tout le pays qu''il a promis à tes pères de te donner, -
verses.am: አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር ለአባቶችህ እንደ ማለላቸው ዳርቻህን ቢያሰፋ፥ ይሰጣቸውም ዘንድ ለአባቶችህ የተናገረውን ምድር ሁሉ ቢሰጥህ፥

verses.en: If thou shalt keep all these commandments to do them, which I command thee this day, to love the Lord thy God, and to walk ever in his ways; then shalt thou add three cities more for thee, beside these three:
verses.fr: pourvu que tu observes et mettes en pratique tous ces commandements que je te prescris aujourd''hui, en sorte que tu aimes l''Eternel, ton Dieu, et que tu marches toujours dans ses voies, -tu ajouteras encore trois villes à ces trois-là,
verses.am: ሰው ግን ባልንጀራውን ቢጠላ፥ ቢሸምቅበትም፥ ተነሥቶም እስኪሞት ድረስ ቢመታው፥ ከእነዚህም ከተሞች ወደ አንዲቱ ቢሸሽ፥

verses.en: That innocent blood be not shed in thy land, which the Lord thy God giveth thee for an inheritance, and so blood be upon thee.
verses.fr: afin que le sang innocent ne soit pas répandu au milieu du pays que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne pour héritage, et que tu ne sois pas coupable de meurtre.
verses.am: ሰው ግን ባልንጀራውን ቢጠላ፥ ቢሸምቅበትም፥ ተነሥቶም እስኪሞት ድረስ ቢመታው፥ ከእነዚህም ከተሞች ወደ አንዲቱ ቢሸሽ፥

verses.en: But if any man hate his neighbour, and lie in wait for him, and rise up against him, and smite him mortally that he die, and fleeth into one of these cities:
verses.fr: Mais si un homme s''enfuit dans une de ces villes, après avoir dressé des embûches à son prochain par inimitié contre lui, après l''avoir attaqué et frappé de manière à causer sa mort,
verses.am: የከተማው ሽማግሌዎች ይልካሉ፥ ከተማጠነበትም ከተማ ይነጥቁታል፥ እንዲሞትም በደም ተበቃዩ እጅ አሳልፈው ይሰጡታል።

verses.en: Then the elders of his city shall send and fetch him thence, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.
verses.fr: les anciens de sa ville l''enverront saisir et le livreront entre les mains du vengeur du sang, afin qu''il meure.
verses.am: ዓይንህ አትራራለት፤ ነገር ግን መልካም ይሆንልህ ዘንድ ንጹሑን ደም ከእስራኤል ታስወግዳለህ።

verses.en: Thine eye shall not pity him, but thou shalt put away the guilt of innocent blood from Israel, that it may go well with thee.
verses.fr: Tu ne jetteras pas sur lui un regard de pitié, tu feras disparaître d''Israël le sang innocent, et tu seras heureux.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ትወርሳት ዘንድ በሚሰጥህ ምድር በምትወርሳት ርስትህ የቀደሙ ሰዎች የተከሉትን የባልንጀራህን የድንበር ምልክት አትንቀል።

verses.en: Thou shalt not remove thy neighbour's landmark, which they of old time have set in thine inheritance, which thou shalt inherit in the land that the Lord thy God giveth thee to possess it.
verses.fr: Tu ne reculeras point les bornes de ton prochain, posées par tes ancêtres, dans l''héritage que tu auras au pays dont l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne la possession.
verses.am: ስለ በደል ሁሉ፥ ክፉ በማድረግም ስለ ሠራት ኃጢአት ሁሉ በማንም ላይ አንድ ምስክር አይቁም፤ በሁለት ምስክሮች ወይም በሦስት ምስክሮች አፍ ነገር ሁሉ ይጸናል።

verses.en: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin, in any sin that he sinneth: at the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall the matter be established.
verses.fr: Un seul témoin ne suffira pas contre un homme pour constater un crime ou un péché, quel qu''il soit; un fait ne pourra s''établir que sur la déposition de deux ou de trois témoins.
verses.am: በዓመፃ ይከስሰው ዘንድ በሰው ላይ ሐሰተኛ ምስክር ቢቆም፥

verses.en: If a false witness rise up against any man to testify against him that which is wrong;
verses.fr: Lorsqu''un faux témoin s''élèvera contre quelqu''un pour l''accuser d''un crime,
verses.am: ሁለቱ ጠበኞች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በካህናቱና በዚያ ዘመን በሚፈርዱ ፈራጆች ፊት ይቆማሉ፤

verses.en: Then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before the Lord, before the priests and the judges, which shall be in those days;
verses.fr: les deux hommes en contestation comparaîtront devant l''Eternel, devant les sacrificateurs et les juges alors en fonctions.
verses.am: ፈራጆቹም አጥብቀው ይመረምራሉ፤ ያም ምስክር ሐሰተኛ ምስክር ሆኖ በወንድሙ ላይ በሐሰት ተናግሮ ቢገኝ፥

verses.en: And the judges shall make diligent inquisition: and, behold, if the witness be a false witness, and hath testified falsely against his brother;
verses.fr: Les juges feront avec soin des recherches. Le témoin est-il un faux témoin, a-t-il fait contre son frère une fausse déposition,
verses.am: በወንድሙ ላይ ያደርገው ዘንድ ያሰበውን በእርሱ ላይ ትመልሱበታላችሁ፤ እንዲሁም ከአንተ መካከል ክፋቱን ታስወግዳለህ።

verses.en: Then shall ye do unto him, as he had thought to have done unto his brother: so shalt thou put the evil away from among you.
verses.fr: alors vous le traiterez comme il avait dessein de traiter son frère. Tu ôteras ainsi le mal du milieu de toi.
verses.am: የቀሩትም ሰምተው ይፈራሉ፥ እንደዚህ ያለውንም ክፋት ከመካከልህ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ደግሞ አያደርጉም።

verses.en: And those which remain shall hear, and fear, and shall henceforth commit no more any such evil among you.
verses.fr: Les autres entendront et craindront, et l''on ne commettra plus un acte aussi criminel au milieu de toi.
verses.am: ዓይንህም አትራራለት፤ ነፍስ በነፍስ፥ ዓይን በዓይን፥ ጥርስ በጥርስ፥ እጅ በእጅ፥ እግር በእግር፥ ይመለሳል።

verses.en: And thine eye shall not pity; but life shall go for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
verses.fr: Tu ne jetteras aucun regard de pitié: oeil pour oeil, dent pour dent, main pour main, pied pour pied.
verses.am: ፤ ዓይንህም አትራራለት፤ ነፍስ በነፍስ፥ ዓይን በዓይን፥ ጥርስ በጥርስ፥ እጅ በእጅ፥ እግር በእግር፥ ይመለሳል።

verses.en: When thou goest out to battle against thine enemies, and seest horses, and chariots, and a people more than thou, be not afraid of them: for the Lord thy God is with thee, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Lorsque tu iras à la guerre contre tes ennemis, et que tu verras des chevaux et des chars, et un peuple plus nombreux que toi, tu ne les craindras point; car l''Eternel, ton Dieu, qui t''a fait monter du pays d''Egypte, est avec toi.
verses.am: ጠላቶችህን ለመውጋት በወጣህ ጊዜ፥ ፈረሶችንና ሰረገሎችን ሕዝቡንም ከአንተ ይልቅ በዝተው ባየህ ጊዜ፥ ከግብፅ አገር ያወጣህ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ነውና አትፍራቸው።

verses.en: And it shall be, when ye are come nigh unto the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak unto the people,
verses.fr: A l''approche du combat, le sacrificateur s''avancera et parlera au peuple.
verses.am: ወደ ሰልፍም በቀረባችሁ ጊዜ ካህኑ ይቅረብ ለሕዝቡም እንዲህ ብሎ ይንገራቸው።

verses.en: And shall say unto them, Hear, O Israel, ye approach this day unto battle against your enemies: let not your hearts faint, fear not, and do not tremble, neither be ye terrified because of them;
verses.fr: Il leur dira: Ecoute, Israël! Vous allez aujourd''hui livrer bataille à vos ennemis. Que votre coeur ne se trouble point; soyez sans crainte, ne vous effrayez pas, ne vous épouvantez pas devant eux.
verses.am: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ስሙ፤ ዛሬ ጠላቶቻችሁን ለመውጋት ትቀርባላችሁ፤ ልባችሁ አይታወክ፥ አትፍሩ፥ አትንቀጥቀጡ፥ በፊታቸውም አትደንግጡ፤

verses.en: For the Lord your God is he that goeth with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel, votre Dieu, marche avec vous, pour combattre vos ennemis, pour vous sauver.
verses.am: ከእናንተ ጋር የሚሄድ፥ ያድናችሁም ዘንድ ጠላቶቻችሁን ስለ እናንተ የሚወጋ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ነውና።

verses.en: And the officers shall speak unto the people, saying, What man is there that hath built a new house, and hath not dedicated it? let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man dedicate it.
verses.fr: Les officiers parleront ensuite au peuple et diront: Qui est-ce qui a bâti une maison neuve, et ne s''y est point encore établi? Qu''il s''en aille et retourne chez lui, de peur qu''il ne meure dans la bataille et qu''un autre ne s''y établisse.
verses.am: አለቆችም ለሕዝቡ እንዲህ ብለው ይናገሩ። አዲስ ቤት ሠርቶ ያላስመረቀ ሰው ቢኖር በሰልፍ እንዳይሞት ሌላም ሰው እንዳያስመርቀው ወደ ቤቱ ተመልሶ ይሂድ።

verses.en: And what man is he that hath planted a vineyard, and hath not yet eaten of it? let him also go and return unto his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man eat of it.
verses.fr: Qui est-ce qui a planté une vigne, et n''en a point encore joui? Qu''il s''en aille et retourne chez lui, de peur qu''il ne meure dans la bataille et qu''un autre n''en jouisse.
verses.am: ወይንም ተክሎ ፍሬውንም ያልበላ ሰው ቢኖር በሰልፍ እንዳይሞት ሌላም ሰው ፍሬውን እንዳይበላ ወደ ቤቱ ተመልሶ ይሂድ።

verses.en: And what man is there that hath betrothed a wife, and hath not taken her? let him go and return unto his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man take her.
verses.fr: Qui est-ce qui a fiancé une femme, et ne l''a point encore prise? Qu''il s''en aille et retourne chez lui, de peur qu''il ne meure dans la bataille et qu''un autre ne la prenne.
verses.am: ሚስትም አጭቶ ያላገባትም ሰው ቢኖር በሰልፍ እንዳይሞት ሌላም ሰው እንዳያገባት ወደ ቤቱ ተመልሶ ይሂድ።

verses.en: And the officers shall speak further unto the people, and they shall say, What man is there that is fearful and fainthearted? let him go and return unto his house, lest his brethren's heart faint as well as his heart.
verses.fr: Les officiers continueront à parler au peuple, et diront: Qui est-ce qui a peur et manque de courage? Qu''il s''en aille et retourne chez lui, afin que ses frères ne se découragent pas comme lui.
verses.am: አለቆቹም ደግሞ ጨምረው። ማንም ፈሪና ድንጉጥ ሰው ቢሆን እርሱ ፈርቶ የወንድሞቹን ልብ ደግሞ እንዳያስፈራ ወደ ቤቱ ተመልሶ ይሂድ ብለው ለሕዝቡ ይናገሩ።

verses.en: And it shall be, when the officers have made an end of speaking unto the people that they shall make captains of the armies to lead the people.
verses.fr: Quand les officiers auront achevé de parler au peuple, ils placeront les chefs des troupes à la tête du peuple.
verses.am: አለቆቹም ለሕዝቡ ነግረው በጨረሱ ጊዜ በየጭፍራው በሕዝቡ ላይ የጦር አለቆችን ይሹሙ።

verses.en: When thou comest nigh unto a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace unto it.
verses.fr: Quand tu t''approcheras d''une ville pour l''attaquer, tu lui offriras la paix.
verses.am: ለመዋጋት ወደ አንዲት ከተማ በደረስህ ጊዜ አስቀድመህ በዕርቅ ቃል ጥራቸው።

verses.en: And it shall be, if it make thee answer of peace, and open unto thee, then it shall be, that all the people that is found therein shall be tributaries unto thee, and they shall serve thee.
verses.fr: Si elle accepte la paix et t''ouvre ses portes, tout le peuple qui s''y trouvera te sera tributaire et asservi.
verses.am: የዕርቅ ቃልም ቢመልሱልህ ደጅም ቢከፍቱልህ፥ በከተማ ውስጥ ያለው ሕዝብ ሁሉ ይገብሩልህ ያገልግሉህም።

verses.en: And if it will make no peace with thee, but will make war against thee, then thou shalt besiege it:
verses.fr: Si elle n''accepte pas la paix avec toi et qu''elle veuille te faire la guerre, alors tu l''assiégeras.
verses.am: የዕርቅ ቃልም ባይመልሱልህ ከአንተም ጋር መዋጋት ቢወድዱ፥ አንተ ከተማይቱን ትከብባለህ ታስጨንቃትማለህ፤

verses.en: And when the Lord thy God hath delivered it into thine hands, thou shalt smite every male thereof with the edge of the sword:
verses.fr: Et après que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, l''aura livrée entre tes mains, tu en feras passer tous les mâles au fil de l''épée.
verses.am: አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር በእጅህ አሳልፎ በሰጣት ጊዜ፥ በእርስዋ ያሉትን ወንዶች ሁሉ በሰይፍ ስለት ትገድላቸዋለህ፤

verses.en: But the women, and the little ones, and the cattle, and all that is in the city, even all the spoil thereof, shalt thou take unto thyself; and thou shalt eat the spoil of thine enemies, which the Lord thy God hath given thee.
verses.fr: Mais tu prendras pour toi les femmes, les enfants, le bétail, tout ce qui sera dans la ville, tout son butin, et tu mangeras les dépouilles de tes ennemis que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''aura livrés.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሴቶቹንና ሕፃናትን እንስሶቹንም በከተማይቱም ያለውን ምርኮ ሁሉ በዝብዘህ ለአንተ ትወስዳለህ፤ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር የሚሰጥህን የጠላቶችህን ምርኮ ትበላለህ።

verses.en: Thus shalt thou do unto all the cities which are very far off from thee, which are not of the cities of these nations.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que tu agiras à l''égard de toutes les villes qui sont très éloignées de toi, et qui ne font point partie des villes de ces nations-ci.
verses.am: የእነዚህ አሕዛብ ከተሞች ባይደሉት ከአንተ እጅግ በራቁት ከተሞች ሁሉ እንዲሁ ታደርጋለህ።

verses.en: But of the cities of these people, which the Lord thy God doth give thee for an inheritance, thou shalt save alive nothing that breatheth:
verses.fr: Mais dans les villes de ces peuples dont l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne le pays pour héritage, tu ne laisseras la vie à rien de ce qui respire.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ርስት አድርጎ ከሚሰጥህ ከእነዚህ አሕዛብ ከተሞች ምንም ነፍስ አታድንም።

verses.en: But thou shalt utterly destroy them; namely, the Hittites, and the Amorites, the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee:
verses.fr: Car tu dévoueras ces peuples par interdit, les Héthiens, les Amoréens, les Cananéens, les Phéréziens, les Héviens, et les Jébusiens, comme l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te l''a ordonné,
verses.am: ከተማይቱን ለመውሰድ በመውጋት ብዙ ቀን ከብበህ ባስጨነቅሃት ጊዜ፥ ምሳርህን አንሥተህ ዛፎችዋን አትቍረጥ፤ ከእነርሱ ትበላለህና አትቍረጣቸው፤ ከብበህ የምታጠፋው የምድር ዛፍ ሰው መሆኑ ነውን?

verses.en: That they teach you not to do after all their abominations, which they have done unto their gods; so should ye sin against the Lord your God.
verses.fr: afin qu''ils ne vous apprennent pas à imiter toutes les abominations qu''ils font pour leurs dieux, et que vous ne péchiez point contre l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: ከተማይቱን ለመውሰድ በመውጋት ብዙ ቀን ከብበህ ባስጨነቅሃት ጊዜ፥ ምሳርህን አንሥተህ ዛፎችዋን አትቍረጥ፤ ከእነርሱ ትበላለህና አትቍረጣቸው፤ ከብበህ የምታጠፋው የምድር ዛፍ ሰው መሆኑ ነውን?

verses.en: When thou shalt besiege a city a long time, in making war against it to take it, thou shalt not destroy the trees thereof by forcing an axe against them: for thou mayest eat of them, and thou shalt not cut them down (for the tree of the field is man's life) to employ them in the siege:
verses.fr: Si tu fais un long siège pour t''emparer d''une ville avec laquelle tu es en guerre, tu ne détruiras point les arbres en y portant la hache, tu t''en nourriras et tu ne les abattras point; car l''arbre des champs est-il un homme pour être assiégé par toi?
verses.am: ለመብል የማይሆኑትን የምታውቃቸውን ዛፎች ታጠፋቸዋለህ፥ ትቈርጣቸውማለህ፤ እስክታሸንፋትም ድረስ በምትዋጋህ ከተማ ላይ ምሽግ ትመሽጋለህ።

verses.en: Only the trees which thou knowest that they be not trees for meat, thou shalt destroy and cut them down; and thou shalt build bulwarks against the city that maketh war with thee, until it be subdued.
verses.fr: Mais tu pourras détruire et abattre les arbres que tu sauras ne pas être des arbres servant à la nourriture, et en construire des retranchements contre la ville qui te fait la guerre, jusqu''à ce qu''elle succombe.
verses.am: ፤ ለመብል የማይሆኑትን የምታውቃቸውን ዛፎች ታጠፋቸዋለህ፥ ትቈርጣቸውማለህ፤ እስክታሸንፋትም ድረስ በምትዋጋህ ከተማ ላይ ምሽግ ትመሽጋለህ።

verses.en: If one be found slain in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee to possess it, lying in the field, and it be not known who hath slain him:
verses.fr: Si, dans le pays dont l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne la possession, l''on trouve étendu au milieu d''un champ un homme tué, sans que l''on sache qui l''a frappé,
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ትወርሳት ዘንድ በሚሰጥህ ምድር የተገደለ ሰው በሜዳ ወድቆ ቢገኝ፥

verses.en: Then thy elders and thy judges shall come forth, and they shall measure unto the cities which are round about him that is slain:
verses.fr: tes anciens et tes juges iront mesurer les distances à partir du cadavre jusqu''aux villes des environs.
verses.am: ገዳዩም ባይታወቅ፥ ሽማግሌዎችህና ፈራጆችህ ወጥተው በተገደለው ሰው ዙሪያ እስካሉት ከተሞች ድረስ በስፍር ይለኩ፤

verses.en: And it shall be, that the city which is next unto the slain man, even the elders of that city shall take an heifer, which hath not been wrought with, and which hath not drawn in the yoke;
verses.fr: Quand on aura déterminé la ville la plus rapprochée du cadavre, les anciens de cette ville prendront une génisse qui n''ait point servi au travail et qui n''ait point tiré au joug.
verses.am: ወደ ተገደለውም ሰው አቅራቢያ የሆነችው የከተማይቱ ሽማግሌዎች ለሥራ ያልደረሰችውን ቀንበርም ያልተጫነባትን ጊደር ይውሰዱ፤

verses.en: And the elders of that city shall bring down the heifer unto a rough valley, which is neither eared nor sown, and shall strike off the heifer's neck there in the valley:
verses.fr: Ils feront descendre cette génisse vers un torrent qui jamais ne tarisse et où il n''y ait ni culture ni semence; et là, ils briseront la nuque à la génisse, dans le torrent.
verses.am: የዚያችም ከተማ ሽማግሌዎች ጊደሪቱን ይዘው ፈሳሽ ውኃ ወዳለበት ወዳልታረሰና ዘርም ወዳልተዘራበት ሸለቆ ይሄዳሉ፤ በዚያም በሸለቆው ውስጥ የጊደሪቱን አንገት ይሰብራሉ።

verses.en: And the priests the sons of Levi shall come near; for them the Lord thy God hath chosen to minister unto him, and to bless in the name of the Lord; and by their word shall every controversy and every stroke be tried:
verses.fr: Alors s''approcheront les sacrificateurs, fils de Lévi; car l''Eternel, ton Dieu, les a choisis pour qu''ils le servent et qu''ils bénissent au nom de l''Eternel, et ce sont eux qui doivent prononcer sur toute contestation et sur toute blessure.
verses.am: የሌዊ ልጆች ካህናትም ይቀርባሉ፤ በፊቱ እንዲያገለግሉ፥ በስሙም እንዲባርኩ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር መርጦአቸዋልና፥ በእነርሱም ቃል ክርክር ሁሉ ጉዳትም ሁሉ ይቈረጣልና፤

verses.en: And all the elders of that city, that are next unto the slain man, shall wash their hands over the heifer that is beheaded in the valley:
verses.fr: Tous les anciens de cette ville la plus rapprochée du cadavre laveront leurs mains sur la génisse à laquelle on a brisé la nuque dans le torrent.
verses.am: ወደ ተገደለው ሰው አቅራቢያ የሆነችው የከተማይቱ ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ በሸለቆው ውስጥ አንገትዋ በተሰበረው ጊደር ላይ እጃቸውን ሲታጠቡ።

verses.en: And they shall answer and say, Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen it.
verses.fr: Et prenant la parole, ils diront: Nos mains n''ont point répandu ce sang et nos yeux ne l''ont point vu répandre.
verses.am: እጃችን ይህን ደም አላፈሰሰችም፥ ዓይናችንም አላየችም፤

verses.en: Be merciful, O Lord, unto thy people Israel, whom thou hast redeemed, and lay not innocent blood unto thy people of Israel's charge. And the blood shall be forgiven them.
verses.fr: Pardonne, ô Eternel! à ton peuple d''Israël, que tu as racheté; n''impute pas le sang innocent à ton peuple d''Israël, et ce sang ne lui sera point imputé.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የተቤዠኸውን ሕዝብህን እስራኤልን ይቅር በል፤ በሕዝብህም በእስራኤል ላይ የንጹሑን ደም በደል አትቍጠር ብለው ይናገራሉ። ስለ ደሙም ይሰረይላቸዋል።

verses.en: So shalt thou put away the guilt of innocent blood from among you, when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the Lord.
verses.fr: Ainsi, tu dois faire disparaître du milieu de toi le sang innocent, en faisant ce qui est droit aux yeux de l''Eternel.
verses.am: አንተም በእግዚአብሔር ዓይን የቀናውን ባደረግህ ጊዜ የንጹሑን ደም በደል ከመካከልህ ታርቃለህ።

verses.en: When thou goest forth to war against thine enemies, and the Lord thy God hath delivered them into thine hands, and thou hast taken them captive,
