verses.am: የአምላክህንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስላልሰማህ፥ ያዘዘህንም ትእዛዙንና ሥርዓቱን ስላልጠበቅህ፥ እስክትጠፋ ድረስ እነዚህ መርገሞች ሁሉ ይወርዱብሃል፥ ያሳድዱህማል፥ ያገኙሁማል።

verses.en: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:
verses.fr: Toutes ces malédictions viendront sur toi, elles te poursuivront et seront ton partage jusqu''à ce que tu sois détruit, parce que tu n''auras pas obéi à la voix de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, parce que tu n''auras pas observé ses commandements et ses lois qu''il te prescrit.
verses.am: በአንተም በልጅ ልጅህም ላይ ለዘላለም ለምልክትና ለድንቅ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.
verses.fr: Elles seront à jamais pour toi et pour tes descendants comme des signes et des prodiges.
verses.am: ሁሉን አብዝቶ ስለ ሰጠህ አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን በፍሥሐና በሐሤት አላመለክህምና

verses.en: Because thou servedst not the Lord thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;
verses.fr: Pour n''avoir pas, au milieu de l''abondance de toutes choses, servi l''Eternel, ton Dieu, avec joie et de bon coeur,
verses.am: በራብና በጥማት በዕራቁትነትም ሁሉንም በማጣት እግዚአብሔር ለሚልክብህ ለጠላቶችህ ትገዛለህ፤ እስኪያጠፋህም ድረስ በአንገትህ ላይ የብረት ቀንበር ይጭናል።

verses.en: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.fr: tu serviras, au milieu de la faim, de la soif, de la nudité et de la disette de toutes choses, tes ennemis que l''Eternel enverra contre toi. Il mettra un joug de fer sur ton cou, jusqu''à ce qu''il t''ait détruit.
verses.am: እስክትጠፋ ድረስ የከብትህን ፍሬ የምድርህንም ፍሬ ይበላሉ፤ እስኪያጠፉህም ድረስ እህልን የወይንም ጠጅ ዘይትንም የላምህንና የበግህን ርቢ አይተዉልህም።

verses.en: The Lord shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;
verses.fr: L''Eternel fera partir de loin, des extrémités de la terre, une nation qui fondra sur toi d''un vol d''aigle, une nation dont tu n''entendras point la langue,
verses.am: እስክትጠፋ ድረስ የከብትህን ፍሬ የምድርህንም ፍሬ ይበላሉ፤ እስኪያጠፉህም ድረስ እህልን የወይንም ጠጅ ዘይትንም የላምህንና የበግህን ርቢ አይተዉልህም።

verses.en: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:
verses.fr: une nation au visage farouche, et qui n''aura ni respect pour le vieillard ni pitié pour l''enfant.
verses.am: በአገርህ ሁሉ ያሉ፥ ትታመንባቸው የነበሩ፥ የረዘሙ የጸኑም ቅጥሮች እስኪፈርሱ ድረስ፥ በከተሞችህ ደጆች ሁሉ ከብበው ያስጭንቁሃል፤ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር በሰጠህ ምድር ሁሉ በደጆች ሁሉ ከብበው ያስጨንቁሃል።

verses.en: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which also shall not leave thee either corn, wine, or oil, or the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.fr: Elle mangera le fruit de tes troupeaux et le fruit de ton sol, jusqu''à ce que tu sois détruit; elle ne te laissera ni blé, ni moût, ni huile, ni portées de ton gros et de ton menu bétail, jusqu''à ce qu''elle t''ait fait périr.
verses.am: ጠላቶችህም ከብበው ባስጨነቁህና መከራ ባሳዩህ ጊዜ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር የሚሰጥህን የሆድህን ፍሬ የወንዶችና የሴቶች ልጆችህን ሥጋ ትበላለህ።

verses.en: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the Lord thy God hath given thee.
verses.fr: Elle t''assiégera dans toutes tes portes, jusqu''à ce que tes murailles tombent, ces hautes et fortes murailles sur lesquelles tu auras placé ta confiance dans toute l''étendue de ton pays; elle t''assiégera dans toutes tes portes, dans tout le pays que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne.
verses.am: በአንተ ዘንድ የተለሳለሰና በቅምጥልነት ሁልጊዜ ይኖር የነበረ ሰው በወንድሙ፥ አቅፋውም በምትተኛ በሚስቱ፥ በቀሩትም ልጆች ይቀናል፤

verses.en: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the Lord thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee:
verses.fr: Au milieu de l''angoisse et de la détresse où te réduira ton ennemi, tu mangeras le fruit de tes entrailles, la chair de tes fils et de tes filles que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''aura donnés.
verses.am: በደጆችህ ሁሉ ውስጥ ጠላቶችህ ከብበው ባስጨነቁህና መከራ ባሳዩህ ጊዜ ሌላ ነገር የቀረው የለምና ከሚበላው ከልጆቹ ሥጋ ለአንዱ አይሰጥም።

verses.en: So that the man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:
verses.fr: L''homme d''entre vous le plus délicat et le plus habitué à la mollesse aura un oeil sans pitié pour son frère, pour la femme qui repose sur son sein, pour ceux de ses enfants qu''il a épargnés;
verses.am: በአንተ ዘንድ ያለችው የተለሳለሰችና በቅምጥልነት ሁልጊዜ ትኖር የነበረችው፥ ከልስላሴና ከቅምጥልነት የተነሣ የእግር ጫማዋን በምድር ላይ ያላደረገችው ሴት፥ አቅፋ በተኛችው ባልዋ፥

verses.en: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he hath nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates.
verses.fr: il ne donnera à aucun d''eux de la chair de ses enfants dont il fait sa nourriture, parce qu''il ne lui reste plus rien au milieu de l''angoisse et de la détresse où te réduira ton ennemi dans toutes tes portes.
verses.am: በወንድና በሴት ልጅዋም፥ በእግርዋ መካከል በሚወጣው በእንግዴ ልጅ፥ በምትወልዳቸውም ልጆች ትቀናለች፤ በደጆችህም ውስጥ ጠላቶችህ ከብበው ባስጨነቁህና መከራ ባሳዩህ ጊዜ ሁሉን ስላጣች በስውር ትበላቸዋለች።

verses.en: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,
verses.fr: La femme d''entre vous la plus délicate et la plus habituée à la mollesse, qui par mollesse et par délicatesse n''essayait pas de poser à terre la plante de son pied, aura un oeil sans pitié pour le mari qui repose sur son sein, pour son fils et pour sa fille;
verses.am: በዚህ መጽሐፍ የተጻፉትን የዚህን ሕግ ቃሎች ሁሉ ታደርግ ዘንድ ባትጠብቅ፥ ይህንንም <<አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር>> የተባለውን የተመሰገነውንና የተፈራውን ስም ባትፈራ፥

verses.en: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.
verses.fr: elle ne leur donnera rien de l''arrière-faix sorti d''entre ses pieds et des enfants qu''elle mettra au monde, car, manquant de tout, elle en fera secrètement sa nourriture au milieu de l''angoisse et de la détresse où te réduira ton ennemi dans tes portes.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር መቅሠፍትህን፥ የዘርህንም መቅሠፍት፥ ብዙ ዘመንም የሚኖረውን ታላቅ መቅሠፍት፥ ብዙ ዘመን የሚኖረውንም ክፉ ደዌ ያደርግብሃል።

verses.en: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, The Lord Thy God;
verses.fr: Si tu n''observes pas et ne mets pas en pratique toutes les paroles de cette loi, écrites dans ce livre, si tu ne crains pas ce nom glorieux et redoutable de l''Eternel, ton Dieu,
verses.am: የፈራኸውንም የግብፅ ደዌ ሁሉ እንደ ገና ያመጣብሃል፥ ይጣበቅብህማል።

verses.en: Then the Lord will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, even great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.
verses.fr: l''Eternel te frappera miraculeusement, toi et ta postérité, par des plaies grandes et de longue durée, par des maladies graves et opiniâtres.
verses.am: ደግሞም ይህ ሕግ ባለበት መጽሐፍ ውስጥ ያልተጻፈውን ደዌ ሁሉ መቅሠፍትም ሁሉ እስክትጠፋ ድረስ እግዚአብሔር ያመጣብሃል።

verses.en: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.
verses.fr: Il amènera sur toi toutes les maladies d''Egypte, devant lesquelles tu tremblais; et elles s''attacheront à toi.
verses.am: የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰማችሁምና ከብዛታችሁ የተነሣ እንደ ሰማይ ከዋክብት የነበረው ቍጥራችሁ ጥቂት ሆኖ ይቀራል።

verses.en: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will the Lord bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.fr: Et même, l''Eternel fera venir sur toi, jusqu''à ce que tu sois détruit, toutes sortes de maladies et de plaies qui ne sont point mentionnées dans le livre de cette loi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በጎ ያደርግላችሁ ዘንድ ያበዛችሁም ዘንድ ደስ ይለው እንደ ነበረ፥ እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔር ሲያጠፋችሁ ሲያፈርሳችሁም ደስ ይለዋል፤ ትወርሱአትም ዘንድ ከምትገቡባት ምድር ትነቀላላችሁ።

verses.en: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the Lord thy God.
verses.fr: Après avoir été aussi nombreux que les étoiles du ciel, vous ne resterez qu''un petit nombre, parce que tu n''auras point obéi à la voix de l''Eternel, ton Dieu.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከምድር ዳር እስከ ዳርቻዋ ድረስ ወዳሉ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ይበትንሃል፤ በዚያም አንተና አባቶችህ ያላወቃችኋቸውን ሌሎችን አማልክት፥ እንጨትንና ድንጋይን፥ ታመልካለህ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that as the Lord rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the Lord will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.fr: De même que l''Eternel prenait plaisir à vous faire du bien et à vous multiplier, de même l''Eternel prendra plaisir à vous faire périr et à vous détruire; et vous serez arrachés du pays dont tu vas entrer en possession.
verses.am: በእነዚያም አሕዛብ መካከል ዕረፍት አታገኝም፥ ለእግርህም ጫማ ማረፊያ አይሆንም፤ በዚያም እግዚአብሔር ተንቀጥቃጭ ልብ፥ ፈዛዛ ዓይን፥ ደካማም ነፍስ ያመጣብሃል።

verses.en: And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.
verses.fr: L''Eternel te dispersera parmi tous les peuples, d''une extrémité de la terre à l''autre; et là, tu serviras d''autres dieux que n''ont connus ni toi, ni tes pères, du bois et de la pierre.
verses.am: ነፍስህም ታመነታለች፤ ሌሊትና ቀንም ትፈራለህ፥ በሕይወትህም አትታመንም፤

verses.en: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the Lord shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:
verses.fr: Parmi ces nations, tu ne seras pas tranquille, et tu n''auras pas un lieu de repos pour la plante de tes pieds. L''Eternel rendra ton coeur agité, tes yeux languissants, ton âme souffrante.
verses.am: አንተ ስለ ፈራህበት ስለ ልብህ ፍርሃት፥ በዓይንህም ስለምታየው አስተያየት፥ ማለዳ። መቼ ይመሻል? ትላለህ፤ ማታም። መቼ ይነጋል? ትላለህ።

verses.en: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:
verses.fr: Ta vie sera comme en suspens devant toi, tu trembleras la nuit et le jour, tu douteras de ton existence.
verses.am: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ተመልሰህ አታያትም ባልሁህ መንገድም እግዚአብሔር በመርከብ ወደ ግብፅ ይመልስሃል፤ በዚያም ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎች ትሆኑአቸው ዘንድ ለጠላቶቻችሁ ራሳችሁን ትሸጣላችሁ፤ የሚገዛችሁም አይገኝም።

verses.en: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.fr: Dans l''effroi qui remplira ton coeur et en présence de ce que tes yeux verront, tu diras le matin: Puisse le soir être là! et tu diras le soir: Puisse le matin être là!
verses.am: ፤ አንተ ስለ ፈራህበት ስለ ልብህ ፍርሃት፥ በዓይንህም ስለምታየው አስተያየት፥ ማለዳ። መቼ ይመሻል? ትላለህ፤ ማታም። መቼ ይነጋል? ትላለህ።

verses.en: And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel te ramènera sur des navires en Egypte, et tu feras ce chemin dont je t''avais dit: Tu ne le reverras plus! Là, vous vous offrirez en vente à vos ennemis, comme esclaves et comme servantes; et il n''y aura personne pour vous acheter.
verses.am: ፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ተመልሰህ አታያትም ባልሁህ መንገድም እግዚአብሔር በመርከብ ወደ ግብፅ ይመልስሃል፤ በዚያም ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎች ትሆኑአቸው ዘንድ ለጠላቶቻችሁ ራሳችሁን ትሸጣላችሁ፤ የሚገዛችሁም አይገኝም።

verses.en: These are the words of the covenant, which the Lord commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
verses.fr: Voici les paroles de l''alliance que l''Eternel ordonna à Moïse de traiter avec les enfants d''Israël au pays de Moab, outre l''alliance qu''il avait traitée avec eux à Horeb.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በኮሬብ ካደረገው ቃል ኪዳን ሌላ በሞዓብ ምድር ከእስራኤል ልጆች ጋር ያደርገው ዘንድ ሙሴን ያዘዘው የቃል ኪዳኑ ቃሎች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that the Lord did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;
verses.fr: Moïse convoqua tout Israël, et leur dit: Vous avez vu tout ce que l''Eternel a fait sous vos yeux, dans le pays d''Egypte, à Pharaon, à tous ses serviteurs, et à tout son pays,
verses.am: ሙሴም የእስራኤልን ልጆች ሁሉ ጠርቶ አላቸው። እግዚአብሔር በፊታችሁ በግብፅ ምድር በፈርዖንና በባሪያዎቹ ሁሉ በምድሩም ሁሉ ያደረገውን ሁሉ፥

verses.en: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:
verses.fr: les grandes épreuves que tes yeux ont vues, ces miracles et ces grands prodiges.
verses.am: ዓይኖቻችሁ ያዩአቸውን ታላላቆች ፈተናዎች፥ ታላላቆች ተአምራትና ድንቆች፥ አይታችኋል፤

verses.en: Yet the Lord hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.
verses.fr: Mais, jusqu''à ce jour, l''Eternel ne vous a pas donné un coeur pour comprendre, des yeux pour voir, des oreilles pour entendre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን አስተዋይ ልብ፥ የሚያዩ ዓይኖች፥ የሚሰሙም ጆሮች እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ አልሰጣችሁም።

verses.en: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.
verses.fr: Je t''ai conduit pendant quarante années dans le désert; tes vêtements ne se sont point usés sur toi, et ton soulier ne s''est point usé à ton pied;
verses.am: አርባ ዓመት በምድረ በዳ መራኋችሁ፤ ልብሳችሁም አላረጀባችሁም፥ ጫማችሁም በእግራችሁ ላይ አላረጀም።

verses.en: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink: that ye might know that I am the Lord your God.
verses.fr: vous n''avez point mangé de pain, et vous n''avez bu ni vin ni liqueur forte, afin que vous connussiez que je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: እኔ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቁ ዘንድ እንጀራ አልበላችሁም፥ የወይን ጠጅና የሚያሰክረውን መጠጥ አልጠጣችሁም።

verses.en: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:
verses.fr: Vous êtes arrivés dans ce lieu; Sihon, roi de Hesbon, et Og, roi de Basan, sont sortis à notre rencontre, pour nous combattre, et nous les avons battus.
verses.am: ወደዚህም ስፍራ በመጣችሁ ጊዜ የሐሴቦን ንጉሥ ሴዎን የባሳንም ንጉስ ዐግ ሊወጉን ወጡብን፥ እኛም መታናቸው፤

verses.en: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.
verses.fr: Nous avons pris leur pays, et nous l''avons donné en propriété aux Rubénites, aux Gadites et à la moitié de la tribu des Manassites.
verses.am: ምድራቸውንም ወስደን ለሮቤልና ለጋድ ለምናሴም ነገድ እኵሌታ ርስት አድርገን ሰጠናቸው።

verses.en: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.
verses.fr: Vous observerez donc les paroles de cette alliance, et vous les mettrez en pratique, afin de réussir dans tout ce que vous ferez.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በምታደርጉት ሁሉ ትከናወኑ ዘንድ የዚህን ቃል ኪዳን ቃሎች ጠብቁ አድርጉም።

verses.en: Ye stand this day all of you before the Lord your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, with all the men of Israel,
verses.fr: Vous vous présentez aujourd''hui devant l''Eternel, votre Dieu, vous tous, vos chefs de tribus, vos anciens, vos officiers, tous les hommes d''Israël,
verses.am: እኔም ይህን ቃል ኪዳንና ይህን መሐላ የማደርገው ከእናንተ ጋር ብቻ አይደለም፤

verses.en: Your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that is in thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water:
verses.fr: vos enfants, vos femmes, et l''étranger qui est au milieu de ton camp, depuis celui qui coupe ton bois jusqu''à celui qui puise ton eau.
verses.am: እኔም ይህን ቃል ኪዳንና ይህን መሐላ የማደርገው ከእናንተ ጋር ብቻ አይደለም፤

verses.en: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the Lord thy God, and into his oath, which the Lord thy God maketh with thee this day:
verses.fr: Tu te présentes pour entrer dans l''alliance de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, dans cette alliance contractée avec serment, et que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, traite en ce jour avec toi,
verses.am: እኔም ይህን ቃል ኪዳንና ይህን መሐላ የማደርገው ከእናንተ ጋር ብቻ አይደለም፤

verses.en: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself, and that he may be unto thee a God, as he hath said unto thee, and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.fr: afin de t''établir aujourd''hui pour son peuple et d''être lui-même ton Dieu, comme il te l''a dit, et comme il l''a juré à tes pères, Abraham, Isaac et Jacob.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ዛሬ በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ከእኛ ጋር በዚህ ከሚቆም ሰው ጋር፥ ዛሬም ከእኛ ጋር በዚህ ከሌለ ሰው ጋር ነው እንጂ፤

verses.en: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;
verses.fr: Ce n''est point avec vous seuls que je traite cette alliance, cette alliance contractée avec serment.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እኛ በግብፅ ምድር እንደ ተቀመጥን በመካከላቸውም ባለፋችሁባቸው አሕዛብ መካከል እንዳለፍን አውቃችኋልና፥

verses.en: But with him that standeth here with us this day before the Lord our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day:
verses.fr: Mais c''est avec ceux qui sont ici parmi nous, présents en ce jour devant l''Eternel, notre Dieu, et avec ceux qui ne sont point ici parmi nous en ce jour.
verses.am: ርኩስነታቸውንም በእነርሱም ዘንድ የነበሩትን የእንጨትና የድንጋይ የብርና የወርቅም ጣዖቶቻቸውን አይታችኋልና፥

verses.en: (For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by;
verses.fr: Vous savez de quelle manière nous avons habité dans le pays d''Egypte, et comment nous avons passé au milieu des nations que vous avez traversées.
verses.am: ሄዶ የእነዚያን አሕዛብ አማልክት ያመልክ ዘንድ ከአምላኩ ከእግዚአብሔር ልቡን ዛሬ የሚያስት ወንድ ወይም ሴት ወይም ወገን ወይም ነገድ አይኑርባችሁ፤ ሐሞትና እሬትም የሚያበቅል ሥር አይሁንባችሁ።

verses.en: And ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them:)
verses.fr: Vous avez vu leurs abominations et leurs idoles, le bois et la pierre, l''argent et l''or, qui sont chez elles.
verses.am: የዚህንም እርግማን ቃሎች የሰማ ሰው። ምንም እንኳ በልቤ ደንዳንነት ብሄድ፥ ለጥማቴም ስካር ብጨምር፥ ሰላም ይሆንልኛል ብሎ ሰውነቱን በልቡ የሚባርክ ቢኖር፥

verses.en: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the Lord our God, to go and serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;
verses.fr: Qu''il n''y ait parmi vous ni homme, ni femme, ni famille, ni tribu, dont le coeur se détourne aujourd''hui de l''Eternel, notre Dieu, pour aller servir les dieux de ces nations-là. Qu''il n''y ait point parmi vous de racine qui produise du poison et de l''absinthe.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ ቅንዓቱም በዚያ ሰው ላይ ይጤሳል እንጂ እግዚአብሔር ይቅርታ አያደርግለትም፤ በዚህም መጽሐፍ የተጻፈው እርግማን ሁሉ በላዩ ይኖራል፥ እግዚአብሔርም ስሙን ከሰማይ በታች ይደመስሰዋል።

verses.en: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:
verses.fr: Que personne, après avoir entendu les paroles de cette alliance contractée avec serment, ne se glorifie dans son coeur et ne dise: J''aurai la paix, quand même je suivrai les penchants de mon coeur, et que j''ajouterai l''ivresse à la soif.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በዚህ ሕግ መጽሐፍ እንደ ተጻፈው እንደ ቃል ኪዳኑ እርግማን ሁሉ ከእስራኤል ነገዶች ሁሉ ለጥፋት ይለየዋል።

verses.en: The Lord will not spare him, but then the anger of the Lord and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the Lord shall blot out his name from under heaven.
verses.fr: L''Eternel ne voudra point lui pardonner. Mais alors la colère et la jalousie de l''Eternel s''enflammeront contre cet homme, toutes les malédictions écrites dans ce livre reposeront sur lui, et l''Eternel effacera son nom de dessous les cieux.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ የሚነሣ ትውልድ ከእናንተም በኋላ የሚሆኑ ልጆቻችሁ ከሩቅ አገርም የሚመጣ እንግዳ፥ የዚህን አገር መቅሠፍት፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእርስዋ ያደረገውን ሥቃይዋን፥

verses.en: And the Lord shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:
verses.fr: L''Eternel le séparera, pour son malheur, de toutes les tribus d''Israël, selon toutes les malédictions de l''alliance écrite dans ce livre de la loi.
verses.am: ምድርም በሁለንተናዋ ዲንና ጨው መቃጠልም እንደ ሆነባት፥ እንዳትዘራም እንዳታበቅልም፥ ማናቸውም ሣርና ልምላሜም እንዳይወጣባት፥ እግዚአብሔር በቍጣውና በመዓቱ እንደ ገለባበጣቸው እንደ ሰዶምና ገሞራ እንደ አዳማና እንደ ሲባዮ እንደ ሆነች ባዩ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the Lord hath laid upon it;
verses.fr: Les générations à venir, vos enfants qui naîtront après vous et l''étranger qui viendra d''une terre lointaine, -à la vue des plaies et des maladies dont l''Eternel aura frappé ce pays,
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሁሉ። እግዚአብሔር በዚህች ምድር ስለ ምን እንደዚህ አደረገ? ይህስ የቍጣው ታላቅ መቅሠፍት ምንድር ነው? ይላሉ።

verses.en: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the Lord overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:
verses.fr: à la vue du soufre, du sel, de l''embrasement de toute la contrée, où il n''y aura ni semence, ni produit, ni aucune herbe qui croisse, comme au bouleversement de Sodome, de Gomorrhe, d''Adma et de Tseboïm, que l''Eternel détruisit dans sa colère et dans sa fureur, -
verses.am: ሰዎችም እንዲህ ይላሉ። የአባቶቻቸው አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ከግብፅ ምድር ባወጣቸው ጊዜ ከእነርሱ ጋር ያደረገውን ቃል ኪዳን ስለተዉ፥

verses.en: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the Lord done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?
verses.fr: toutes les nations diront: Pourquoi l''Eternel a-t-il ainsi traité ce pays? pourquoi cette ardente, cette grande colère?
verses.am: ሄደውም የማያውቋቸውንና ያልታዘዙትን ሌሎችን አማልክት ስላመለኩና ስለ ሰገዱላቸው፥

verses.en: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the Lord God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:
verses.fr: Et l''on répondra: C''est parce qu''ils ont abandonné l''alliance contractée avec eux par l''Eternel, le Dieu de leurs pères, lorsqu''il les fit sortir du pays d''Egypte;
verses.am: ስለዚህ በዚህ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈውን መርገም ሁሉ ያወርድባት ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በዚህች ምድር ነደደ፤

verses.en: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and whom he had not given unto them:
verses.fr: c''est parce qu''ils sont allés servir d''autres dieux et se prosterner devant eux, des dieux qu''ils ne connaissaient point et que l''Eternel ne leur avait point donnés en partage.
verses.am: ዛሬም እንዳሉ እግዚአብሔር በቍጣና በመቅሠፍት በታላቅም መዓት ከምድራቸው ነቀላቸው፥ ወደ ሌላም ምድር ጣላቸው።

verses.en: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:
verses.fr: Alors la colère de l''Eternel s''est enflammée contre ce pays, et il a fait venir sur lui toutes les malédictions écrites dans ce livre.
verses.am: ምሥጢሩ ለአምላካችን ለእግዚአብሔር ነው፤ የተገለጠው ግን የዚህን ሕግ ቃሎች ሁሉ እናደርግ ዘንድ ለእኛ ለዘላለምም ለልጆቻችን ነው።

verses.en: And the Lord rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day.
verses.fr: L''Eternel les a arrachés de leur pays avec colère, avec fureur, avec une grande indignation, et il les a jetés sur un autre pays, comme on le voit aujourd''hui.
verses.am: ፤ ዛሬም እንዳሉ እግዚአብሔር በቍጣና በመቅሠፍት በታላቅም መዓት ከምድራቸው ነቀላቸው፥ ወደ ሌላም ምድር ጣላቸው።

verses.en: The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.
verses.fr: Les choses cachées sont à l''Eternel, notre Dieu; les choses révélées sont à nous et à nos enfants, à perpétuité, afin que nous mettions en pratique toutes les paroles de cette loi.
verses.am: ፤ ምሥጢሩ ለአምላካችን ለእግዚአብሔር ነው፤ የተገለጠው ግን የዚህን ሕግ ቃሎች ሁሉ እናደርግ ዘንድ ለእኛ ለዘላለምም ለልጆቻችን ነው።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither the Lord thy God hath driven thee,
verses.fr: Lorsque toutes ces choses t''arriveront, la bénédiction et la malédiction que je mets devant toi, si tu les prends à coeur au milieu de toutes les nations chez lesquelles l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''aura chassé,
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እኔ በፊትህ ያኖርሁት ይህ ነገር ሁሉ፥ በረከቱና መርገሙ፥ በወረደብህ ጊዜ፥ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር በሚበትንህ በአሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል ሆነህ በልብህ ባሰብኸው ጊዜ፥

verses.en: And shalt return unto the Lord thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;
verses.fr: si tu reviens à l''Eternel, ton Dieu, et si tu obéis à sa voix de tout ton coeur et de toute ton âme, toi et tes enfants, selon tout ce que je te prescris aujourd''hui,
verses.am: ወደ አምላክህም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመልሰህ እኔ ዛሬ እንደማዝዝህ ሁሉ አንተና ልጆችህ በፍጹም ልብና በፍጹም ነፍስ ለቃሉ በታዘዝህ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: That then the Lord thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the Lord thy God hath scattered thee.
verses.fr: alors l''Eternel, ton Dieu, ramènera tes captifs et aura compassion de toi, il te rassemblera encore du milieu de tous les peuples chez lesquels l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''aura dispersé.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ምርኮህን ይመልሳል ይራራልህማል፤ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር አንተን ከበተነበት ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል መልሶ ይሰበስብሃል።

verses.en: If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the Lord thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:
verses.fr: Quand tu serais exilé à l''autre extrémité du ciel, l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te rassemblera de là, et c''est là qu''il t''ira chercher.
verses.am: ሰዎችህም እስከ ሰማይ ዳርቻ ድረስ ፈልሰው እንደ ሆነ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከዚያ ይሰበስብሃል፥ ከዚያም ያመጣሃል።

verses.en: And the Lord thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.
verses.fr: L''Eternel, ton Dieu, te ramènera dans le pays que possédaient tes pères, et tu le posséderas; il te fera du bien, et te rendra plus nombreux que tes pères.
verses.am: አባቶችህም ወደ ወረሱአት ምድር አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ያጋባሃል፥ ትወርሳትማለህ፤ መልካምም ያደርግልሃል፥ ከአባቶችህም ይልቅ ያበዛሃል።

verses.en: And the Lord thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.
verses.fr: L''Eternel, ton Dieu, circoncira ton coeur et le coeur de ta postérité, et tu aimeras l''Eternel, ton Dieu, de tout ton coeur et de toute ton âme, afin que tu vives.
verses.am: በሕይወትም እንድትኖር፥ አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን በፍጹም ልብህ በፍጹምም ነፍስህ እንድትወድድ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ልብህን የዘርህንም ልብ ይገርዛል።

verses.en: And the Lord thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.
verses.fr: L''Eternel, ton Dieu, fera tomber toutes ces malédictions sur tes ennemis, sur ceux qui t''auront haï et persécuté.
verses.am: አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር ይህችን መርገም ሁሉ በጠላቶችህና በሚጠሉህ በሚያሳድዱህም ላይ ያመጣታል።

verses.en: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the Lord, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.
verses.fr: Et toi, tu reviendras à l''Eternel, tu obéiras à sa voix, et tu mettras en pratique tous ces commandements que je te prescris aujourd''hui.
verses.am: አንተም ተመልሰህ የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ትሰማለህ፥ ዛሬም እኔ የማዝዝህን ትእዛዙን ሁሉ ታደርጋለህ።

verses.en: And the Lord thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the Lord will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:
verses.fr: L''Eternel, ton Dieu, te comblera de biens en faisant prospérer tout le travail de tes mains, le fruit de tes entrailles, le fruit de tes troupeaux et le fruit de ton sol; car l''Eternel prendra de nouveau plaisir à ton bonheur, comme il prenait plaisir à celui de tes pères,
verses.am: እኔ ዛሬ የማዝዝህ ይህች ትእዛዝ ከባድ አይደለችም፥ ከአንተም የራቀች አይደለችም።

verses.en: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, and if thou turn unto the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.
verses.fr: lorsque tu obéiras à la voix de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, en observant ses commandements et ses ordres écrits dans ce livre de la loi, lorsque tu reviendras à l''Eternel, ton Dieu, de tout ton coeur et de toute ton âme.
verses.am: እኔ ዛሬ የማዝዝህ ይህች ትእዛዝ ከባድ አይደለችም፥ ከአንተም የራቀች አይደለችም።

verses.en: For this commandment which I command thee this day, it is not hidden from thee, neither is it far off.
verses.fr: Ce commandement que je te prescris aujourd''hui n''est certainement point au-dessus de tes forces et hors de ta portée.
verses.am: ሰምተን እናደርጋት ዘንድ ስለ እኛ ወደ ሰማይ ወጥቶ እርስዋን የሚያመጣልን ማን ነው? እንዳትል በሰማይ አይደለችም።

verses.en: It is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.fr: Il n''est pas dans le ciel, pour que tu dises: Qui montera pour nous au ciel et nous l''ira chercher, qui nous le fera entendre, afin que nous le mettions en pratique?
verses.am: ሰምተን እናደርጋት ዘንድ ስለ እኛ ባሕሩን ተሻግሮ እርስዋን የሚያመጣልን ማን ነው? እንዳትል ከባሕሩ ማዶ አይደለችም።

verses.en: Neither is it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.fr: Il n''est pas de l''autre côté de la mer, pour que tu dises: Qui passera pour nous de l''autre côté de la mer et nous l''ira chercher, qui nous le fera entendre, afin que nous le mettions en pratique?
verses.am: ነገር ግን ታደርገው ዘንድ ቃሉ በአፍህና በልብህ ውስጥ ለአንተ እጅግ ቅርብ ነው።

verses.en: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
verses.fr: C''est une chose, au contraire, qui est tout près de toi, dans ta bouche et dans ton coeur, afin que tu la mettes en pratique.
verses.am: ተመልከት፤ ዛሬ በፊትህ ሕይወትንና መልካምነትን፥ ሞትንና ክፋትን አኑሬአለሁ።

verses.en: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;
verses.fr: Vois, je mets aujourd''hui devant toi la vie et le bien, la mort et le mal.
verses.am: በሕይወትም እንድትኖር እንድትባዛም፥ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር ልትወርሳት በምትገባባት ምድር እንዲባርክህ፥ አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን ትወድድ ዘንድ፥ በመንገዱም ትሄድ ዘንድ ትእዛዙንና ሥርዓቱን ፍርዱንም ትጠብቅ ዘንድ ዛሬ እኔ አዝዝሃለሁ።

verses.en: In that I command thee this day to love the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the Lord thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.fr: Car je te prescris aujourd''hui d''aimer l''Eternel, ton Dieu, de marcher dans ses voies, et d''observer ses commandements, ses lois et ses ordonnances, afin que tu vives et que tu multiplies, et que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te bénisse dans le pays dont tu vas entrer en possession.
verses.am: ልብህ ግን ቢስት አንተም ባትሰማ፥ ብትታለልም፥ ለሌሎችም አማልክት ብትሰግድ ብታመልካቸውም፥

verses.en: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;
verses.fr: Mais si ton coeur se détourne, si tu n''obéis point, et si tu te laisses entraîner à te prosterner devant d''autres dieux et à les servir,
verses.am: ፈጽማችሁ እንድትጠፉ እኔ ዛሬ እነግራችኋለሁ፤ ዮርዳኖስን ተሻግረህ ትወርሳት ዘንድ በምትገባባት ምድር ዘመናችሁን አታስረዝሙም።

verses.en: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.
verses.fr: je vous déclare aujourd''hui que vous périrez, que vous ne prolongerez point vos jours dans le pays dont vous allez entrer en possession, après avoir passé le Jourdain.
verses.am: በፊታችሁ ሕይወትንና ሞትን በረከትንና መርገምን እንዳስቀመጥሁ እኔ ዛሬ ሰማይንና ምድርን በአንተ ላይ አስመሰክራለሁ፤ እንግዲህ አንተና ዘርህ በሕይወት ትኖሩ ዘንድ ሕይወትን ምረጥ፤

verses.en: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:
verses.fr: J''en prends aujourd''hui à témoin contre vous le ciel et la terre: j''ai mis devant toi la vie et la mort, la bénédiction et la malédiction. Choisis la vie, afin que tu vives, toi et ta postérité,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለአባቶችህ ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም እንዲሰጣቸው በማለላቸው በምድሪቱ ትቀመጥ ዘንድ፥ እርሱ ሕይወትህ የዘመንህም ርዝመት ነውና አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን ትወድደው ትጠባበቀውም ቃሉንም ትሰማ ዘንድ ምረጥ።

verses.en: That thou mayest love the Lord thy God, and that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the Lord sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
verses.fr: pour aimer l''Eternel, ton Dieu, pour obéir à sa voix, et pour t''attacher à lui: car de cela dépendent ta vie et la prolongation de tes jours, et c''est ainsi que tu pourras demeurer dans le pays que l''Eternel a juré de donner à tes pères, Abraham, Isaac et Jacob.
verses.am: ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ለአባቶችህ ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም እንዲሰጣቸው በማለላቸው በምድሪቱ ትቀመጥ ዘንድ፥ እርሱ ሕይወትህ የዘመንህም ርዝመት ነውና አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን ትወድደው ትጠባበቀውም ቃሉንም ትሰማ ዘንድ ምረጥ።

verses.en: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.
verses.fr: Moïse adressa encore ces paroles à tout Israël:
verses.am: ሙሴም ሄዶ ይህንን ቃል ለእስራኤል ሁሉ ነገረ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, I am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the Lord hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
verses.fr: Aujourd''hui, leur dit-il, je suis âgé de cent vingt ans, je ne pourrai plus sortir et entrer, et l''Eternel m''a dit: Tu ne passeras pas ce Jourdain.
verses.am: አላቸውም። እኔ ዛሬ መቶ ሀያ ዓመት ሆኖኛል፤ ከዚህ በኋላ እወጣና እገባ ዘንድ አልችልም፤ እግዚአብሔርም። ይህን ዮርዳኖስን አትሻገርም ብሎኛል።

verses.en: The Lord thy God, he will go over before thee, and he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the Lord hath said.
verses.fr: L''Eternel, ton Dieu, marchera lui-même devant toi, il détruira ces nations devant toi, et tu t''en rendras maître. Josué marchera aussi devant toi, comme l''Eternel l''a dit.
verses.am: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር እርሱ በፊትህ ያልፋል፤ እርሱ እነዚህን አሕዛብ ከፊትህ ያጠፋቸዋል ትወርሳቸውማለህ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተናገረ ኢያሱ በፊትህ ይሻገራል።

verses.en: And the Lord shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.
verses.fr: L''Eternel traitera ces nations comme il a traité Sihon et Og, rois des Amoréens, qu''il a détruits avec leur pays.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ባጠፋቸው በአሞራውያን ነገሥታት በሴዎንና በዐግ በምድራቸውም እንዳደረገ ያደርግባቸዋል።

verses.en: And the Lord shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.
verses.fr: L''Eternel vous les livrera, et vous agirez à leur égard selon tous les ordres que je vous ai donnés.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በፊታችሁ አሳልፎ ይጥላቸዋል፥ እንዳዘዝኋችሁም ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ታደርጉባቸዋላችሁ።

verses.en: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the Lord thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.fr: Fortifiez-vous et ayez du courage! Ne craignez point et ne soyez point effrayés devant eux; car l''Eternel, ton Dieu, marchera lui-même avec toi, il ne te délaissera point, il ne t''abandonnera point.
verses.am: ጽኑ፥ አይዞአችሁ፥ አትፍሩ፥ ከፊታቸውም አትደንግጡ፤ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር እርሱ ከአንተ ጋር ይሄዳል፤ አይጥልህም፥ አይተውህም።

verses.en: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the Lord hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.
verses.fr: Moïse appela Josué, et lui dit en présence de tout Israël: Fortifie-toi et prends courage, car tu entreras avec ce peuple dans le pays que l''Eternel a juré à leurs pères de leur donner, et c''est toi qui les en mettras en possession.
verses.am: ሙሴም ኢያሱን ጠርቶ በእስራኤል ሁሉ ፊት። አንተ ከዚህ ሕዝብ ጋር እግዚአብሔር ለአባቶቻቸው እንዲሰጥ ወደ ማለላቸው ምድር ትገባለህና፥ እርስዋንም ለእነርሱ ታወርሳለህና ጽና፥ አይዞህ።

verses.en: And the Lord, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
verses.fr: L''Eternel marchera lui-même devant toi, il sera lui-même avec toi, il ne te délaissera point, il ne t''abandonnera point; ne crains point, et ne t''effraie point.
verses.am: በፊትህም የሚሄድ እርሱ እግዚአብሔር ነው፤ ከአንተ ጋር ይሆናል፥ አይጥልህም፥ አይተውህም፤ አትፍራ፥ አትደንግጥ አለው።

verses.en: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and unto all the elders of Israel.
verses.fr: Moïse écrivit cette loi, et il la remit aux sacrificateurs, fils de Lévi, qui portaient l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel, et à tous les anciens d''Israël.
verses.am: ሙሴም ይህችን ሕግ ጻፈ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት ይሸከሙ ለነበሩት ለሌዊ ልጆች ለካህናቱ ለእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ ሰጣት።

verses.en: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,
verses.fr: Moïse leur donna cet ordre: Tous les sept ans, à l''époque de l''année du relâche, à la fête des tabernacles,
verses.am: ሙሴም እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዛቸው። በሰባተኛው ዓመት መጨረሻ፥ በዕዳ ምሕረት ዘመን፥ በዳስ በዓል፥

verses.en: When all Israel is come to appear before the Lord thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
verses.fr: quand tout Israël viendra se présenter devant l''Eternel, ton Dieu, dans le lieu qu''il choisira, tu liras cette loi devant tout Israël, en leur présence.
verses.am: እስራኤል ሁሉ በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይታይ ዘንድ እርሱ በመረጠው ስፍራ ሲከማች፥ ይህን ሕግ በእስራኤል ሁሉ ፊት በጆሮው አንብበው።

verses.en: Gather the people together, men and women, and children, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the Lord your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:
verses.fr: Tu rassembleras le peuple, les hommes, les femmes, les enfants, et l''étranger qui sera dans tes portes, afin qu''ils t''entendent, et afin qu''ils apprennent à craindre l''Eternel, votre Dieu, à observer et à mettre en pratique toutes les paroles de cette loi.
verses.am: ይሰሙና ይማሩ ዘንድ፥ አምላካችሁንም እግዚአብሔርን ይፈሩ ዘንድ፥ የዚህንም ሕግ ቃሎች ሁሉ ጠብቀው ያደርጉ ዘንድ ሕዝቡን ወንዶችንና ሴቶችን ሕፃናቶችንም በአገራችሁ ደጅ ያለውንም መጻተኛ ሰብስብ።

verses.en: And that their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, and learn to fear the Lord your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
verses.fr: Et leurs enfants qui ne la connaîtront pas l''entendront, et ils apprendront à craindre l''Eternel, votre Dieu, tout le temps que vous vivrez dans le pays dont vous prendrez possession, après avoir passé le Jourdain.
verses.am: የሕግ ቃላት የማያውቁ ልጆቻቸውም ዮርዳኖስን ተሻግራችሁ ልትወርሱአት በምትሄዱባት ምድር በምትኖሩበት ዘመን ሁሉ ይስሙ፥ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርንም መፍራት ይማሩ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Voici, le moment approche où tu vas mourir. Appelle Josué, et présentez-vous dans la tente d''assignation. Je lui donnerai mes ordres. Moïse et Josué allèrent se présenter dans la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። የምትሞትበት ቀን፥ እነሆ፥ ቀረበ፤ ኢያሱን ጠርተህ እርሱን አዝዘው ዘንድ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ከእርሱ ጋር ቁም አለው። ሙሴና ኢያሱም ሄደው በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ቆሙ።

verses.en: And the Lord appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel apparut dans la tente dans une colonne de nuée; et la colonne de nuée s''arrêta à l''entrée de la tente.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በድንኳኑ ውስጥ በደመና ዓምድ ተገለጠ፤ የደመናውም ዓምድ በድንኳኑ ደጃፍ ላይ ቆመ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Voici, tu vas être couché avec tes pères. Et ce peuple se lèvera, et se prostituera après les dieux étrangers du pays au milieu duquel il entre. Il m''abandonnera, et il violera mon alliance, que j''ai traitée avec lui.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። እነሆ፥ ከአባቶችህ ጋር ትተኛለህ፤ ይህም ሕዝብ ይነሣል፥ ይቀመጥባትም ዘንድ በሚሄድባት ምድር መካከል ያሉትን ሌሎችን አማልክት ተከትሎ ያመነዝራል፥ እኔንም ይተወኛል፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር ያደረግሁትን ቃል ኪዳን ያፈርሳሉ።

verses.en: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God is not among us?
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, ma colère s''enflammera contre lui. Je les abandonnerai, et je leur cacherai ma face. Il sera dévoré, il sera la proie d''une multitude de maux et d''afflictions, et alors il dira: N''est-ce point parce que mon Dieu n''est pas au milieu de moi que ces maux m''ont atteint?
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ቍጣዬ ይነድድባቸዋል፥ እተዋቸውማለሁ፥ ፊቴንም እሰውርባቸዋለሁ፥ ለአሕዛብ መብል ይሆናሉ፤ በዚያም ቀን። በእውነት እግዚአብሔር በእኛ መካከል የለምና ይህ ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ አገኘን እስኪሉ ድረስ ብዙ ክፉ ነገርና ጭንቀት ይደርስባቸዋል።

verses.en: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.
verses.fr: Et moi, je cacherai ma face en ce jour-là, à cause de tout le mal qu''il aura fait, en se tournant vers d''autres dieux.
verses.am: ሌሎችን አማልክት ተከትለዋልና ስላደረጉት ክፋት ሁሉ እኔ በዚያ ቀን ፈጽሜ ፊቴን እሰውራለሁ።

verses.en: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Maintenant, écrivez ce cantique. Enseigne-le aux enfants d''Israël, mets-le dans leur bouche, et que ce cantique me serve de témoin contre les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: አሁንም ይህችን መዝሙር ለእናንተ ጻፉ፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች አስተምሩአቸው፤ ይህችም መዝሙር በእስራኤል ላይ ምስክር ትሆንልኝ ዘንድ በአፋቸው አድርጓት።

verses.en: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.
verses.fr: Car je mènerai ce peuple dans le pays que j''ai juré à ses pères de lui donner, pays où coulent le lait et le miel; il mangera, se rassasiera, s''engraissera; puis il se tournera vers d''autres dieux et les servira, il me méprisera et violera mon alliance;
verses.am: ለአባቶቻቸው ወደ ማልሁላቸው፥ ወተትና ማር ወደ ምታፈስሰው ምድር ካገባኋቸው በኋላ፥ ከበሉም ከጠገቡም ከደነደኑም በኋላ፥ ሌሎችን አማልክት ተከትለው ያመልካሉ፥ እኔንም ይንቃሉ፥ ቃል ኪዳኔንም ያፈርሳሉ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.
verses.fr: quand alors il sera atteint par une multitude de maux et d''afflictions, ce cantique, qui ne sera point oublié et que la postérité aura dans la bouche, déposera comme témoin contre ce peuple. Je connais, en effet, ses dispositions, qui déjà se manifestent aujourd''hui, avant même que je l''aie fait entrer dans le pays que j''ai juré de lui donner.
verses.am: ዛሬ ወደ ማልሁላቸው ምድር ገና ሳላገባቸው የሚያስቡትን አሳብ አውቃለሁና፥ ከልጆቻቸውም አፍ አትረሳምና ብዙ ክፉ ነገርና ጭንቀት በደረሰባቸው ጊዜ ይህች መዝሙር ምስክር ሆና በፊታቸው ትመሰክራለች።

verses.en: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, Moïse écrivit ce cantique, et il l''enseigna aux enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ሙሴም በዚያ ቀን ይህችን መዝሙር ጻፈ፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች አስተማራት።

verses.en: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.
verses.fr: L''Eternel donna ses ordres à Josué, fils de Nun. Il dit: Fortifie-toi et prends courage, car c''est toi qui feras entrer les enfants d''Israël dans le pays que j''ai juré de leur donner; et je serai moi-même avec toi.
verses.am: የነዌንም ልጅ ኢያሱን። የእስራኤልን ልጆች ወደ ማልሁላቸው ምድር ታገባለህና ጽና፥ አይዞህ፤ እኔም ከአንተ ጋር እሆናለሁ ብሎ አዘዘው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
verses.fr: Lorsque Moïse eut complètement achevé d''écrire dans un livre les paroles de cette loi,
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሙሴ የዚህን ሕግ ቃሎች በመጽሐፍ ከጻፈ ከፈጸመም በኋላ፥

verses.en: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, saying,
verses.fr: il donna cet ordre aux Lévites qui portaient l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel:
verses.am: ሙሴ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት የሚሸከሙትን ሌዋውያንን እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዘ።

verses.en: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.
verses.fr: Prenez ce livre de la loi, et mettez-le à côté de l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel, votre Dieu, et il sera là comme témoin contre toi.
verses.am: ይህን የሕግ መጽሐፍ ውሰዱ፥ በዚያም በእናንተ ላይ ምስክር እንዲሆን በአምላካችሁ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት አጠገብ አኑሩት።

verses.en: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the Lord; and how much more after my death?
verses.fr: Car je connais ton esprit de rébellion et la roideur de ton cou. Si vous êtes rebelles contre l''Eternel pendant que je suis encore vivant au milieu de vous, combien plus le serez-vous après ma mort!
verses.am: እኔ ዓመፃችሁንና የአንገታችሁን ድንዳኔ አውቃለሁና፤ እኔም ዛሬ ከእናንተ ጋር ገና በሕይወት ሳለሁ እናንተ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ዐምፃችኋል፤ ይልቁንስ ከሞትሁ በኋላ እንዴት ይሆናል?

verses.en: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.
verses.fr: Assemblez devant moi tous les anciens de vos tribus et vos officiers; je dirai ces paroles en leur présence, et je prendrai à témoin contre eux le ciel et la terre.
verses.am: ይህን ቃል በጆሮአቸው እናገር ዘንድ፥ ሰማይንና ምድርንም አስመሰክርባቸው ዘንድ የነገዶቻችሁን ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ አለቆቻችሁንም ሰብስቡልኝ፤

verses.en: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.
verses.fr: Car je sais qu''après ma mort vous vous corromprez, et que vous vous détournerez de la voie que je vous ai prescrite; et le malheur finira par vous atteindre, quand vous ferez ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel, au point de l''irriter par l''oeuvre de vos mains.
verses.am: ከሞትሁ በኋላ ፈጽማችሁ እንድትረክሱ፥ ካዘዝኋችሁም መንገድ ፈቀቅ እንድትሉ አውቃለሁና። በእጃችሁም ሥራ ታስቈጡት ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ስላደረጋችሁ በኋለኛው ዘመን ክፉ ነገር ያገኛችኋል።

verses.en: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.
verses.fr: Moïse prononça dans leur entier les paroles de ce cantique, en présence de toute l''assemblée d''Israël:
verses.am: ሙሴም በእስራኤል ጉባኤ ሁሉ ጆሮ የዚህች መዝሙር ቃሎች እስኪፈጸሙ ድረስ ተናገረ።

verses.en: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
verses.fr: Cieux! prêtez l''oreille, et je parlerai; Terre! écoute les paroles de ma bouche.
verses.am: ሰማያት ሆይ፥ አድምጡ፥ እኔም እናገራለሁ፤  ምድርም የአፌን ቃሎች ትስማ።

verses.en: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
verses.fr: Que mes instructions se répandent comme la pluie, Que ma parole tombe comme la rosée, Comme des ondées sur la verdure, Comme des gouttes d''eau sur l''herbe!
verses.am: ትምህርቴ እንደ ዝናብ ትፈስሳለች፥  ነገሬ እንደ ጠል ትንጠባጠባለች፤  በልምላሜ ላይ እንደ ጤዛ፥  በሣርም ላይ እንደ ካፊያ።

verses.en: Because I will publish the name of the Lord: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.
verses.fr: Car je proclamerai le nom de l''Eternel. Rendez gloire à notre Dieu!
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ስም እጠራለሁና፤  ለአምላካችን ታላቅነትን ስጡ።

verses.en: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.
verses.fr: Il est le rocher; ses oeuvres sont parfaites, Car toutes ses voies sont justes; C''est un Dieu fidèle et sans iniquité, Il est juste et droit.
verses.am: እርሱ አምላክ ነው፤ ሥራውም ፍጹም ነው፤  መንገዱም ሁሉ የቀና ነው፤  የታመነ አምላክ፥ ክፋትም የሌለበት፥  እርሱ እውነተኛና ቅን ነው።

verses.en: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.
verses.fr: S''ils se sont corrompus, à lui n''est point la faute; La honte est à ses enfants, Race fausse et perverse.
verses.am: እነርሱ ረከሱ፤ ልጆቹም አይደሉም፤  ነውርም አለባቸው፤ ጠማማና ገልበጥባጣ ትውልድ ናቸው።

verses.en: Do ye thus requite the Lord, O foolish people and unwise? is not he thy father that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?
verses.fr: Est-ce l''Eternel que vous en rendrez responsable, Peuple insensé et dépourvu de sagesse? N''est-il pas ton père, ton créateur? N''est-ce pas lui qui t''a formé, et qui t''a affermi?
verses.am: ደንቆሮ ብልሃተኛም ያልሆንህ ሕዝብ ሆይ፥  ለእግዚአብሔር ይህንን ትመልሳለህ?  የገዛህ አባትህ አይደለምን?  የፈጠረህና ያጸናህ እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.
verses.fr: Rappelle à ton souvenir les anciens jours, Passe en revue les années, génération par génération, Interroge ton père, et il te l''apprendra, Tes vieillards, et ils te le diront.
verses.am: የዱሮውን ዘመን አስብ፥  የብዙ ትውልድንም ዓመታት አስተውል፤  አባትህን ጠይቅ፥ ያስታውቅህማል፤  ሽማግሌዎችህን ጠይቅ፥ ይነግሩህማል።

verses.en: When the Most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Quand le Très-Haut donna un héritage aux nations, Quand il sépara les enfants des hommes, Il fixa les limites des peuples D''après le nombre des enfants d''Israël,
verses.am: ልዑል ለአሕዛብ ርስታቸውን ባወረሰ ጊዜ፥  የአዳምን ልጆች በለየ ጊዜ፥  እንደ እስራኤል ልጆች ቍጥር  የአሕዛብን ድንበር አቆመ።

verses.en: For the Lord's portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
verses.fr: Car la portion de l''Eternel, c''est son peuple, Jacob est la part de son héritage.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር እድል ፈንታ ሕዝቡ ነው፤  ያዕቆብም የርስቱ ገምድ ነው።

verses.en: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.
verses.fr: Il l''a trouvé dans une contrée déserte, Dans une solitude aux effroyables hurlements; Il l''a entouré, il en a pris soin, Il l''a gardé comme la prunelle de son oeil,
verses.am: በምድረ በዳ በጥማት፥  የነፋስ ጩኸትም በሞላበት ውድማ አገኘው፤  ከበበው ተጠነቀቀለትም፤  እንደ ዓይን ብሌን ጠበቀው።

verses.en: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:
verses.fr: Pareil à l''aigle qui éveille sa couvée, Voltige sur ses petits, Déploie ses ailes, les prend, Les porte sur ses plumes.
verses.am: ንስር ጫጩቶቹን እንደሚያወጣ፥  በእነርሱም ላይ እንደሚሰፍፍ፥  ክንፎቹን ዘርግቶ ወሰዳቸው፥  በክንፎቹም አዘላቸው።

verses.en: So the Lord alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.
verses.fr: L''Eternel seul a conduit son peuple, Et il n''y avait avec lui aucun dieu étranger.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ብቻውን መራው፤  ከእርሱም ጋር ሌላ አምላክ አልነበረም።

verses.en: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;
verses.fr: Il l''a fait monter sur les hauteurs du pays, Et Israël a mangé les fruits des champs; Il lui a fait sucer le miel du rocher, L''huile qui sort du rocher le plus dur,
verses.am: በምድር ከፍታ ላይ አወጣው፤  የእርሻውን ፍሬ በላ፤  ከዓለትም ድንጋይ በሚገኝ ማር፥  ከጭንጫውም ድንጋይ በሚገኝ ዘይት አጠባው፤

verses.en: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.
verses.fr: La crème des vaches et le lait des brebis, Avec la graisse des agneaux, Des béliers de Basan et des boucs, Avec la fleur du froment; Et tu as bu le sang du raisin, le vin.
verses.am: የላሙንም ቅቤ፥ የመንጋውም ወተት፥  ከጠቦት ስብ ጋር፥  የባሳንንም አውራ በግ፥ ፍየሉንም፥  ከስንዴ እሸት ጋር በላህ፤  ከወይኑም ደም ያለውን ጠጅ ጠጣህ።

verses.en: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
verses.fr: Israël est devenu gras, et il a regimbé; Tu es devenu gras, épais et replet! -Et il a abandonné Dieu, son créateur, Il a méprisé le rocher de son salut,
verses.am: ይሹሩን ወፈረ፥ ረገጠ፤  ወፈረ፥ ደነደነ፥ ሰባ፤  የፈጠረውንም እግዚአብሔርን ተወ፤  የመድኃኒቱንም አምላክ ናቀ።

verses.en: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.
verses.fr: Ils ont excité sa jalousie par des dieux étrangers, Ils l''ont irrité par des abominations;
verses.am: በሌሎች አማልክት አስቀኑት፥  በርኵሰታቸውም አስቈጡት።

verses.en: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.
verses.fr: Ils ont sacrifié à des idoles qui ne sont pas Dieu, A des dieux qu''ils ne connaissaient point, Nouveaux, venus depuis peu, Et que vos pères n''avaient pas craints.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ላልሆኑ አጋንንት፥  ለማያውቋቸውም አማልክት፥  በቅርብ ጊዜ ለተነሡ ለአዲሶች  አባቶቻቸውም ላልፈሩአቸው አማልክት ሠዉ።

verses.en: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
verses.fr: Tu as abandonné le rocher qui t''a fait naître, Et tu as oublié le Dieu qui t''a engendré.
verses.am: የወለደህን አምላክ ተውህ፥  ያሳደገህን እግዚአብሔርን ረሳህ።

verses.en: And when the Lord saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.
verses.fr: L''Eternel l''a vu, et il a été irrité, Indigné contre ses fils et ses filles.
verses.am: ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችም ስላስቈጡት  እግዚአብሔር አይቶ ጣላቸው።

verses.en: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.
verses.fr: Il a dit: Je leur cacherai ma face, Je verrai quelle sera leur fin; Car c''est une race perverse, Ce sont des enfants infidèles.
verses.am: እርሱም አለ። ፊቴን እሰውርባቸዋለሁ፤  ፍጻሜያቸው ምን እንደ ሆነ አያለሁ፤  ጠማማ ትውልድ፥  ያልታመኑም ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.en: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
verses.fr: Ils ont excité ma jalousie par ce qui n''est point Dieu, Ils m''ont irrité par leurs vaines idoles; Et moi, j''exciterai leur jalousie par ce qui n''est point un peuple, Je les irriterai par une nation insensée.
verses.am: አምላክ ባልሆነው አስቀኑኝ፤ 3 ቍ.15፤ በዕብራይስጥ ይሹሩን የሚለውን ግዕዙ ያዕቆብ ይለዋል።  በምናምንቴዎቻቸውም አስቈጡኝ፤  እኔም ሕዝብ ባልሆነው አስቀናቸዋለሁ፤  በማያስተውል ሕዝብ አስቈጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.
verses.fr: Car le feu de ma colère s''est allumé, Et il brûlera jusqu''au fond du séjour des morts; Il dévorera la terre et ses produits, Il embrasera les fondements des montagnes.
verses.am: እሳት ከቍጣዬ ትነድዳለችና፥  እስከ ሲኦል ድረስ ታቃጥላለች፥  ምድርንም ከፍሬዋ ጋር ትበላለች፥  የተራሮችን መሠረት ታነድዳለች።

verses.en: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.
verses.fr: J''accumulerai sur eux les maux, J''épuiserai mes traits contre eux.
verses.am: መከራን እጨምርባቸዋለሁ፤  በፍላጾቼም እወጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.
verses.fr: Ils seront desséchés par la faim, consumés par la fièvre Et par des maladies violentes; J''enverrai parmi eux la dent des bêtes féroces Et le venin des serpents.
verses.am: በራብ በንዳድ ይጠፋሉ፤  በንዳድና በመራራ ጥፋት ያልቃሉ፤  የአራዊትን ጥርስ፥  የምድርንም እባብ መርዝ እሰድድባቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.
verses.fr: Au dehors, on périra par l''épée, Et au dedans, par d''effrayantes calamités: Il en sera du jeune homme comme de la jeune fille, De l''enfant à la mamelle comme du vieillard.
verses.am: ጕልማሳውን ከድንግል፥ ሕፃኑንም ከሽማግሌ ጋር፥  በሜዳ ሰይፍ፥ በቤትም ውስጥ ድንጋጤ ያጠፋቸዋል።

verses.en: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:
verses.fr: Je voudrais dire: Je les emporterai d''un souffle, Je ferai disparaître leur mémoire d''entre les hommes!
verses.am: እበትናቸዋለሁ አልሁ፤  ከሰዎችም መካከል መታሰቢያቸውን አጠፋለሁ።

verses.en: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the Lord hath not done all this.
verses.fr: Mais je crains les insultes de l''ennemi, Je crains que leurs adversaires ne se méprennent, Et qu''ils ne disent: Notre main a été puissante, Et ce n''est pas l''Eternel qui a fait toutes ces choses.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ጠላቶቻቸው እንዳይታበዩ።  እጃችን ከፍ ከፍ አለች እንጂ  እግዚአብሔር ይህን ሁሉ አላደረገም  እንዳይሉ፥  ስለ ጠላቱ ቍጣ ፈራሁ።

verses.en: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.
verses.fr: C''est une nation qui a perdu le bon sens, Et il n''y a point en eux d''intelligence.
verses.am: ምክር ያጡ ሕዝብ ናቸው፥  ማስተዋልም የላቸውም።

verses.en: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
verses.fr: S''ils étaient sages, voici ce qu''ils comprendraient, Et ils penseraient à ce qui leur arrivera.
verses.am: አእምሮ ቢኖራቸው፥  ይህንን ያስተውሉ ነበር፥  ፍጻሜያቸውንም ያስቡ ነበር።

verses.en: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the Lord had shut them up?
verses.fr: Comment un seul en poursuivrait-il mille, Et deux en mettraient-ils dix mille en fuite, Si leur Rocher ne les avait vendus, Si l''Eternel ne les avait livrés?
verses.am: እርሱ አምላካቸው ካልሸጣቸው፥  እግዚአብሔርም አሳልፎ ካልሰጣቸው፥  አንድ ሰው እንዴት ሺህን ያሳድድ ነበር?  ሁለቱሳ እንዴት አሥሩን ሺህ ያሸሹ ነበር?

verses.en: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.
verses.fr: Car leur rocher n''est pas comme notre Rocher, Nos ennemis en sont juges.
verses.am: አምላካችን እንደ አማልክቶቻቸው አይደለም፤  ጠላቶቻችንም ሰነፎች ናቸው።

verses.en: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:
verses.fr: Mais leur vigne est du plant de Sodome Et du terroir de Gomorrhe; Leurs raisins sont des raisins empoisonnés, Leurs grappes sont amères;
verses.am: ወይናቸው ከሰዶም ወይን፥  ከገሞራም እርሻ ነው፤  ፍሬያቸው ሐሞት ነው፤  ዘለላውም መራራ ነው።

verses.en: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.
verses.fr: Leur vin, c''est le venin des serpents, C''est le poison cruel des aspics.
verses.am: የወይን ጠጃቸው የእባብ መርዝ፥  የእፉኝትም ሥራይ ነው።

verses.en: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?
verses.fr: Cela n''est-il pas caché près de moi, Scellé dans mes trésors?
verses.am: ይህ በእኔ ዘንድ ተጠብቆ የለምን?  በመዝገቤስ የታተመ አይደለምን?

verses.en: To me belongeth vengeance and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.
verses.fr: A moi la vengeance et la rétribution, Quand leur pied chancellera! Car le jour de leur malheur est proche, Et ce qui les attend ne tardera pas.
verses.am: የጥፋታቸው ቀን ቀርቦአልና፥  የሚመጣባቸውም ነገር ይፈጥናልና  እግራቸው ሲሰናከል  በቀልና ፍርድ የእኔ ነው።

verses.en: For the Lord shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.
verses.fr: L''Eternel jugera son peuple; Mais il aura pitié de ses serviteurs, En voyant que leur force est épuisée, Et qu''il n''y a plus ni esclave ni homme libre.
verses.am: ኃይላቸውም እንደ ደከመ፥  የተዘጋ የተለቀቀም እንደሌለ ባየ ጊዜ  እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ይፈርዳል፥  ስለ ባሪያዎቹም ያዝናል።

verses.en: And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,
verses.fr: Il dira: Où sont leurs dieux, Le rocher qui leur servait de refuge,
verses.am: እርሱም ይላል። አማልክቶቻቸው የት ናቸው?  ይታመኑባቸው የነበሩት አማልክት?

verses.en: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.
verses.fr: Ces dieux qui mangeaient la graisse de leurs victimes, Qui buvaient le vin de leurs libations? Qu''ils se lèvent, qu''ils vous secourent, Qu''ils vous couvrent de leur protection!
verses.am: የመሥዋዕታቸውን ስብ የበሉ፥  የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውንም የወይን ጠጅ የጠጡ?  እነርሱ ይነሡ፥ ይርዱአችሁም፥  መጠጊያም ይሁኑላችሁ።

verses.en: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.
verses.fr: Sachez donc que c''est moi qui suis Dieu, Et qu''il n''y a point de dieu près de moi; Je fais vivre et je fais mourir, Je blesse et je guéris, Et personne ne délivre de ma main.
verses.am: አሁንም እኔ ብቻዬን እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ፥  ከእኔም በቀር አምላክ እንደሌለ እዩ፤  እኔ እገድላለሁ፥ አድንማለሁ፤  እኔ እመታለሁ፥ እፈውስማለሁ፤  ከእጄም የሚያድን የለም።

verses.en: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.
verses.fr: Car je lève ma main vers le ciel, Et je dis: Je vis éternellement!
verses.am: እጄን ወደ ሰማይ እዘረጋለሁና፥  እንዲህም እላለሁ። ለዘላለም እኔ ሕያው ነኝና

verses.en: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.
verses.fr: Si j''aiguise l''éclair de mon épée Et si ma main saisit la justice, Je me vengerai de mes adversaires Et je punirai ceux qui me haïssent;
verses.am: የሚንቦገቦግ ሰይፌን እስለዋለሁ፥  እጄም ፍርድን ትይዛለች፥  ጠላቶቼንም እበቀላለሁ፥  ለሚጠሉኝም ፍዳቸውን እከፍላለሁ።

verses.en: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.
verses.fr: Mon épée dévorera leur chair, Et j''enivrerai mes flèches de sang, Du sang des blessés et des captifs, De la tête des chefs de l''ennemi.
verses.am: ከተወጉት ከተማረኩትም ደም፥  ፍላጾቼን በደም አሰክራለሁ፤  ከጠላት አለቆችም ራስ  ሰይፌ ሥጋ ይበላል።

verses.en: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.
verses.fr: Nations, chantez les louanges de son peuple! Car l''Eternel venge le sang de ses serviteurs, Il se venge de ses adversaires, Et il fait l''expiation pour son pays, pour son peuple.
verses.am: የባሪያዎቹን ደም ይበቀላልና፥  ጠላቶቹንም ይበቀላቸዋልና፥  ምድሪቱንና ሕዝቡን ይክሳልና  እናንተ አሕዛብ ሆይ፥ ከሕዝቡ ጋር ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.en: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.
verses.fr: Moïse vint et prononça toutes les paroles de ce cantique en présence du peuple; Josué, fils de Nun, était avec lui.
verses.am: ሙሴም የነዌም ልጅ ኢያሱ የዚህችን መዝሙር ቃሎች ሁሉ በሕዝቡ ጆሮ ተናገሩ።

verses.en: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:
verses.fr: Lorsque Moïse eut achevé de prononcer toutes ces paroles devant tout Israël,
verses.am: ሙሴም ይህን ቃል ሁሉ ለእስራኤል ሁሉ ተናግሮ ፈጸመ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
verses.fr: il leur dit: Prenez à coeur toutes les paroles que je vous conjure aujourd''hui de recommander à vos enfants, afin qu''ils observent et mettent en pratique toutes les paroles de cette loi.
verses.am: እርሱም እንዲህ አላቸው። የዚህን ሕግ ቃሎች ሁሉ ይጠብቁና ያደርጉ ዘንድ ልጆቻችሁን እንድታዝዙበት ዛሬ የምመሰክርላችሁን ቃል ሁሉ በልባችሁ አኑሩት።

verses.en: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
verses.fr: Car ce n''est pas une chose sans importance pour vous; c''est votre vie, et c''est par là que vous prolongerez vos jours dans le pays dont vous aurez la possession, après avoir passé le Jourdain.
verses.am: ይህ ነገር ሕይወታችሁ ነው እንጂ ለእናንተ ከንቱ አይደለምና፤ በዚህም ነገር ትወርሱአት ዘንድ ዮርዳኖስን ተሻግራችሁ በምትገቡባት ምድር ረጅም ዘመን ትቀመጣላችሁ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,
verses.fr: Ce même jour, l''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:
verses.fr: Monte sur cette montagne d''Abarim, sur le mont Nebo, au pays de Moab, vis-à-vis de Jéricho; et regarde le pays de Canaan que je donne en propriété aux enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ወደዚህ በኢያሪኮ አንጻር በሞዓብ ምድር በዓባሪም ተራራ ውስጥ ወዳለው ወደ ናባው ተራራ ውጣ፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች ርስት አድርጌ የምሰጣቸውን የከነዓንን ምድር እይ፤

verses.en: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:
verses.fr: Tu mourras sur la montagne où tu vas monter, et tu seras recueilli auprès de ton peuple, comme Aaron, ton frère, est mort sur la montagne de Hor et a été recueilli auprès de son peuple,
verses.am: ወንድምህም አሮን በሖር ተራራ እንደ ሞተ ወደ ወገኖቹም እንደ ተከማቸ፥ በወጣህበት ተራራ ሙት፥ ወደ ወገኖችህም ተከማች፤

verses.en: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of MeribahKadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: parce que vous avez péché contre moi au milieu des enfants d''Israël, près des eaux de Meriba, à Kadès, dans le désert de Tsin, et que vous ne m''avez point sanctifié au milieu des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል በጺን ምድረ በዳ በቃዴስ ባለው በመሪባ ውኃ ስለ በደላችሁኝ፥ በእስራኤልም ልጆች መካከል ስላልቀደሳችሁኝ፥

verses.en: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Tu verras le pays devant toi; mais tu n''entreras point dans le pays que je donne aux enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ምድሪቱን ፊት ለፊት ታያለህ እንጂ ወደዚያች እኔ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ወደምሰጣቸው ምድር አትገባም።

verses.en: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
verses.fr: Voici la bénédiction par laquelle Moïse, homme de Dieu, bénit les enfants d''Israël, avant sa mort.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሙሴ ሳይሞት የእስራኤልን ልጆች የባረከባት በረከት ይህች ናት።

verses.en: And he said, The Lord came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.
verses.fr: Il dit: L''Eternel est venu du Sinaï, Il s''est levé sur eux de Séir, Il a resplendi de la montagne de Paran, Et il est sorti du milieu des saintes myriades: Il leur a de sa droite envoyé le feu de la loi.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ።  እግዚአብሔር ከሲና መጣ፥  በሴይርም ተገለጠ፤  ከፋራን ተራራ አበራላቸው፥  ከአእላፋትም ቅዱሳኑ መጣ፤  በስተ ቀኙም የእሳት ሕግ ነበረላቸው።

verses.en: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.
verses.fr: Oui, il aime les peuples; Tous ses saints sont dans ta main. Ils se sont tenus à tes pieds, Ils ont reçu tes paroles.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም ወደዳቸው፤  ቅዱሳኑ ሁሉ በእጅህ ናቸው፤  በእግሮችህም አጠገብ ተቀመጡ፤  ቃሎችህን ይቀበላሉ።

verses.en: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
verses.fr: Moïse nous a donné la loi, Héritage de l''assemblée de Jacob.
verses.am: ሙሴ ለያዕቆብ ጉባኤ ርስት የሆነውን  ሕግ አዘዘን።

verses.en: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.
verses.fr: Il était roi en Israël, Quand s''assemblaient les chefs du peuple Et les tribus d''Israël.
verses.am: የሕዝቡ አለቆች ከእስራኤል ነገዶች  ሁሉ ጋር በተከማቹ ጊዜ፥  ንጉሥ በይሹሩን ነበረ።

verses.en: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let not his men be few.
verses.fr: Que Ruben vive et qu''il ne meure point, Et que ses hommes soient nombreux!
verses.am: ሮቤል በህይወት ይኑር፥ አይሙት፤  ሰዎቹም በቍጥር ብዙ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.
verses.fr: Voici sur Juda ce qu''il dit: Ecoute, ô Eternel! la voix de Juda, Et ramène-le vers son peuple. Que ses mains soient puissantes, Et que tu lui sois en aide contre ses ennemis!
verses.am: የይሁዳ በረከት ይህ ነው፤ እንዲህም አለ።  አቤቱ፥ የይሁዳን ድምፅ ስማ፥  ወደ ወገኖቹም አግባው፤  እጆቹ ይጠንክሩለት፤  በጠላቶቹ ላይ ረዳት ትሆነዋለህ።

verses.en: And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;
verses.fr: Sur Lévi il dit: Les thummim et les urim ont été confiés à l''homme saint, Que tu as tenté à Massa, Et avec qui tu as contesté aux eaux de Meriba.
verses.am: ስለ ሌዊም እንዲህ አለ፥  ቱሚምህና ኡሪምህ ለቅዱስህ ሰው ነው፥  በማሳህ ለፈተንኸው፥  በመሪባ ውኃም ለተከራከርኸው፤

verses.en: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.
verses.fr: Lévi dit de son père et de sa mère: Je ne les ai point vus! Il ne distingue point ses frères, Il ne connaît point ses enfants. Car ils observent ta parole, Et ils gardent ton alliance;
verses.am: ስለ አባቱና ስለ እናቱ። አላየሁም ላለ፥  ወንድሞቹንም ላላስተዋለ፥  ልጆቹንም ላላወቀ፤  ቃልህን አደረጉ፥  ቃል ኪዳንህንም ጠበቁ።

verses.en: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.
verses.fr: Ils enseignent tes ordonnances à Jacob, Et ta loi à Israël; Ils mettent l''encens sous tes narines, Et l''holocauste sur ton autel.
verses.am: ፍርድህን ለያዕቆብ፥  ሕግህንም ለእስራኤል ያስተምራሉ፤  በፊትህ ዕጣንን፥  በመሠዊያህም የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ይሠዋሉ።

verses.en: Bless, Lord, his substance, and accept the work of his hands; smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.
verses.fr: Bénis sa force, ô Eternel! Agrée l''oeuvre de ses mains! Brise les reins de ses adversaires, Et que ses ennemis ne se relèvent plus!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሀብቱን ባርክ፥  የእጁንም ሥራ ተቀበል፤  የሚነሣበትን ወገብ ውጋው፥  የሚጠሉትም አይነሡ።

verses.en: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the Lord shall dwell in safety by him; and the Lord shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.
verses.fr: Sur Benjamin il dit: C''est le bien-aimé de l''Eternel, Il habitera en sécurité auprès de lui; L''Eternel le couvrira toujours, Et résidera entre ses épaules.
verses.am: ስለ ብንያምም እንዲህ አለ።  በእግዚአብሔር የተወደደ በእርሱ  ዘንድ ተማምኖ ይኖራል፤  ቀኑን ሁሉ ይጋርደዋል፥  በትከሻውም መካከል ያድራል።

verses.en: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the Lord be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,
verses.fr: Sur Joseph il dit: Son pays recevra de l''Eternel, en signe de bénédiction, Le meilleur don du ciel, la rosée, Les meilleures eaux qui sont en bas,
verses.am: ስለ ዮሴፍም እንዲህ አለ፥  ምድሩ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የተባረከ ይሁን፤  በሰማያት ገናንነት በጠል፥  በታችኛውም ቀላይ፥

verses.en: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,
verses.fr: Les meilleurs fruits du soleil, Les meilleurs fruits de chaque mois,
verses.am: በፀሐዩ ፍሬያት ገናንነት፥  በጨረቃውም መውጣት ገናንነት

verses.en: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,
verses.fr: Les meilleurs produits des antiques montagnes, Les meilleurs produits des collines éternelles,
verses.am: በቀደሙትም ተራሮች ከፍተኛነት፥  በዘላለሙም ኮረብቶች ገናንነት፥

verses.en: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.
verses.fr: Les meilleurs produits de la terre et de ce qu''elle renferme. Que la grâce de celui qui apparut dans le buisson Vienne sur la tête de Joseph, Sur le sommet de la tête du prince de ses frères!
verses.am: በምድሪቱም ገናንነትና ሞላዋ፥  በቍጥቋጦው ውስጥ ከነበረው በረከት  በዮሴፍ ራስ ላይ፥ ከወንድሞቹም በተለየው ራስ አናት ላይ ይውረድ።

verses.en: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns are like the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.
verses.fr: De son taureau premier-né il a la majesté; Ses cornes sont les cornes du buffle; Avec elles il frappera tous les peuples, Jusqu''aux extrémités de la terre: Elles sont les myriades d''Ephraïm, Elles sont les milliers de Manassé.
verses.am: ለላሞች በኵር ግርማ ይሆናል፤  ቀንዶቹ አንድ ቀንድ እንዳለው ናቸው፤  በእነርሱ እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ያሉትን  አሕዛብ ሁሉ ይወጋል፤  የኤፍሬም እልፍ አእላፋት፥  የምናሴም አእላፋት እነርሱ ናቸው።

verses.en: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.
verses.fr: Sur Zabulon il dit: Réjouis-toi, Zabulon, dans tes courses, Et toi, Issacar, dans tes tentes!
verses.am: ስለ ዛብሎንም እንዲህ አለ። ዛብሎን ሆይ፥ በመውጣትህ፥  ይሳኮር ሆይ፥ በድንኳንህ ውስጥ ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.en: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas, and of treasures hid in the sand.
verses.fr: Ils appelleront les peuples sur la montagne; Là, ils offriront des sacrifices de justice, Car ils suceront l''abondance de la mer, Et les trésors cachés dans le sable.
verses.am: የተሰወረውን የአሸዋውን መዝገብ፥  የባሕሩንም ባለጠግነት ይጠባሉና  አሕዛብን ወደ ተራራው ይጠራሉ፤  በዚያ የጽድቅ መሥዋዕት ይሠዋሉ።

verses.en: And of Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the head.
verses.fr: Sur Gad il dit: Béni soit celui qui met Gad au large! Gad repose comme une lionne, Il déchire le bras et la tête.
verses.am: ስለ ጋድም እንዲህ አለ።  ጋድን ሰፊ ያደረገ ቡሩክ ይሁን፤  እንደ አንበሳይቱ ዐርፎአል፤  ክንድንና ራስን ይቀጠቅጣል።

verses.en: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, in a portion of the lawgiver, was he seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the Lord, and his judgments with Israel.
verses.fr: Il a choisi les prémices du pays, Car là est caché l''héritage du législateur; Il a marché en tête du peuple, Il a exécuté la justice de l''Eternel, Et ses ordonnances envers Israël.
verses.am: በዚያ የአለቃ እድል ፈንታ ቀርቶአልና  የመጀመሪያውን ክፍል ለራሱ መረጠ፤  ወደ ሕዝብ አለቆችም መጣ፤  የእግዚአብሔርንም ጽድቅ፥  ፍርዱንም ከእስራኤል ጋር አደረገ።

verses.en: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion's whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.
verses.fr: Sur Dan il dit: Dan est un jeune lion, Qui s''élance de Basan.
verses.am: ስለ ዳንም እንዲህ አለ።  ዳን የአንበሳ ደቦል ነው፤  ከባሳን ዘልሎ ይወጣል።

verses.en: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the Lord: possess thou the west and the south.
verses.fr: Sur Nephthali il dit: Nephthali, rassasié de faveurs Et comblé des bénédictions de l''Eternel, Prends possession de l''occident et du midi!
verses.am: ስለ ንፍታሌምም እንዲህ አለ።  ንፍታሌም በሞገስ ጠግቦአል፥  የእግዚአብሔርንም በረከት ተሞልቶአል፤  ባሕሩንና ደቡቡን ይወርሳል።

verses.en: And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.
verses.fr: Sur Aser il dit: Béni soit Aser entre les enfants d''Israël! Qu''il soit agréable à ses frères, Et qu''il plonge son pied dans l''huile!
verses.am: ስለ አሴርም እንዲህ አለ።  አሴር በልጆች የተባረከ ይሁን፤  በወንድሞቹ የተወደደ ይሁን፤ እግሩንም በዘይት ውስጥ ያጥልቅ።

verses.en: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass; and as thy days, so shall thy strength be.
verses.fr: Que tes verrous soient de fer et d''airain, Et que ta vigueur dure autant que tes jours!
verses.am: ጫማህ ብረትና ናስ ይሆናል፤  እንደ ዕድሜህ እንዲሁ ኃይልህ ይሆናል።

verses.en: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun, who rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.
verses.fr: Nul n''est semblable au Dieu d''Israël, Il est porté sur les cieux pour venir à ton aide, Il est avec majesté porté sur les nuées.
verses.am: ይሹሩን ሆይ፥ በሰማያት ላይ ለረድኤትህ፥  በደመናትም ላይ በታላቅነት እንደሚሄድ  እንደ እግዚአብሔር ያለ ማንም የለም።

verses.en: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.
verses.fr: Le Dieu d''éternité est un refuge, Et sous ses bras éternels est une retraite. Devant toi il a chassé l''ennemi, Et il a dit: Extermine.
verses.am: መኖሪያህ የዘላለም አምላክ ነው፥  የዘላለምም ክንዶች ከአንተ በታች ናቸው፤  ጠላትህን ከፊትህ አውጥቶ።  አጥፋው ይላል።

verses.en: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.
verses.fr: Israël est en sécurité dans sa demeure, La source de Jacob est à part Dans un pays de blé et de moût, Et son ciel distille la rosée.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ተማምኖ፥  የያዕቆብም ምንጭ ብቻውን፥  እህልና የወይን ጠጅ ባለባት ምድር ይኖራል፤  ሰማያቱም ጠልን ያንጠባጥባሉ።

verses.en: Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the Lord, the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.
verses.fr: Que tu es heureux, Israël! Qui est comme toi, Un peuple sauvé par l''Eternel, Le bouclier de ton secours Et l''épée de ta gloire? Tes ennemis feront défaut devant toi, Et tu fouleras leurs lieux élevés.
verses.am: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ምስጉን ነህ፤  በእግዚአብሔር የዳነ ሕዝብ እንደ አንተ ማን ነው?  እርሱ የረድኤትህ ጋሻ፥  የከፍተኛነትህም ሰይፍ ነው።  ጠላቶችህም ይገዙልሃል፤  አንተም ከፍታቸውን ትረግጣለህ።

verses.en: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And the Lord shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,
verses.fr: Moïse monta des plaines de Moab sur le mont Nebo, au sommet du Pisga, vis-à-vis de Jéricho. Et l''Eternel lui fit voir tout le pays: Galaad jusqu''à Dan,
verses.am: ሙሴም ከሞዓብ ሜዳ በኢያሪኮ ፊት ለፊት ወዳለው ወደ ናባው ተራራ ወደ ፈስጋ ራስ ወጣ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እስከዳን ድረስ ያለውን የገለዓድን ምድር፥

verses.en: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,
verses.fr: tout Nephthali, le pays d''Ephraïm et de Manassé, tout le pays de Juda jusqu''à la mer occidentale,
verses.am: የንፍታሌምንም ምድር ሁሉ፥ የኤፍሬምንና የምናሴንም ምድር፥ እስከ ምዕራብም ባሕር ድረስ ያለውን የይሁዳን ምድር ሁሉ፥ ደቡብንም፥

verses.en: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.
verses.fr: le midi, les environs du Jourdain, la vallée de Jéricho, la ville des palmiers, jusqu''à Tsoar.
verses.am: እስከ ዞዓር ድረስ ያለውንም የዘንባባ ዛፎች ያሉባትን ከተማ የኢያሪኮን ሸለቆ ሜዳ አሳየው።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto him, This is the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.
verses.fr: L''Eternel lui dit: C''est là le pays que j''ai juré de donner à Abraham, à Isaac et à Jacob, en disant: Je le donnerai à ta postérité. Je te l''ai fait voir de tes yeux; mais tu n''y entreras point.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ለዘርህ እሰጣታለሁ ብዬ ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም የማልሁላቸው ምድር ይህች ናት፤ በዓይንህ እንድታያት አደረግሁህ፥ ነገር ግን ወደዚያች አትሻገርም አለው።

verses.en: So Moses the servant of the Lord died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.fr: Moïse, serviteur de l''Eternel, mourut là, dans le pays de Moab, selon l''ordre de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያም ሙሴ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል በዚያ በሞዓብ ምድር ሞተ።

verses.en: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Bethpeor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel l''enterra dans la vallée, au pays de Moab, vis-à-vis de Beth-Peor. Personne n''a connu son sépulcre jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: በቤተ ፌጎርም ፊት ለፊት በሞዓብ ምድር በሸለቆው ውስጥ ተቀበረ፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ መቃብሩን ማንም አላወቀም።

verses.en: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.
verses.fr: Moïse était âgé de cent vingt ans lorsqu''il mourut; sa vue n''était point affaiblie, et sa vigueur n''était point passée.
verses.am: ሙሴም በሞተ ጊዜ ዕድሜው መቶ ሀያ ዓመት ነበረ፤ ዓይኑ አልፈዘዘም፥ ጕልበቱም አልደነገዘም።

verses.en: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël pleurèrent Moïse pendant trente jours, dans les plaines de Moab; et ces jours de pleurs et de deuil sur Moïse arrivèrent à leur terme.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በሞዓብ ሜዳ ሠላሳ ቀን ለሙሴ አለቀሱለት፤ ለሙሴም ያለቀሱለት የልቅሶው ወራት ተፈጸመ።

verses.en: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Josué, fils de Nun, était rempli de l''esprit de sagesse, car Moïse avait posé ses mains sur lui. Les enfants d''Israël lui obéirent, et se conformèrent aux ordres que l''Eternel avait donnés à Moïse.
verses.am: ሙሴም እጆቹን ስለ ጫነበት የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ የጥበብን መንፈስ ተሞላ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ታዘዙለት፥ እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው አደረጉ።

verses.en: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,
verses.fr: Il n''a plus paru en Israël de prophète semblable à Moïse, que l''Eternel connaissait face à face.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ፊት ለፊት እንዳወቀው እንደ ሙሴ ያለ ነቢይ ከዚያ ወዲህ በእስራኤል ዘንድ አልተነሣም፤

verses.en: In all the signs and the wonders, which the Lord sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
verses.fr: Nul ne peut lui être comparé pour tous les signes et les miracles que Dieu l''envoya faire au pays d''Egypte contre Pharaon, contre ses serviteurs et contre tout son pays,
verses.am: በግብፅ ምድር በፈርዖንና በባሪያዎቹ ሁሉ ላይ በምድሪቱም ሁሉ ላይ ምልክትንና ድንቅን ያደርግ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ላከው ያለ፥

verses.en: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.
verses.fr: et pour tous les prodiges de terreur que Moïse accomplit à main forte sous les yeux de tout Israël.
verses.am: በእስራኤል ሁሉ ፊት በጸናች እጅ ሁሉና በታላቅ ማስደንገጥ ሁሉ እንዳደረገው እንደ ሙሴ ያለ አልተነሣም።
